verses.translation: They shall be rushing with their heads raised upward; their eyes shall not return towards them and their hearts shall be hollow.

verses.text: And, [O Muhammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?
verses.translation: Warn the people of a day when punishment will come upon them, and the wrongdoers will say, “Our Lord, give us respite for a short term, and we will respond to Your call and will follow the messengers.” (Allah will say), “Is it not that you had sworn oaths earlier that you would not have to leave (the world)?

verses.text: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."
verses.translation: And you dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We put forth for you the examples.”

verses.text: And they had planned their plan, but with Allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
verses.translation: And they worked out their plot and whatever they plot is before Allah, even though their plot is such as would move the mountains.

verses.text: So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
verses.translation: So, never think that Allah will do against His promise to His messengers. Surely, Allah is Mighty, the Lord of Retribution

verses.text: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and all creatures will come out before Allah , the One, the Prevailing.
verses.translation: the day on which this earth will be turned into some other earth, and the skies as well, and they all shall appear before Allah, the One, the All-Dominant.

verses.text: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in shackles,
verses.translation: On that day you will see the culprits tied up together in chains,

verses.text: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire.
verses.translation: their shirts will be of rosin, and their faces will be covered with Fire

verses.text: So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
verses.translation: so that Allah repays everyone in full whatever he earned. Indeed, Allah is swift at reckoning.

verses.text: This [Qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
verses.translation: This is a message for mankind, so that they (take lesson and) be warned, and so that they may know that He is One God, and so that the people of understanding may observe the advice.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
verses.translation: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are verses of the Book and the enlightening Qur’ān.

verses.text: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
verses.translation: On many occasions, the disbelievers will wish that they were Muslims.

verses.text: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
verses.translation: Let them eat and enjoy, and let (their) fancy make them neglectful, for they shall soon come to know (their ultimate end).

verses.text: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
verses.translation: We did not destroy any town without having a pre-determined time for it.

verses.text: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
verses.translation: No people can precede their appointed time, nor can they exceed it.

verses.text: And they say,"O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
verses.translation: They say, “O you to whom the Dhikr (the Qur’ān) has been revealed, you are surely insane.

verses.text: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
verses.translation: Why do you not bring the angels to us, if you are one of the truthful?”

verses.text: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.
verses.translation: We do not send down the angels except with truth, and then they shall be given no respite.

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.
verses.translation: We, Ourselves, have sent down the Dhikr (the Qur’ān), and We are there to protect it.

verses.text: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
verses.translation: We did send the messengers before you among the groups of earlier peoples.

verses.text: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
verses.translation: No messenger came to them but they used to mock at him.

verses.text: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.
verses.translation: Likewise, We make it (i.e. disbelief) enter into the hearts of the sinners,

verses.text: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
verses.translation: (whereby) they do not believe in it (the Qur’ān), and this has been the way of earlier people.

verses.text: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
verses.translation: Even if We open a gate in the sky and they keep ascending through it,

verses.text: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
verses.translation: still they will say, “In fact our eyes have been deluded; rather we are enchanted people.

verses.text: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
verses.translation: We have created stellar formations in the sky and have beautified them for onlookers,

verses.text: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah ]
verses.translation: and have protected them from every outcast devil,

verses.text: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
verses.translation: but the one who tries to eavesdrop is chased by a clearly visible flame.

verses.text: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
verses.translation: As for the earth, We have stretched it out and placed on it firm mountains, and We have caused to grow in it everything well-balanced,

verses.text: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
verses.translation: and created in it sources of sustenance for you and those (creatures) for whom you are not the sustainers.

verses.text: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.
verses.translation: We have treasures of every thing, but We send it down only in a determined quantity.

verses.text: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
verses.translation: And We sent forth winds carrying the clouds, then sent down water from the sky and gave it to you to drink, and you are not able to store it.

verses.text: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
verses.translation: It is indeed We, and only We, who give life and bring death, and We are the ultimate inheritor (of everything).

verses.text: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
verses.translation: We know those of you who went ahead, and We know those who remained late.

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
verses.translation: Surely, your Lord will gather all of them together. Indeed He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.text: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
verses.translation: Indeed We created man from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.

verses.text: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
verses.translation: As for the Jānn (the first Jinn), We had created him earlier from the fire of the scorching wind.

verses.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
verses.translation: Recall when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.

verses.text: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.translation: When I form him perfect, and blow in him of My spirit, then you must fall down before him in prostration.”

verses.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
verses.translation: So the angels prostrated themselves, all together,

verses.text: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
verses.translation: except Iblīs (Satan). He refused to join those who prostrated.

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
verses.translation: He (Allah) said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?”

verses.text: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
verses.translation: He said, “I am not such that I should prostrate myself before a mortal whom You have created from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.translation: He said, “Then, get out of here, for you are an outcast,

verses.text: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.translation: and upon you is the curse up to the Day of Judgment.”

verses.text: He said,"My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, then give me respite up to the day they (the dead) shall be raised.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.translation: He (Allah) said, “Well, respite is given to you

verses.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.translation: till the day of the Appointed Time.”

verses.text: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, since You made me go astray, I swear that I shall beautify for them (evils) on the earth, and shall lead all of them astray,

verses.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.translation: except those of Your servants from among them who are chosen (by You).”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
verses.translation: He (Allah) said, “This is the straight path leading to Me (that a person is chosen by Me through his good deeds).

verses.text: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
verses.translation: My servants are such that you have no power over them except those of the deviators who will follow you.

verses.text: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
verses.translation: And Jahannam (Hell) is the promised place for them all.

verses.text: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."
verses.translation: It has seven gates. For each gate there is a group apportioned from them.”

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.
verses.translation: Surely, the God-fearing will be in gardens and streams:

verses.text: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
verses.translation: “Enter here in peace, free of fear.”

verses.text: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
verses.translation: We shall have removed whatever grudge they had in their hearts, (thus making them) brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.

verses.text: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
verses.translation: No weariness shall touch them nor will they be expelled from there.

verses.text: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.translation: Tell My servants that I am the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful

verses.text: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
verses.translation: and that My punishment is the painful punishment,

verses.text: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
verses.translation: and tell them about the guests of Ibrāhīm.

verses.text: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."
verses.translation: When they visited him, they greeted him with Salām (peace on you). He said, “We are scared of you.”

verses.text: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
verses.translation: They said, “Do not be scared. We give you good news of a boy who will be knowledgeable.”

verses.text: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
verses.translation: He said, “Do you give me the good news despite the old age has befallen me? So what good news you are giving to me?”

verses.text: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
verses.translation: They said, “We have given to you the good news of a fact. So do not be one of those who lose hope.”

verses.text: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
verses.translation: He said, “Who can lose hope in the mercy of his Lord except those who have lost the straight path?”

verses.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
verses.translation: He said, “Then, what is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
verses.translation: They said, “We have been sent to a sinful people,

verses.text: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
verses.translation: except the family of LūT - all of whom we shall save,

verses.text: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
verses.translation: but his wife. We have ordained that she will be among those who will remain behind.”

verses.text: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
verses.translation: So when the messengers came to the family of LūT,

verses.text: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
verses.translation: he said, “You are an unfamiliar people.”

verses.text: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
verses.translation: They said, “No, but we have brought to you that (scourge) in which they have been doubting,

verses.text: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
verses.translation: and we have come to you with a definite matter and surely we are truthful.

verses.text: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
verses.translation: So, carry your family after a part of the night (has passed), and follow them at the rear (to make sure that all of your family has joined you), and no one from you should look back; and keep going to where you are commanded.”

verses.text: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
verses.translation: We conveyed to him Our decision that they (the unbelievers) were to be totally uprooted when they would see the morning.

verses.text: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
verses.translation: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

verses.text: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
verses.translation: He (LūT) said, “They are my guests; so do not put me to shame,

verses.text: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."
verses.translation: and fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”

verses.text: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
verses.translation: They said, “Had we not forbidden you from (being the guardian of) the whole world?”

verses.text: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
verses.translation: He said, “These are my daughters, if you are to do something.”

verses.text: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
verses.translation: By your life, (O prophet) they were wandering blindly in their intoxication (misguidance).

verses.text: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
verses.translation: So, they were seized by the Cry at sunrise.

verses.text: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
verses.translation: Then, We turned it (the city) upside down and rained down upon them stones of baked clay.

verses.text: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
verses.translation: Surely, in that there are signs for those who read signs.

verses.text: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.
verses.translation: Surely, it (their city) is located on the straight road.

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
verses.translation: Surely, in it there is a sign for the believers.

verses.text: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.
verses.translation: And the people of Aikah were (also) transgressors.

verses.text: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
verses.translation: So, We punished them in retribution, and both of them are (situated) by a highway, clearly visible.

verses.text: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.
verses.translation: And the people of Al-Hijr gave the lie to the messengers.

verses.text: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
verses.translation: We provided them with Our signs, yet they kept turning away from them.

verses.text: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
verses.translation: They used to hew out houses from the hills peacefully.

verses.text: But the shriek seized them at early morning.
verses.translation: Then, the Cry seized them by the morning.

verses.text: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
verses.translation: So, whatever they earned did not come to their help.

verses.text: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them without a truthful purpose. The Hour is sure to come. Therefore, overlook (their evil behavior) in a gracious manner.

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
verses.translation: Surely, your Lord is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.

verses.text: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
verses.translation: We have given you the seven oft-repeated verses and the glorious Qur’ān.

verses.text: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
verses.translation: Never stretch your eyes towards what We have given to groups of them to enjoy, and do not grieve for them, and be kind to believers in humbleness,

verses.text: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
verses.translation: and say, “I am a plain warner indeed”

verses.text: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
verses.translation: (to warn them that We may send down the scourge upon them) as We sent down upon the dividers.

verses.text: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
verses.translation: who had split the divine recitation (Scriptures) into bits.

verses.text: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
verses.translation: So, by your Lord, We shall question all of them.

verses.text: About what they used to do.
verses.translation: about what they have been doing.

verses.text: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
verses.translation: Now, proclaim what you are commanded to, and turn away from those who ascribe partners to Allah.

verses.text: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
verses.translation: Surely, We are sufficient for you against those who deride,

verses.text: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.
verses.translation: - those who believe in any other god along with Allah. So, they shall soon learn (the reality).

verses.text: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
verses.translation: We know that your heart feels distressed for what they say.

verses.text: So exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
verses.translation: So, proclaim the purity and glory of your Lord, and be among those who prostrate themselves (before Allah);

verses.text: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty  ( death ) .
verses.translation: and worship your Lord until comes to you that which is certain.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
verses.translation: Allah’s command has (almost) come. So, do not demand that it should come sooner. Pure is He, and much higher than their ascribing partners to Him.

verses.text: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
verses.translation: He sends down the angels at His behest with the spirit, (that is, the revelation), upon whom He wills from among His servants: “Warn people that there is no god but Me. So, fear Me.”

verses.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
verses.translation: He created the heavens and the earth in the proper way. He is much higher than their ascribing partners to Him.

verses.text: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.
verses.translation: He created man from a drop, and soon he turned into a debating person, expressing himself openly.

verses.text: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
verses.translation: He has created cattle in which there is warmth and other benefits for you; and from them you have food;

verses.text: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
verses.translation: and in them there is a beautiful look for you when you drive them home in the evening and take them out to graze.

verses.text: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
verses.translation: And they carry your loads to a city where you were not able to reach without putting yourselves to arduous labor. Surely, your Lord is Very-Kind, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
verses.translation: And (He created) horses, mules and donkeys, so that you may ride on them, and they may give you a good look. And He creates what you do not know (as yet).

verses.text: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
verses.translation: Undertaken by Allah is (to show) the right path, while there are some (paths) that are crooked. Had He so willed, He would have led all of you to the right path.

verses.text: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
verses.translation: He is the One who sent down water from the heavens, of which you have your drink; and with it (you grow) plants on which you pasture your cattle.

verses.text: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
verses.translation: He causes the crops therewith to grow for you, and olives, and date palms, and grape vines, and all the fruits. Surely, in that, there is a sign for a people who ponder.

verses.text: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
verses.translation: He has subjugated for you the day and the night and the sun and the moon, and the stars (too) are subservient by His command. Surely, in that, there are signs for a people who understand.

verses.text: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
verses.translation: And (He subjugated to you) whatever He created for you on the earth having varied colors. Surely, in that, there is a sign for a people who accept advice.

verses.text: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.translation: He is the One who has subjugated the sea, so that you may eat fresh meat from it, and may take out from it ornaments you wear, and you see the boats cleaving through it, and so that you may seek His bounty, and that you may be grateful.

verses.text: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
verses.translation: And He placed mountains on the earth, lest it should shake with you, and rivers and tracks, so that you may find the right way,

verses.text: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
verses.translation: and He has set landmarks. And by the stars they find the right way.

verses.text: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
verses.translation: Is then the One who creates (everything) equal to one who does not create? Would you still pay no heed?

verses.text: And if you should count the favors of Allah , you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: If you count the bounties of Allah, you cannot count them all. Surely, Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare.
verses.translation: Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

verses.text: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
verses.translation: Those whom they invoke beside Allah do not create any thing; rather they are themselves created;

verses.text: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
verses.translation: they are dead, having no life, and they do not know when they shall be raised again.

verses.text: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
verses.translation: Your God is One God. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are defiant and they are arrogant.

verses.text: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
verses.translation: Invariably, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Surely, He does not like the arrogant.

verses.text: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
verses.translation: When it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “It is nothing but the tales of the ancient people.”

verses.text: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
verses.translation: Hence, they shall bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Judgment, and also some of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Remember, evil is the burden they bear.

verses.text: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
verses.translation: Those (too) who were before them made plots. Then (the command of) Allah came upon their buildings (uprooting them) from the foundations. So roofs fell down upon them from above, and the chastisement came to them from where they could not even imagine.

verses.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -
verses.translation: Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will put them to disgrace and will say, “Where are My partners for whose sake you used to quarrel (with the believers)?” Those endowed with knowledge will say, “Today, the disgrace and the evil (chastisement) has to befall the unbelievers,

verses.text: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do.
verses.translation: the ones to whom the angels brought death while they were (still) wronging themselves.” Then, they will resort to submission, (yet will say), “We used to do nothing wrong.” (They will be answered) Why not? Allah knows well what you used to do.

verses.text: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
verses.translation: Hence, enter the gates of Jahannam to live in it forever. So evil is the abode of the arrogant.

verses.text: And it will be said to those who feared Allah , "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
verses.translation: And (on the other hand,) it is said to the God-fearing, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “(He has sent down) excellent (discourse).” For those who do good, there is good (end) in this world, and indeed the abode of the Hereafter is much better. Excellent is the abode of the God-fearing -

verses.text: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -
verses.translation: the eternal gardens they enter, with rivers flowing beneath them. For them there is what they desire. That is how Allah rewards the God-fearing -

verses.text: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."
verses.translation: the ones to whom angels bring death while they are pure (in beliefs and deeds). They (angels) say, “Peace on you! Enter Paradise for the deeds you have been doing.”

verses.text: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
verses.translation: They (the unbelievers) are waiting for nothing but that the angels should come to them, or comes the command of your Lord. Similar was the reaction of those who were before them. Allah did not wrong them; rather they were doing wrong to themselves.

verses.text: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: So, the evils of what they did overtook them, and they were encircled by the very thing they used to ridicule.

verses.text: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?
verses.translation: The polytheists said, “If Allah had so willed, we would have not worshipped anything other than Him - neither we nor our forefathers - nor would we have made anything unlawful without (a command from) Him.” Similar was the reaction of those who were before them. Therefore, the messengers’ obligation is no more than to convey the message clearly.

verses.text: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
verses.translation: We did raise a messenger among every people, with the message: “Worship Allah and stay away from the Rebel (the Satan).” Then, there were some among them whom Allah guided, and there were others against whom deviation (from the right path) was established. So, travel on earth and see how was the fate of those who rejected (the prophets).

verses.text: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
verses.translation: If you are keen for their guidance, then, (remember that) Allah does not lead those to the right path whom He lets go astray, and for them there are no helpers.

verses.text: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
verses.translation: They swore by Allah on solemn oaths: “Allah will not resurrect those who die.” Why not? It is a promise on His part, which is due to come true, but most of the people do not know.

verses.text: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
verses.translation: (He will resurrect all of them,) so that He discloses for them what they have been disputing about, and so that those who disbelieve may know that they were liars.

verses.text: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.translation: Whenever We intend to do something, We do no more than say to it, “Be,” and it comes to be.

verses.text: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
verses.translation: Those who have migrated for the sake of Allah after they were oppressed, We shall give them a good place in the world, and of course, the reward of the Hereafter is much greater, if they only knew!

verses.text: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
verses.translation: - those who kept patient, and who place trust in their Lord.

verses.text: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know.
verses.translation: We did not send (messengers) before you other than men whom We inspired with revelation. So, ask the people (having the knowledge) of the Reminder (the earlier Scriptures), if you do not know.

verses.text: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
verses.translation: (We sent them) with clear signs and scriptures. And We sent down the Reminder (The Qur’ān) to you, so that you explain to the people what has been revealed for them, and so that they may ponder.

verses.text: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
verses.translation: Do those who contrive evil plots feel immune from that Allah makes them sink into the earth, or from that the punishment comes to them from where they would not perceive,

verses.text: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?
verses.translation: or that He seizes them when roaming about - while they are not able to frustrate Him -

verses.text: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
verses.translation: or that He seizes them while they are in apprehension? So, indeed your Lord is Very-Kind, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah , while they are humble.
verses.translation: Have they not observed the things Allah has created, their shadows inclining from the right and the left prostrating themselves before Allah, while they are humble?

verses.text: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
verses.translation: To Allah prostrates itself whatever creature there is in the heavens and in the earth, and the angels, and they show no arrogance.

verses.text: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
verses.translation: They fear their Lord above them and do as they are commanded.

verses.text: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me."
verses.translation: Allah has said, “Do not take two gods. He is but One God. So, Me alone you fear.”

verses.text: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear?
verses.translation: And to Him belongs what is in the heavens and the earth, and it is only He who deserves obedience as ever due. Would you, then, fear someone other than Allah?

verses.text: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah . Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
verses.translation: Whatever blessing you have is from Allah. Then, once you are touched by distress, to Him alone you cry for help.

verses.text: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
verses.translation: Then, as soon as He removes the distress from you, a group from among you starts ascribing partners to their Lord.

verses.text: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
verses.translation: Thus, they deny what We have given to them. Well, enjoy yourself (for some time), and soon you will come to know (the fate of your misdeeds).

verses.text: And they assign to what they do not know a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allah , you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.
verses.translation: They allocate a share from what We have given to them for those (idols) the reality of whom they do not even know. By Allah, you shall definitely be responsible for the fabrications you have been inventing.

verses.text: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire.
verses.translation: They ascribe daughters to Allah - Pure is He - and for themselves is what they desire!

verses.text: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
verses.translation: When one of them is given the good news of a female child, his face becomes gloomy and he is choked with grief.

verses.text: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.
verses.translation: He hides himself from people because of the (self-presumed) bad news given to him (and wonders): Shall he keep it despite the disgrace (he will face in the society), or put it away into the dust? In fact, evil is what they decide.

verses.text: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter have evil attributes, and to Allah belong the most exalted attributes. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.text: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
verses.translation: If Allah were to seize the people for their transgression, He would have spared no creature on earth, but He lets them go on up to an appointed time. So, when their time will come, they will not be able to delay it for a moment, nor to bring it soon.

verses.text: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.
verses.translation: They assign to Allah what they themselves dislike, and their tongues make the false statement that for them there is a happy end. No, Fire is imminently theirs, and they are being driven (towards it) speedily.

verses.text: By Allah , We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.translation: By Allah, We sent (messengers) to communities before you, but the Satan made their deeds look good to them. So, he is their patron today, and for them there is a painful punishment.

verses.text: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
verses.translation: We have sent down the Book to you, only because you may explain to them what they differed about, and (so that it may be) guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

verses.text: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
verses.translation: Allah sent down water from the heavens and revived the land with it after it was dead. Surely, in that there is a sign for a people who listen.

verses.text: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
verses.translation: Surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle. We provide you, out of what lies in their bellies between feces and blood, the (drink of) milk, pure and pleasant for those who drink.

verses.text: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
verses.translation: And from the fruits of date palms and grape vines, you obtain intoxicants, and good provision. Surely, in that there is a sign for a people who understand.

verses.text: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
verses.translation: Your Lord revealed to the honeybee: “Make homes in the mountains, in the trees and in the structures they raise.

verses.text: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
verses.translation: Then, eat from all the fruits, and go along the pathways of your Lord made easy for you.” From their bellies comes out a drink of various colors in which there is cure for people. Surely, in that there is a sign for a people who ponder.

verses.text: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.
verses.translation: Allah has created you, then He takes you back. And among you there is one who is carried to the worst part of the age, so that he knows nothing after having knowledge. Surely, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

verses.text: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject?
verses.translation: Allah has given some of you preference over others in provision. So, those given preference are not willing to pass on their provision to their slaves, so that they become equal in it: Do they, then, reject the blessing of Allah?

verses.text: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?
verses.translation: Allah has created spouses from among you and created sons and grandsons for you from your spouses, and gave you provision from good things. Is it, then, the falsehood that they believe in, and the blessing of Allah that they reject?

verses.text: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
verses.translation: They worship, besides Allah, the objects that have no power to give them anything from the heavens and the earth, nor can they ever have such power.

verses.text: So do not assert similarities to Allah . Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.
verses.translation: So, do not coin similarities for Allah. Surely, Allah knows and you do not know.

verses.text: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah ! But most of them do not know.
verses.translation: Allah gives an example: There is a slave owned (by someone), who has no power over anything, and there is a person whom We have given good provision from Us, and he spends out of it secretly and openly. Are they equal? Praise be to Allah. But, most of them do not know.

verses.text: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
verses.translation: And Allah gives another example: There are two men. One of them is dumb who is unable to do anything, and he is a burden on his master. Wherever he directs him to, he brings no good. Can he be equal to the one who enjoins justice and is on the straight path?

verses.text: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
verses.translation: To Allah belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth; and the matter of Hour (of Judgment) is no more than of twinkling of the eye, or even quicker. Of course, Allah is powerful over everything.

verses.text: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.
verses.translation: Allah has brought you forth from your mothers’ wombs when you knew nothing, and He made for you ears, eyes and hearts, so that you may be grateful.

verses.text: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah . Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.translation: Did they not look at the birds how they are controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? No one holds them but Allah. Surely, in that there are signs for a people who believe.

verses.text: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.
verses.translation: Allah has made your houses a place of comfort for you, and made for you houses from the hides of cattle, which you find so light on the day you travel and the day you camp, and out of their wool and their fur and their hair (He created) furnishings and goods of enjoyment for a period of time.

verses.text: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].
verses.translation: Allah has made for your benefit shades from what He has created, and made for you shelters in the mountains, and made for you shirts that protect you from heat, and shirts that protect you in your battles. This is how He perfects His favor upon you, so that you may submit.

verses.text: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
verses.translation: If they still turn away, then, your responsibility is only to convey the message clearly.

verses.text: They recognize the favor of Allah ; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.
verses.translation: They are aware of Allah’s favor, yet they deny it, and most of them are ungrateful.

verses.text: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [ Allah ].
verses.translation: (Remember) the Day on which We shall raise up a witness from every people, then the disbelievers will not be allowed (to make excuses), nor shall they be asked to repent.

verses.text: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
verses.translation: And when the unjust will see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be given respite.

verses.text: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."
verses.translation: When the Mushriks (i.e. those who ascribe partners to Allah) will see those whom they made partners with Allah, they will say: “Our Lord, these are the partners we made whom we called in worship besides you.” Then, they (the partners) will turn to them saying: “You are indeed liars.”

verses.text: And they will impart to Allah that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
verses.translation: On that day they will tender submission to Allah, and all that they used to fabricate will have vanished from them.

verses.text: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.
verses.translation: For those who disbelieve and put obstructions in the way of Allah, We shall add up punishment after punishment for the mischief they used to make.

verses.text: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.
verses.translation: And (think of) the day We shall send to every people a witness from among them (to testify) against them, and We shall bring you (O prophet) as witness against these. And We have revealed to you the Book, an exposition of everything, and guidance, and mercy, and glad tidings for the Muslims.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.
verses.translation: Allah enjoins to do justice and to adopt good behavior and to give relatives (their due rights), and forbids shameful acts, evil deeds and oppressive attitude. He exhorts you, so that you may be mindful.

verses.text: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah , over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do.
verses.translation: Fulfill the Covenant of Allah when you pledge, and do not break oaths after you swear them solemnly, while you have made Allah a witness over you. Surely, Allah knows all that you do.

verses.text: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
verses.translation: Do not be like the woman who had broken her yarn into pieces after spinning it firmly, by taking your oaths as means of mischief between yourselves, merely because a group gets greater benefit than the other. In fact, Allah puts you to a test thereby and, of course, on the Day of Resurrection He will explain to you all those matters in which you disagreed.

verses.text: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
verses.translation: If Allah so willed, He would have made all of you a single community, but He lets whom He wills go astray and takes whom He wills to the right path; and surely you will be questioned about what you used to do.

verses.text: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah , and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
verses.translation: Do not make your oaths a means of mischief among yourselves, lest a foot should slip after it is firmly placed, and you taste evil consequences for your having prevented (others) from the path of Allah, and you incur a great punishment.

verses.text: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know.
verses.translation: And do not take a paltry price against the pledge of Allah. Indeed, what is with Allah is much better for you, if you only knew.

verses.text: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
verses.translation: What is with you shall perish and what is with Allah shall last. And certainly, We shall bless those who observed patience, with their reward for the best of what they used to do.

verses.text: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
verses.translation: Whoever, male or female, has acted righteously, while being a believer, We shall certainly make him live a good life, and shall give such people their reward for the best of what they used to do.

verses.text: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
verses.translation: So, when you recite the Qur’ān, seek refuge with Allah against Satan, the accursed.

verses.text: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.
verses.translation: He is such that he has no authority over those who believe and place trust in their Lord.

verses.text: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah .
verses.translation: His authority is only over those who befriend him and those who associate partners with Allah.

verses.text: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allah is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muhammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know.
verses.translation: Whenever We replace a verse with another verse - and Allah knows well what He reveals - they say, “You are but a forger.” The fact rather is that most of them are ignorant.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "The Pure Spirit has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims."
verses.translation: Say, “This has been brought down by RūH-ul-Qudus (the Holy Spirit - Jibra’īl ) from your Lord rightly (as due), so that it may bring firmness to the believers and become guidance and good news for the Muslims.

verses.text: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language.
verses.translation: We know well that they say, “There is a man who teaches him.” The language of the one they refer to is non-Arabic while this is clear Arabic language.

verses.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah - Allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.
verses.translation: Surely, those who do not believe in Allah’s verses, Allah does not lead them to the right path, and for them there is a painful punishment.

verses.text: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allah , and it is those who are the liars.
verses.translation: It is (not the Prophet but) the disbelievers in Allah’s verses who forge lies, and it is they who are the liars.

verses.text: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah , and for them is a great punishment;
verses.translation: Whoever rejects his faith in Allah after having believed in Him - not the one who is compelled (to utter a word of disbelief) under duress while his heart is at peace with Faith, but the one who has laid his breast wide open for disbelief - upon such people is the wrath of Allah, and for them there is a heavy punishment.

verses.text: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.
verses.translation: That is because they have preferred the worldly life to the Hereafter, and that Allah does not lead the disbelieving people to the right path.

verses.text: Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless.
verses.translation: Those are the ones Allah has set a seal on whose hearts, ears and eyes; and they are the heedless.

verses.text: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers.
verses.translation: Invariably, they are the losers in the Hereafter.

verses.text: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah ] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful
verses.translation: Then, your Lord - for those who left their homes after being persecuted, then fought in the way of Allah and stood patient - surely your Lord is, after all that, Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: On the Day when every soul will come disputing for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged.
verses.translation: (All this will happen) on the day when everyone will come pleading for himself, and everyone will be given in full what he did, and they will not be wronged.

verses.text: And Allah presents an example: a city which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allah . So Allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing.
verses.translation: Allah gives an example: There was a town, secure and content with its sustenance coming in plenty from every place. Then, it turned ungrateful to the bounties of Allah; so, Allah made it to taste hunger and terror (that covered it) like a garment, as recompense of what its people used to do.

verses.text: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.
verses.translation: And, of course, a messenger from among themselves had come to them, but they rejected him; so the punishment seized them when they were wrongdoers.

verses.text: Then eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allah , if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.
verses.translation: So, eat the permissible and pure things from what Allah has provided you, and be grateful for the bounty of Allah, if you worship Him alone.

verses.text: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah . But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: He has but prohibited for you the carrion, the blood, the flesh of swine and what has been invoked upon with a name other than that of Allah. However, if anyone is compelled by necessity - neither seeking pleasure, nor crossing the limit (of necessity) - then, Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allah . Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed.
verses.translation: Do not say about what your tongues describe falsely, “This is lawful and that is unlawful” so that you may forge the lie upon Allah. Surely, those who forge a lie upon Allah do not prosper.

verses.text: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.translation: (Let there be) a little enjoyment, and (then) for them there is a painful punishment.

verses.text: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves.
verses.translation: For those who are Jews, We had prohibited that which We have already told you; and We did not wrong them, but it was they who used to wrong themselves.

verses.text: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: Then your Lord - for those who did evil because of ignorance, then repented after that and corrected themselves - surely your Lord is, after all that, Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allah , inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allah .
verses.translation: Surely, Ibrāhīm was an Ummah (a whole community in himself), devoted to Allah, a man of pure faith; and he was not among the Mushriks (i.e. those who associate partners with Allah)

verses.text: [He was] grateful for His favors. Allah chose him and guided him to a straight path.
verses.translation: He was grateful to His bounties. He (Allah) chose him and led him to the straight path.

verses.text: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.
verses.translation: We bestowed good upon him in this world; and in the Hereafter, he is among the righteous.

verses.text: Then We revealed to you, [O Muhammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allah .
verses.translation: Then, We revealed to you, “Follow the way of Ibrāhīm, the upright, and he was not among the Mushriks”.

verses.text: The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.translation: The Sabbath was prescribed only for those people (i.e. Jews) who differed in it, and your Lord will certainly judge between them on the Day of Resurrection in those matters in which they used to differ.

verses.text: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided.
verses.translation: Invite (people) to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good counsel. And argue with them in the best of manners. Surely, your Lord knows best the one who deviates from His way, and He knows best the ones who are on the right path.

verses.text: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.
verses.translation: And if you were to harm (them) in retaliation, harm them to the measure you were harmed. And if you opt for patience, it is definitely much better for those who are patient.

verses.text: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah . And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.
verses.translation: And be patient. Your patience is bestowed by none but Allah, and do not grieve over them, and do not be in distress for what they devise.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
verses.translation: Surely, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are good in their deeds

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al- Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.translation: Glorious is He Who made his servant travel by night from Al-Masjid-ul-Harām to Al-Masjid-ul-AqSā whose environs We have blessed, so that We let him see some of Our signs. Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All- Seeing.

verses.text: And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,
verses.translation: And We gave Mūsā the Book and made it guidance for the children of Isrā’īl (bearing the command) “Do not take anyone other than Me as guardian,

verses.text: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.
verses.translation: O you, the progeny of those whom We put on board with NūH. Surely, He was a very grateful servant.”

verses.text: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness.
verses.translation: And We declared to the children of Isrā’īl in the Book: “You will surely spread mischief on the earth twice, and you will surely show utmost haughtiness.

verses.text: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.
verses.translation: So, when came the time appointed for the first of the two, We dispatched against you some servants belonging to us having strong aggressive power, who combed through the houses; and it was a promise, bound to be fulfilled.

verses.text: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower
verses.translation: Then We gave you your turn to overpower them, and increased your strength with wealth and sons, and made you greater in number,

verses.text: [And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to yourselves." Then when the final promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in Jerusalem, as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.
verses.translation: (saying) ‘If you do good, you will do it for your own benefit, and if you do evil, it will be against yourselves’. Later, when came the time appointed for the second, (We sent others,) so that they spoil your faces, and so that they enter into the Mosque as the former ones entered it the first time, and utterly destroy whatever they prevail upon.

verses.text: [Then Allah said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."
verses.translation: May be your Lord would bestow mercy upon you. But if you do this again, We shall do that again, and We have made Jahannam (Hell) a prison for the disbelievers.”

verses.text: Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.
verses.translation: Surely, this Qur’ān guides to something that is most straightforward, and gives glad tidings to the believers who do good deeds that ready for them there is a great reward,

verses.text: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.
verses.translation: and that We have prepared a painful punishment for those who do not believe in the Hereafter.

verses.text: And man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.
verses.translation: Man prays for evil like his prayer for good, and man is so hasty.

verses.text: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail.
verses.translation: We have made the night and the day two signs, then We made the sign of night marked by darkness and the sign of day bright, so that you may seek grace from your Lord, and that you may know how to number the years and how to compute, and We have expounded everything in detail.

verses.text: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
verses.translation: We have tied up every human’s fortune to his neck, and on the Day of Resurrection, We will bring forth a book for him that he will find wide open,

verses.text: [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."
verses.translation: (and We will say to him) “Read your book. Enough are you today to take your own account.”

verses.text: Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.
verses.translation: Whoever adopts the right path does so for his own benefit, and whoever goes astray does so to his own detriment, and no bearer of burden shall bear the burden of another, and it is not Our way to punish (anyone) unless We send a Messenger.

verses.text: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.
verses.translation: And when We intend to destroy a habitation, We command its affluent people (to do good), then they commit sins therein, and thus the word (of punishment) becomes applicable to it (habitation), and We annihilate it totally.

verses.text: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Acquainted and Seeing.
verses.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed after NūH! And enough is your Lord to know, (and) watch the sins of His servants.

verses.text: Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.
verses.translation: Whoever opts for the immediate (benefits from) life herein, We give him, right here in this life, as much as We will, to whomever We intend. Then We assign Jahannam for him where he shall enter condemned, discarded.

verses.text: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allah ].
verses.translation: And whoever opts for the Hereafter and makes efforts for it as due, while he is a believer, then, the effort of such people is appreciated!

verses.text: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.
verses.translation: To all of them - both these and those - We extend the grants of your Lord. And the grant of your Lord is not barred (for anyone).

verses.text: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
verses.translation: See how We made some of them excel some others (in this world) and, of course, the Hereafter is much higher in ranks and much greater in degrees of merit.

verses.text: Do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
verses.translation: Do not set up any other god along with Allah, otherwise you will sit condemned, forsaken.

verses.text: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.
verses.translation: Your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and do good to parents. If any one of them or both of them reach old age, do not say to them: uff (a word or expression of anger or contempt) and do not scold them, and address them with respectful words,

verses.text: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."
verses.translation: and submit yourself before them in humility out of compassion, and say, “My Lord, be merciful to them as they have brought me up in my childhood.”

verses.text: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving.
verses.translation: Your Lord knows best what is in your hearts. If you are righteous, then He is Most-Forgiving for those who turn to Him in repentance.

verses.text: And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.
verses.translation: Give the relative his right, and the needy and the wayfarer. And do not squander recklessly.

verses.text: Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.
verses.translation: Surely, squanderers are brothers of satans, and the Satan is very ungrateful to his Lord.

verses.text: And if you [must] turn away from the needy awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word.
verses.translation: And if you turn away from them looking for a bounty from your Lord you are expecting, then speak to them in polite words.

verses.text: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
verses.translation: And do not keep your hand tied to your neck, nor extend it to the full extent, lest you should be sitting reproached, empty-handed.

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.
verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord expands sustenance for whomsoever He wills, and constricts (for whomsoever He wills). Surely, He is All-Aware of His servants, All-Seeing.

verses.text: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
verses.translation: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide sustenance to them and to you, too. Killing them is a great sin indeed.

verses.text: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
verses.translation: Do not even go close to fornication. It is indeed a shameful act, and an evil way to follow.

verses.text: And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
