verses.translation: Do not kill any person the life of whom is sanctified by Allah, except for a just reason. And whoever is killed unjustly, We have invested his heir with authority (of equal retaliation), but he must not cross the limit in the matter of killing. Surely, he will be helped.

verses.text: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
verses.translation: Do not go near the property of an orphan, except in a manner that is good, until he comes to his maturity. And fulfill the covenant. Surely, the covenant shall be asked about (on the Day of Reckoning).

verses.text: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
verses.translation: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with a straight balance. That is fair, and better at the end.

verses.text: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
verses.translation: And do not follow a thing about which you have no knowledge. Surely, the ear, the eye and the heart - each one of them shall be interrogated about.

verses.text: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
verses.translation: Do not walk on the earth in haughty style. You can neither tear the earth apart, nor can you match the mountains in height.

verses.text: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
verses.translation: That which is evil, of all these, is detestable in the sight of your Lord.

verses.text: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
verses.translation: This is part of the Wisdom your Lord has revealed to you. And do not set up any other god along with Allah, lest you should be thrown into Jahannam , reproached, rejected.

verses.text: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
verses.translation: Is it, then, that your Lord has chosen you people to have sons, and has Himself opted for females from among the angels? Surely, you are uttering a serious statement.

verses.text: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion.
verses.translation: Surely, We have explained things in various ways in this Qur’ān, so that they may pay heed to the advice; but it increases nothing in them except aversion.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."
verses.translation: Say, “Had there been other gods along with Him”, as they say, “then they would have found out a way to the Lord of the Throne”.

verses.text: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
verses.translation: Pure is He, and Exalted, immensely above what they say.

verses.text: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [ Allah ] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
verses.translation: All the seven skies and the earth and all those therein extol His purity. And there is not a single thing that does not extol His purity along with His praise, but you do not understand their extolling. Surely He is Forbearing, Most-Forgiving.

verses.text: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.
verses.translation: When you recite the Qur’ān, We place an invisible curtain between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter,

verses.text: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn back in aversion.
verses.translation: and We put covers on their hearts barring them from understanding it, and (We put) deafness in their ears; and when you refer to your Lord alone (without referring to their presumed deities,) in the Qur’ān, they turn their backs in aversion.

verses.text: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
verses.translation: We are fully aware of the reason for which they listen, when they listen to you, and when they are in secret consultation: when the transgressors say, “You are following none but a bewitched man.”

verses.text: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
verses.translation: See how they have made (silly) statements about you; so they have gone astray and cannot find a way.

verses.text: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
verses.translation: And they say, “Once we are reduced to bones and dust, is it then that we will be raised, created anew?”

verses.text: Say, "Be you stones or iron
verses.translation: Say, “Be you stones or iron

verses.text: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
verses.translation: or any creation you deem harder in your hearts.” Thereupon they will ask, “Who will bring us back?” Say, “The One who created you for the first time.” So, they will shake their heads before you and say, “When shall that be?” Say, “May be, it is near.”

verses.text: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
verses.translation: (It will be) on a day when He will call you, and you will respond praising Him, and you will think you did not stay (on the earth) but for a short while.

verses.text: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
verses.translation: Tell My servants that they should speak that which is best. Surely, Satan creates discord among them. Indeed, Satan is an open enemy to mankind.

verses.text: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a manager.
verses.translation: Your Lord knows you best. If He so wills, He will have mercy on you, and if He so wills, He will punish you, and We did not send you (O Prophet,) to become responsible for them.

verses.text: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
verses.translation: Your Lord knows best about all those in the heavens and the earth, and We have certainly granted excellence to some prophets over some others, and We gave Dawūd the Zabūr (the Psalms).

verses.text: Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
verses.translation: Say, “Call those whom you assume (to be gods), besides Him, while they have no power to remove distress from you, nor to change it.”

verses.text: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
verses.translation: Those whom they invoke, do themselves seek the means of access to their Lord as to which of them becomes the closest, and they hope for His Mercy and fear His punishment. The punishment of your Lord is really something to be feared.

verses.text: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.
verses.translation: There is no town but We are to destroy it before the Doomsday, or punish it with severe punishment. That is what stands written in the Book.

verses.text: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
verses.translation: Nothing made us refrain from sending the signs (demanded by the pagans,) except that the earlier people had rejected them. (For example,) We gave Thamūd the she-camel, as an eye-opener, then they did wrong to her, and We do not send signs but as a warning.

verses.text: And [remember, O Muhammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur'an. And We threaten them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
verses.translation: (Remember) when We said to you that your Lord encompasses all humans. And We did not make the vision We showed to you, but a test for the people - and the tree cursed in the Qur’ān as well. And We warn them, yet it adds nothing to them but enormous rebellion.

verses.text: And [mention] when We said to the angles, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"
verses.translation: (Remember) when We said to the angels, “Prostrate yourself before ’Ādam.” So, they all prostrated, except Iblīs (Satan). He said, “Shall I prostrate before the one You have created from mud?”

verses.text: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."
verses.translation: He (Iblīs) added, “Tell me, this one whom You have honored more than me, if You give me respite till the Doomsday, I will subdue his progeny, except a few of them.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of you - an ample recompense.
verses.translation: He (Allah) said, “Go then, for whoever of them follows you, the Hell shall be the recompense of you all, a full recompense.

verses.text: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
verses.translation: Entice with your voice those of them whom you can, and rally against them your horsemen and your footmen, and share with them in their wealth and their children, and make promises to them” - and Satan promises them nothing but delusion -

verses.text: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
verses.translation: “As for My servants, you have no control over them, and your Lord is enough to look after (everything).”

verses.text: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
verses.translation: Your Lord is the One who causes ships to sail for you through the sea, so that you may go in quest of His bounty; surely, He is Ever-Merciful for you.

verses.text: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.
verses.translation: you face a hardship at sea, vanished are those whom you used to invoke, except Him (Allah). Then, once He brings you safe to the land, you turn away (from Him); man is so ungrateful.

verses.text: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
verses.translation: Do you, then, feel secure from that He makes a part of the land sink down along with you, or that He sends down a rain of stones on you, whereupon you will find no one to protect you?

verses.text: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into the sea another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.
verses.translation: Or, do you feel secure from that He takes you back to it (the sea) once again, and sends a heavy storm of wind upon you which drowns you because of your disbelief, and then you will find no one to help?

verses.text: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
verses.translation: And We bestowed dignity on the children of ’Ādam and provided them with rides on the land and in the sea, and provided them with a variety of good things and made them much superior to many of those whom We have created.

verses.text: [Mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
verses.translation: (Think of) the Day when We will call every people with their books of deeds. Then the ones who will be given their book in their right hands will read their book (happily) and will not be wronged even to the measure of a fine thread.

verses.text: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
verses.translation: But whoever is (too) blind in this (world to see the right path) will be (too) blind in the Hereafter (to reach the salvation), and much more astray from the path.

verses.text: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
verses.translation: (O Prophet,) Surely, they were about to lure you away from what We have revealed to you, so that you forge something else against Us, and in that case they would have certainly made you a bosom friend.

verses.text: And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
verses.translation: Had We not made you firm, it was likely that you would have inclined towards them a little bit.

verses.text: Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper.
verses.translation: In that case, We would have surely made you taste a double (punishment) in life and a double (punishment) after death, then you would not have found anyone to help you against Us.

verses.text: And indeed, they were about to drive you from the land to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.
verses.translation: And they were likely to harass you in the land, so that they could expel you from there, and in that case, they will have not lived (there) after you, but a little.

verses.text: [That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.
verses.translation: Such has been Our way with the messengers We sent before you. And you will find no change in Our way.

verses.text: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur'an of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
verses.translation: (O Prophet,) establish Salāh between the decline of the sun and the darkness of the night, and (establish) the recital at dawn. Surely, the recital at dawn is well attended.

verses.text: And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
verses.translation: And during the night, wake up for Salāh of tahajjud , an additional prayer for you. It is very likely that your Lord will place you at Praised Station.

verses.text: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
verses.translation: And say, “O my Lord, make me enter a rightful entrance and make me exit a rightful exit, and grant me from Your Own a power, favored (by You).”

verses.text: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
verses.translation: And say, “Truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Falsehood is surely bound to vanish.”

verses.text: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
verses.translation: We reveal the Qur’ān, which is cure and mercy for the believers; and it adds nothing to the unjust but loss.

verses.text: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
verses.translation: When We bestow Our favor upon man, he avoids (to recognize it) and keeps himself far aside (from obedience), and when some evil touches him, he is in total despair.

verses.text: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
verses.translation: Say, “Everyone acts in his own style. So, your Lord knows best which one is better guided in his way.”

verses.text: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little."
verses.translation: And they ask you about the soul. Say, “The soul is something from the command of my Lord, and you are not given from the knowledge but a little.”

verses.text: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
verses.translation: And if We so will, We will surely take away what We have revealed to you, then you shall find no one to rely upon against Us in this matter.

verses.text: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
verses.translation: But it is a mercy from your Lord. Great is indeed His favor upon you.

verses.text: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
verses.translation: Say, “If all the humans and jinns join together to produce anything like this Qur’ān, they will not (be able to) come up with anything like it, even if they assist one another.

verses.text: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind] of example, but most of the people refused [anything] except disbelief.
verses.translation: Indeed We explained every subject in this Qur’ān in various ways for the benefit of mankind. Still, most of the people refused to do anything but reject.

verses.text: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring.
verses.translation: They said, “We shall never believe in you unless you cause a spring to gush forth for us from the earth.

verses.text: Or [until] you have a garden of palm tress and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
verses.translation: Or you have a garden of date palms and grapes, then you bring forth rivers from their midst in abundance.

verses.text: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before [us]
verses.translation: Or you cause the sky to fall upon us in pieces, as you claimed, or you bring Allah and angels before us face to face.

verses.text: Or you have a house of gold or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
verses.translation: Or you have a house made of gold. Or you ascend to the sky, and we will not believe in your ascension unless you send down to us a book we may read.” Say, “I proclaim the Purity of my Lord. I am nothing but human, a messenger.”

verses.text: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger?"
verses.translation: Nothing prevented people from believing, when guidance came to them, except that they said, “Has Allah sent a man as a messenger?”

verses.text: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
verses.translation: Say, “Had there been angels (living) on the earth, walking about in peace, We would have certainly sent down an angel from the heavens as a messenger.”

verses.text: Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing."
verses.translation: Say, “Allah is sufficient as witness between me and you. Surely, He is All-Aware, All-Watchful to His servants.”

verses.text: And whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire.
verses.translation: The one whom Allah guides is the guided one; and those whom He lets go astray, you will never find for them any helpers other than Him. And We shall gather them on the Day of Judgment, with their faces down-blind, dumb and deaf. Their abode is the Fire. Whenever it calms down, We increase its flames for them.

verses.text: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
verses.translation: That is their punishment, because they rejected Our signs and said, “Is it that once we are reduced to bones and dust, is it then that we shall be raised, created anew?”

verses.text: Do they not see that Allah , who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief.
verses.translation: Have they not seen that Allah who has created the heavens and the earth has the power to create them as they were? He has appointed a time for them in which there is no doubt. Still, the wrongdoers refused to do anything but reject.

verses.text: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
verses.translation: Say, “If you were to own the treasures of my Lord’s blessing, you would certainly hold them back, lest it should be spent. Man is so niggardly.”

verses.text: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
verses.translation: Surely we gave Mūsā nine clear signs. So, ask the children of Isrā’īl, when he came to them, Pharaoh said to him, “I am afraid, O Mūsā, you are under the spell of magic.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “You know well that these (signs) are sent down by none but by the Lord of the heavens and the earth as eye-openers. And, I am afraid O Pharaoh, you are going to be destroyed.”

verses.text: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
verses.translation: Then he (Pharaoh) tried to harass them to drive them out of the land, so We drowned him and those with him altogether,

verses.text: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
verses.translation: and thereafter We said to the children of Isrā’īl, “Live in the land. So, when the appointed time of the Hereafter will come, We shall bring you all joined together.”

verses.text: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
verses.translation: With truth We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down and with truth it descended, and We did not send you but as a bearer of good tidings and as a warner.

verses.text: And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
verses.translation: We have divided the Qur’ān in portions, so that you may recite it to the people gradually, and We have revealed it little by little.

verses.text: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe. Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
verses.translation: Say, “Believe in it or do not believe in it; when it is recited to those who were given knowledge before it, they fall down on their faces in prostration

verses.text: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
verses.translation: and say, “Pure is our Lord. Certainly, the word of our Lord was sure to be fulfilled.”

verses.text: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and the Qur'an increases them in humble submission.
verses.translation: They fall down on their faces weeping, and it increases humbleness in their hearts.

verses.text: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
verses.translation: Say, “Call (Him by the name of) Allah or Ar-RaHmān, in whichever way you call, His are the Best Names.” Do not be (too) loud in your Salāh, nor be (too) low in it, and seek a way in between.

verses.text: And say, "Praise to Allah , who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
verses.translation: Say, “Praise belongs to Allah who has neither had a son, nor is there any partner to Him in His kingdom, nor is anyone (needed) to protect Him from (any) weakness. And proclaim His greatness, an open proclamation.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: [All] praise is [due] to Allah , who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
verses.translation: Praise belongs to Allah who has sent down the Book to His servant, and allowed no crookedness in it,

verses.text: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward
verses.translation: a straightforward Book to warn of a severe punishment from Him, and to give the good news to the believers, who do righteous deeds, that they will have an excellent reward (Paradise)

verses.text: In which they will remain forever
verses.translation: in which they will dwell for ever,

verses.text: And to warn those who say, " Allah has taken a son."
verses.translation: and to warn those who have said that Allah has had a son,

verses.text: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.
verses.translation: while they have no knowledge about it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths. They say nothing but lie.

verses.text: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
verses.translation: So, (O Prophet) perhaps you are going to kill yourself after them, out of grief, if they do not believe in this discourse.

verses.text: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
verses.translation: Surely, We have made what is on earth an adornment for it, so that We test them as to who among them is better in deeds.

verses.text: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
verses.translation: And surely, We are going to turn whatever is thereon into a barren land.

verses.text: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?
verses.translation: Do you think that the People of Kahf (the Cave) and Raqīm (inscription) were unusual out of Our signs?

verses.text: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."
verses.translation: When the young men took refuge in the Cave and said, “Our Lord, bless us with mercy from Your own and provide us with guidance in our matters.”

verses.text: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
verses.translation: So, We sealed up their hearing (putting them to sleep) in the Cave for a number of years.

verses.text: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.
verses.translation: Thereafter We raised them up, so that We know which of the two groups had better calculated the period in which they remained (sleeping).

verses.text: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.
verses.translation: We narrate to you their story with truth. They were young men who believed in their Lord and We gave them more guidance.

verses.text: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.
verses.translation: We made their hearts firm when they stood up and said, “Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We shall never invoke any god other than Him, otherwise we would be saying something far from the truth.

verses.text: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie?"
verses.translation: These, our people, have adopted gods other than Him. Why do they not bring a clear proof in their favor? So, who is more unjust than the one who fabricates a lie against Allah?

verses.text: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah , retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."
verses.translation: When you have turned away from them, and those whom they worship, except Allah, then seek refuge in the cave, and your Lord will extend His mercy for you, and provide you ease in your matters.”

verses.text: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah . He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.
verses.translation: You would see the sun, when it rose, turning away from their Cave towards the right; and when it set, it bypassed them towards the left, and they were (lying) in the hollow thereof. That is one of the signs of Allah.Whomsoever Allah guides is the one who gets the right path and whomsoever He lets go astray, for him you will find no one to help, no one to lead.

verses.text: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
verses.translation: And you would think they were awake while they were asleep. We turned them on their sides, right and left. And their dog had its forelegs stretched out to the doorstep. If you had a look at them, you would have fled away from them and would have been filled with awe of them.

verses.text: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.
verses.translation: In this way We raised them up until they asked each other. One of them said, “How long did you tarry?” They said, “A day, or part of a day.” They said, “Your Lord knows best how long you tarried.” So, send one of you with this silver (coin) of yours to the city and let him look around which of the eatables are the purest and let him bring you some food from there. And he must act in polite manner, and must not let anyone know about you.

verses.text: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."
verses.translation: If they (the habitants of the city) will know about you, they will force you to revert to their faith, and in that case, you will never find success.”

verses.text: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."
verses.translation: And in this way, We made them known to the people (of the city), so that they realize that Allah’s promise is true, and that there is no doubt about the Hour (the Day of Resurrection). When they were disputing among themselves in their matter, they said, “Erect a building over them. Their Lord knows them best.” Said those who prevailed in their matter, “We will certainly make a mosque over them.”

verses.text: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone."
verses.translation: Some will say, “(They were) three, the fourth of them being their dog,” and some will say, “Five, the sixth of them being their dog, just making conjectures.” And others will say, “Seven, the eighth of them is their dog.” Say, “My Lord knows best about their number.” No one knows them except a few, so do not argue about them except an apparent argumentation. And do not ask anyone of these about them.

verses.text: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,"
verses.translation: And never say about anything, “I will do this tomorrow,”

verses.text: Except [when adding], "If Allah wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."
verses.translation: unless (you say - ‘if) Allah wills.’ And remember your Lord if you forget, and say (to those who asked you about the story of the People of the Cave), “May be, my Lord will lead me to something closer than this to guidance.”

verses.text: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.
verses.translation: They stayed in their Cave for three hundred years and added nine.

verses.text: Say, " Allah is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone."
verses.translation: Say, “Allah knows best how long they stayed. To Him belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth - how well He sees and how well He hears! They have no supporter other than Him and He lets no one share His authority.”

verses.text: And recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.
verses.translation: And recite what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no one to change His words, and you will never find a refuge beside Him.

verses.text: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His countenance. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.
verses.translation: Keep yourself content with those who call their Lord morning and evening, seeking His pleasure, and let not your eyes overlook them, seeking the splendor of the worldly life. And do not obey the one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, and who has followed his desire and whose behavior has exceeded the limits.

verses.text: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.
verses.translation: And say, “The truth is from your Lord. Now, whoever so wills may believe and whoever so wills may deny.” Surely, We have prepared for the unjust a fire, whose tent will envelop them. And if they will beg for help, they shall be helped with water like oily dregs that will scald the faces. Vile is the drink, and evil is the Fire as a resting-place.

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds,-of course, We do not waste the reward of those who are good in deeds.

verses.text: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.
verses.translation: Those are the ones for whom there are eternal gardens, rivers flowing beneath them. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and they will be dressed in green garments, made of fine silk and thick silk, reclining therein on couches. Excellent is the reward and beautiful is the Paradise as a resting-place.

verses.text: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.
verses.translation: Give them an example. There were two men; We gave one of them two gardens of grapes, and surrounded both of them with date-palms, and placed vegetation between them.

verses.text: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.
verses.translation: Both the gardens brought forth their fruit, and suppressed nothing from it, and We caused a stream to flow through them.

verses.text: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men."
verses.translation: And he had wealth. So, he said to his companion while conversing with him, “I am greater than you in wealth and stronger in manpower.”

verses.text: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever.
verses.translation: And he entered his garden while he was doing wrong to himself. He said, “I do not think that this will ever perish,

verses.text: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."
verses.translation: and I do not think that the Hour (Day of Judgment) has to come. And even if I am sent back to my Lord, I will surely find a better place than this to resort to.”

verses.text: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?
verses.translation: Said his companion, as he was conversing with him, “Do you deny Him who created you from dust, then from a drop (of semen), then He made you a perfect man?

verses.text: But as for me, He is Allah , my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.
verses.translation: As for me, I believe that Allah is my Lord, and I do not associate anyone with my Lord.

verses.text: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah '? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,
verses.translation: Why, when you entered your garden, did you not say, ‘(Everything is) as Allah wills. There is no power except with Allah’? If you see me inferior to you in wealth and children,

verses.text: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a calamity from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,
verses.translation: then, it is likely that my Lord will give me (what is) better than your garden, and will send to it a punishment from the heavens, and it will become a barren land.

verses.text: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."
verses.translation: Or, its water will sink deep in the earth, so that you will never be able to search it out.”

verses.text: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."
verses.translation: And its produce was overwhelmed by calamities and he stood wringing his hands (in anguish) over what he had invested in it, while it was fallen down on its trellises and he was saying, “I wish I had not ascribed any partner to my Lord!”

verses.text: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah , nor could he defend himself.
verses.translation: There were no supporters for him beside Allah, who could come to his help, nor was he able to defend himself.

verses.text: There the authority is [completely] for Allah , the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
verses.translation: That is where the power of protection rests with Allah, the True God. He is the best in rewarding and best in requiting.

verses.text: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: Give them the example of the worldly life; it is like water We sent down from the sky, then the vegetation of the earth was mingled with it, and then it turned into chaff that is blown by the winds, and Allah is powerful over everything.

verses.text: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
verses.translation: Wealth and children are the embellishment of the worldly life, and the everlasting virtues are better with your Lord, both in rewards and in creating good hopes

verses.text: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth prominent, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
verses.translation: And (visualize) the Day when We will make mountains move, and you will see the earth fully exposed, and We shall gather them together, so as not to leave a single one of them.

verses.text: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment."
verses.translation: And they shall be presented lined-up before your Lord. (It will be said to them,) “Lo! You have come to Us just as We had created you for the first time, while you claimed that We would not make any appointed time for you.”

verses.text: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.
verses.translation: And the book (of deeds) will be placed (before them), then you will see the guilty people scared of its contents and saying, “Woe to us! What a book is this! It has missed nothing, minor or major, but has taken it into account.” Thus they will find whatever they did present before them, and your Lord will not wrong anyone.

verses.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.
verses.translation: (Recall) when We said to the angels, “Prostrate yourselves before ’Ādam.” So, they prostrated themselves, all of them but Iblīs (Satan). He was of the Jinn, so he rebelled against the command of your Lord. Do you still take him and his progeny as friends instead of Me, while they are enemy to you? Evil is he as substitute (of obedience to Allah) for wrongdoers.

verses.text: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.
verses.translation: I did not make them witnesses of the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor of their own creation. I was not such that I should take the misleaders as helpers.

verses.text: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call 'My partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.
verses.translation: (Recall) the Day when He will say, “Call My ‘partners’ whom you claimed as such.” So, they will call them, but they will not respond to them, and We will put a destructive barrier between them.

verses.text: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
verses.translation: And the sinners will see the Fire; so they will know that they will have to fall into it, and they will find no way to bypass it.

verses.text: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur'an for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.
verses.translation: Indeed We have explained in this Qur’ān every subject in various ways for the benefit of the people, but out of all creation, man is most disputing.

verses.text: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
verses.translation: The only thing that prevented people from believing, even after the guidance had come to them, and from seeking forgiveness from their Lord, is (their demand) that what used to come to the earlier people should come to them as well, or that the punishment should visit them face to face.

verses.text: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.
verses.translation: We send the messengers only as bearers of good tidings and warnings, and those who disbelieve raise disputes on the basis of the false (arguments), so that they may nullify the truth with it; and they have taken My signs, and the warnings given to them, as mockery.

verses.text: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.
verses.translation: Who is more unjust than the one who was reminded through the signs of his Lord, but he turned away from them, and forgot what his own hands sent ahead. Indeed We have put covers on their hearts that bar them from understanding it, and (We have created) deafness in their ears. And if you call them to guidance, even then they will never adopt the right path.

verses.text: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
verses.translation: Your Lord is the Most Forgiving, the Lord of Mercy. If He seizes them for what they did, He may cause the punishment to befall them sooner, but there is an appointed time for them, from which they can never find a place of refuge.

verses.text: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.
verses.translation: These are the towns that We destroyed when they (i.e. their people) transgressed, and We had appointed a time for their destruction.

verses.text: And [mention] when Moses said to his servant, "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."
verses.translation: (Recall) when Mūsā said to his young man, “I shall not give up until I reach the meeting point of the two seas, or else I shall go on traveling for years.”

verses.text: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.
verses.translation: So, when they reached the meeting point of the two seas, they forgot their fish, and it made its way into the sea as in a tunnel.

verses.text: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."
verses.translation: When they went further, he said to his young man, “Bring us our morning meal; we have, indeed, had much fatigue from this journey of ours.”

verses.text: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly".
verses.translation: He said, “You see, when we stayed at the rock, I forgot the fish. It was none but Satan who made me forget it to tell you about it - and it made its way into the sea in an amazing manner.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
verses.translation: He said, “That was what we were looking for.” So they returned, retracing their footsteps.

verses.text: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.
verses.translation: Then they found one of Our servants whom We blessed with mercy from Us and whom We gave knowledge, a knowledge from Our own.

verses.text: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"
verses.translation: Mūsā said to him, “May I have your company so that you teach me some of the rightful knowledge you have been given.”

verses.text: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.
verses.translation: He said, “You can never bear with me patiently.

verses.text: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"
verses.translation: And how would you keep patient over something your comprehension cannot grasp?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “You will find me patient, if Allah wills, and I shall not disobey any order from you.”

verses.text: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention."
verses.translation: He said, “Well, if you follow me, do not ask me about anything unless I myself start telling you about it.”

verses.text: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
verses.translation: So, they both moved ahead, until when they boarded a boat, he sliced it (by removing one of its planks). He (Mūsā) said, “Did you slice it to drown its people? In fact, you have done a terrible act.”

verses.text: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
verses.translation: He said, “Did I not say that you can never bear with me patiently?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “Do not hold me punishable for what I forgot, and do not make my course too difficult for me.”

verses.text: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
verses.translation: So, they moved ahead until when they met a boy, he killed him (the boy). He (Mūsā) said, “Did you kill an innocent soul while he did not kill anyone? You have committed a heinous act indeed.”

verses.text: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
verses.translation: He said, “Did I not tell you that you can never bear with me patiently?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “If I ask you about something after this, do not allow me your company. You have now reached a point where you have a valid excuse (to part with me) from my own side. “

verses.text: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
verses.translation: Then, they moved ahead until they came to the people of a town; they asked its people for food, and they refused to host them. Then, they found there a wall tending to fall down. So he (KhaDir) set it right. He (Mūsā) said, “If you wished, you could have charged a fee for this.”

verses.text: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
verses.translation: He said, “Here is the point of parting ways between me and you. I shall now explain to you the reality of things about which you could not remain patient.

verses.text: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
verses.translation: As for the boat, it belonged to some poor people who worked at sea. So I wanted to make it defective, as there was a king across them who used to usurp every boat by force.

verses.text: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
verses.translation: As for the boy, his parents were believers. We apprehended that he would impose rebellion and infidelity upon them.

verses.text: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
verses.translation: We, therefore, wished that their Lord would replace him with someone better than him in piety, and more akin to affection.

verses.text: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
verses.translation: As for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was a treasure beneath it belonging to them, and their father was a pious man. So your Lord willed that they should reach their maturity and dig out their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do it on my own accord. This is the reality of things about which you could not remain patient.”

verses.text: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
verses.translation: They ask you about Dhul-Qarnain. Say, “I shall now recite to you an account of him.”

verses.text: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.
verses.translation: Surely, We gave him power on earth and gave him means to (have) everything (he needs).

verses.text: So he followed a way
verses.translation: So he followed a course,

verses.text: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
verses.translation: until when he reached the point of sunset, he found it setting into a miry spring, and found a people near it. We said, “O Dhul-Qarnain, either punish them or adopt good behavior with them.”

verses.text: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.
verses.translation: He said, “As for him who does wrong, we shall punish him, then he will be sent back to his Lord, and He will punish him with a severe punishment.

verses.text: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."
verses.translation: As for the one who believes and acts righteously, he will have the best (life) as reward, and we shall speak to him politely in our directions.”

verses.text: Then he followed a way
verses.translation: Thereafter, he followed a course,

verses.text: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
verses.translation: until when he reached the point of sunrise, he found it rising over a people for whom We did not make any shelter against it.

verses.text: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
verses.translation: Thus it was, and Our knowledge fully comprehends whatever (wealth and equipment) he had with him.

verses.text: Then he followed a way
verses.translation: Thereafter he followed a course

verses.text: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
verses.translation: until when he reached between the two mountains, he found by them a people who were almost unable to understand anything said.

verses.text: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
verses.translation: They said, “O Dhul-Qarnain, the (tribes of) Ya’jūj and Ma’jūj (Gog and Magog) are mischief-makers on the earth. So, should we assign a tax for you on condition that you make a barrier between us and them?”

verses.text: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.
verses.translation: He said, “What my Lord has (already) given in my control is better enough (for me than the tax you are offering to me), so help me (only) with some (man) power, and I shall make a rampart between you and them.

verses.text: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
verses.translation: Bring me big pieces of iron.” (They proceeded accordingly) until when he leveled up (the gap) between the two cliffs, he said, “Blow.” (They complied) until when he made it (like) fire, he said, “Bring me molten copper, and I will pour it upon this.”

verses.text: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
verses.translation: So they (Ya’jūj and Ma’jūj) were not able to climb it, nor were they able to make a hole in it.

verses.text: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
verses.translation: He said, “This is a mercy from my Lord. Then, when the promise of my Lord will come, He will make it leveled to the ground. The promise of my Lord is true.”

verses.text: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
verses.translation: And on that day, (i.e. the Doomsday) We will leave them (all the people including Ya’jūj and Ma’jūj) surging over one another. And the Horn shall be blown, then We shall gather them together.

verses.text: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display -
verses.translation: And on that day We will bring Jahannam fully exposed before the infidels

verses.text: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
verses.translation: whose eyes were under a cover against My reminders, and they were not able to listen.

verses.text: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
verses.translation: Do, then, the disbelievers deem (it fit) that they take My servants as patrons beside Me? Surely, We have prepared Jahannam as entertainment for the disbelievers.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
verses.translation: Say, “Shall We tell you about the greatest losers in respect of (their) deeds?

verses.text: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
verses.translation: Those are the ones whose effort in the worldly life has gone in vain, while they think they are doing well.

verses.text: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.
verses.translation: Those are the ones who rejected the signs of their Lord and (the concept of) meeting with Him, so their deeds have gone to waste, and We shall assign to them no weight at all.

verses.text: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
verses.translation: That is their punishment, the Jahannam , for they disbelieved and made My signs and My messengers a mockery.

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
verses.translation: Surely those who believed and did righteous deeds, theirs are the Gardens of Firdaus as entertainment

verses.text: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
verses.translation: where they will live forever, and will not wish to move from there.”

verses.text: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."
verses.translation: Say, “If the ocean were to be ink for (writing) the Words of my Lord, the ocean would have been consumed before the Words of my Lord are exhausted, even though we were to bring another (ocean) like it in addition.”

verses.text: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
verses.translation: Say, “Surely, I am but a human being like you; it is revealed to me that your God is the One God. So the one who hopes to meet his Lord must do righteous deed and must not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.
verses.translation: Kāf, Hā Yā, ‘Ain, Sād

verses.text: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
verses.translation: This is a narration of your Lord’s mercy to His servant Zakariyyā,

verses.text: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
verses.translation: When he called his Lord in a low voice.

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, I am in a state that bones in my body have turned feeble, and the head has flared up grey with old age, and I never remained, My Lord, unanswered in my prayer to You.

verses.text: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
verses.translation: I fear (my) kinsmen after me, and my wife is barren, so bless me with an heir, from Your own side,

verses.text: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
verses.translation: who inherits me and inherits the house of Ya‘qūb. And make him, My Lord, a favourite one.”

verses.text: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
verses.translation: (Allah said) “O Zakariyyā, We give you the good news of a boy whose name is YaHyā. We did not create any one before him of the same name.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
verses.translation: He Said, “My Lord, how shall there be a boy for me while my wife is barren, and I have reached the extreme of old age?”

verses.text: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "
verses.translation: He said, “So it is; your Lord said ‘it is easy for Me, and I did create you before, when you were nothing.’”

verses.text: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, make for me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not (be able to) speak to the people for three (consecutive) nights, even though you will be sound in health.”

verses.text: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [ Allah ] in the morning and afternoon.
verses.translation: Then he came out to his people from the place of prayer, and directed them by gestures to proclaim the purity of Allah at morning and evening.

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
verses.translation: (When the child was born, Allah said to him,) “O YaHyā, hold on to the Book firmly.” And We gave him wisdom, while he was still a child,

verses.text: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
verses.translation: and (blessed him with) love from our own, and purity; and he was God-fearing,

verses.text: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
verses.translation: and he was good to his parents; and he was not oppressive (or) disobedient.

verses.text: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
verses.translation: Peace on him the day he was born, the day he dies and the day he will be raised alive.

verses.text: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book (the story of) Maryam, when she secluded herself from her people to a place towards East,

verses.text: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
verses.translation: then she used a barrier to hide herself from them. Then, We sent to her Our Spirit, (Jibra’īl) and he took before her the form of a perfect human being.

verses.text: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah ."
verses.translation: She said, “I seek refuge with the All-Merciful (Allah) against you, if you are God-fearing.”

verses.text: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
verses.translation: He said, “I am but a message-bearer of your Lord (sent) to give you a boy, purified.”

verses.text: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
verses.translation: She said, “How shall I have a boy while no human has ever touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?”

verses.text: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
verses.translation: He said, “So it is; your Lord said, ‘It is easy for Me, and (We will do this) so that We make it a sign for people and a mercy from Us, and this is a matter already destined.’”

verses.text: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
verses.translation: So she conceived him, and went in seclusion with him to a remote place.

verses.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
verses.translation: Then the labour pains brought her to the trunk of a palm-tree. She said “O that I would have died before this, and would have been something gone, forgotten.”

verses.text: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
verses.translation: Then he called her from beneath her: “Do not grieve; your Lord has placed a stream beneath you.

verses.text: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
verses.translation: Shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards yourself and, it will drop upon you ripe fresh dates.

verses.text: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
verses.translation: So eat, drink and cool your eyes. Then if you see any human being, say (to him), “I have vowed a fast (of silence) for the All-Merciful (Allah,) and therefore, I shall never speak to any human today.”

verses.text: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
verses.translation: Then she came to her people carrying him (the baby). They said, “O Maryam you have committed something grave indeed.

verses.text: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
verses.translation: O sister of Hārūn, neither your father was a man of evil nor was your mother unchaste.”

verses.text: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
verses.translation: So, she pointed towards him (the baby). They said, “How shall we speak to someone who is still a child in the cradle?”

verses.text: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah . He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
verses.translation: Spoke he (the baby), “Verily I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Book, and made me a prophet,

verses.text: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
verses.translation: and He has made me a blessed one wherever I be, and has enjoined Salāh and Zakāh upon me as long as I am alive,

verses.text: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
verses.translation: and (He has made me) good to my mother, and he did not make me oppressive (or) ill-fated.

verses.text: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
verses.translation: And peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I shall die, and the day I shall be raised alive again.”

verses.text: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
verses.translation: That is ‘Īsā, the son of Maryam, to say the truth in which they (Christians) are disputing.

verses.text: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.translation: It is not for Allah to have a son. Pure is He. When He decides a thing, He simply says to it, “Be” and it comes to be.

verses.text: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
verses.translation: And (O Prophet, say to the people,) “Allah is surely my Lord and your Lord. So, worship Him. This is the straight path.”

verses.text: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
verses.translation: Then the groups among them fell in dispute. So, how evil is the fate of the disbelievers when they have to face the Great Day.

verses.text: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
verses.translation: How strong will their hearing be, and how strong their vision, the day they will come to Us! But today the transgressors are straying in clear error.

verses.text: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
verses.translation: Warn them of The Day of Remorse when the whole thing will be settled, while they are heedless and do not believe.

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
verses.translation: Surely We, only We, shall be the ultimate owner of the earth and all those on it, and to Us they will be returned.

verses.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book (the story of) Ibrāhīm. Indeed, he was Siddīq (a man of truth), a prophet,

verses.text: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
verses.translation: when he said to his father, “My dear father, why do you worship something that does neither hear nor see, nor help you in any way?

verses.text: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
verses.translation: My dear father, indeed there has come to me a knowledge that has not come to you; so, follow me, and I shall lead you to a straight path.

verses.text: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
verses.translation: My dear father, do not worship the Satan. The Satan is surely rebellious to the All-Merciful, (Allah).

verses.text: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
verses.translation: My dear father, I fear lest a punishment from the All- Merciful (Allah) should afflict you, and you become a companion of Satan.”

verses.text: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
verses.translation: He said, “Are you averse to my gods O Ibrāhīm? Should you not stop, I will definitely stone you. And leave me for good.”

verses.text: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
verses.translation: He said, “Peace on you. I shall seek forgiveness for you from my Lord. He has always been gracious to me.

verses.text: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
