verses.translation: And I go away from you and what you invoke besides Allah. And I shall invoke my Lord. Hopefully I shall not be a loser by invoking my Lord.”

verses.text: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah , We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
verses.translation: So, when he went away from them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We blessed him with IsHāq (Isaac) and Ya‘qūb (Jacob) and We made each one of them a prophet,

verses.text: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
verses.translation: and We bestowed on them (a great deal) of our mercy, and caused them to have a good name at a high level.

verses.text: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book (the story of) Mūsā. Indeed he was a chosen one and was a messenger, a prophet.

verses.text: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
verses.translation: And We called him from the right side of the mount Tūr (Sinai), and We brought him close to communicate in secret.

verses.text: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
verses.translation: And, out of Our mercy, We granted him his brother Hārūn as a prophet.

verses.text: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book (the story of) Ismā‘īl. He was indeed true to his promise, and was a messenger, a prophet.

verses.text: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
verses.translation: He used to enjoin Salāh and Zakāh upon his family, and was favourite to his Lord.

verses.text: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book (the story of) Idrīs. He was indeed a Siddīq (man of truth), a prophet.

verses.text: And We raised him to a high station.
verses.translation: We raised him to a high place.

verses.text: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
verses.translation: Those are the people whom Allah has blessed with bounties, the prophets from the progeny of ’Ādam, and of those whom We caused to board (the Ark) along with NūH, and from the progeny of Ibrāhīm and Isrā’īl (Jacob), and from those whom We guided and selected. When the verses of The RaHmān (The All-Merciful) were recited before them, they used to fall down in Sajdah (prostration), while they were weeping.

verses.text: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
verses.translation: Then came after them the successors who neglected Salāh and followed (their selfish) desires. So they will soon face (the outcome of their) deviation,

verses.text: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
verses.translation: except those who repent and believe and do good deeds, and therefore they will enter the Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

verses.text: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
verses.translation: (They will enter) the Gardens of eternity, promised by the All-Merciful (Allah) to His servants, in the unseen world. They will surely reach (the places of) His promise.

verses.text: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
verses.translation: They will not hear anything absurd therein, but a word of peace, and there they will have their provision at morn and eve.

verses.text: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah .
verses.translation: That is the Paradise We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who have been God-fearing.

verses.text: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
verses.translation: (Jibra’īl X said to the Holy Prophet) “We do not descend but with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is in front of us and what is behind us and what is in between; and your Lord is not the One who forgets.

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
verses.translation: (He is) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them. So, worship Him and persevere in His worship. Do you know any one worthy of His name?”

verses.text: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
verses.translation: Man says, “Is it that, once I die, I shall be brought forth alive?”

verses.text: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
verses.translation: Does not the man remember that We created him before, when he was nothing?

verses.text: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
verses.translation: So, by your Lord, We will definitely gather them together, and the devils as well; then We will definitely make them present around the Jahannam , fallen on their knees.

verses.text: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
verses.translation: Then, out of every group, We will certainly draw out those who were more rebellious against the All-Merciful (Allah).

verses.text: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
verses.translation: Then of course, We are most aware of those who are more deserving to enter it (the Jahannam ).

verses.text: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
verses.translation: There is none among you who does not have to arrive at it. This is undertaken by your Lord as an absolute decree, bound to be enforced.

verses.text: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
verses.translation: Then We will save those who feared Allah, and will leave the wrongdoers in it, fallen on their knees.

verses.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two groups is superior in its place and better in its assembly?”

verses.text: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
verses.translation: How many a generation We have destroyed before them who were better in assets and outlook!

verses.text: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
verses.translation: Say, “Whoever stays straying, let his term be extended by the All-Merciful (Allah) still longer, until when they will see what they are being warned of: either the punishment or the Hour (of Doom), then they will know who was worse in his place and weaker in his forces.

verses.text: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
verses.translation: Allah makes those on the right path excel in guidance. And the everlasting virtues are better with your Lord in respect of reward and better in their return.

verses.text: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
verses.translation: Have you, then, seen him who rejected Our verses and said, “I shall certainly be given wealth and children”?

verses.text: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
verses.translation: Has he peeped into the Unseen or taken a covenant with the All-Merciful (Allah)?

verses.text: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
verses.translation: Never! We will write what he says and extend for him the punishment extensively.

verses.text: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
verses.translation: And We will inherit from him what he is talking about, and he will come to Us all alone.

verses.text: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
verses.translation: They have taken gods other than Allah, so that they may be a source of might for them.

verses.text: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
verses.translation: Never! They (their fabricated deities) will soon reject their having worshipped them, and they will be just the opposite for them.

verses.text: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
verses.translation: Have you not seen that We have sent the devils onto the disbelievers inciting them with all their incitements.

verses.text: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
verses.translation: So make no hurry about them; We are but counting for them a count down.

verses.text: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
verses.translation: The day We will assemble the God-fearing before the All-Merciful (Allah) as guests,

verses.text: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
verses.translation: and will drive the sinners towards the Jahannam as herds of cattle (are driven) towards water,

verses.text: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
verses.translation: none will have power to intercede, except the one who has entered into a covenant with the All-Merciful (Allah).

verses.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
verses.translation: They say, “The All-Merciful (Allah) has got a son.”

verses.text: You have done an atrocious thing.
verses.translation: Indeed you have come up with such an abominable statement

verses.text: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
verses.translation: that the heavens are well-nigh to explode at it, and the earth to burst apart, and the mountains to fall down crumbling,

verses.text: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
verses.translation: for they have ascribed a son to the All-Merciful (Allah),

verses.text: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
verses.translation: while it does not behove the All-Merciful to have a son.

verses.text: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
verses.translation: There is none in the heavens and the earth, but bound to come to the All-Merciful as a slave.

verses.text: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
verses.translation: He has fully encompassed them and precisely calculated their numbers,

verses.text: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
verses.translation: and each one of them is bound to come to Him on the Day of Judgment, all alone.

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
verses.translation: Surely, those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them the All-Merciful (Allah) will create love.

verses.text: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
verses.translation: So We have made it (the Qur’ān) easy through your tongue, so that you give with it the good news to the God-fearing, and warn with it an obstinate people.

verses.text: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
verses.translation: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them! Do you sense (the presence of) any one of them, or hear from them even a whisper?

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ta, Ha.
verses.translation: Tā-Hā

verses.text: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
verses.translation: We did not reveal the Qur’ān to you to (make you) face hardship

verses.text: But only as a reminder for those who fear [ Allah ] -
verses.translation: rather to remind him who has the fear (of Allah),

verses.text: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
verses.translation: it being a revelation from the One Who created the earth, and high heavens.

verses.text: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
verses.translation: The RaHmān (Allah, the All-Merciful) has positioned Himself on the Throne.

verses.text: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
verses.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens, all that is in the earth and whatever lies between them and whatever lies beneath the soil.

verses.text: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
verses.translation: If you pronounce the word aloud, then (it makes no difference, for) He certainly knows the secret and what is even more hidden.

verses.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
verses.translation: (Such is) Allah. There is no god but He. For Him are the Beautiful Names.

verses.text: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of Mūsā?

verses.text: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
verses.translation: When he saw a fire and said to his family, “Stay here. I have noticed a fire. Perhaps I can bring you an ember from it, or find some guidance by the fire.”

verses.text: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
verses.translation: So when he came to it, he was called, “O Mūsā,

verses.text: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
verses.translation: it is Me, your Lord, so remove your shoes; you are in the sacred valley of Tuwā.

verses.text: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
verses.translation: I have chosen you (for prophet-hood), so listen to what is revealed:

verses.text: Indeed, I am Allah . There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
verses.translation: Surely, I AM ALLAH. There is no god but Myself, so worship Me, and establish Salāh for My remembrance.

verses.text: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
verses.translation: Surely, the Hour (i.e. the Day of Judgment) has to come. I would keep it secret, so that everyone is given a return for the effort one makes.

verses.text: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
verses.translation: So the one who does not believe in it and follows his desires must not make you neglectful of it, otherwise you will perish.

verses.text: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
verses.translation: And what is that in your right hand, O Mūsā?”

verses.text: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
verses.translation: He said, “It is my staff. I lean on it, and I beat down leaves with it for my sheep, and I have many other uses for it.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
verses.translation: He said, “Throw it down O Mūsā”.

verses.text: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
verses.translation: So, he threw it down, and suddenly it was a snake, running around.

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
verses.translation: He said, “Pick it up, and be not scared. We shall restore it to its former state.

verses.text: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
verses.translation: And press your hand under your arm, and it will come out (brightly) white without any disease, as another sign,

verses.text: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
verses.translation: so that We may show you some of Our great signs.

verses.text: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh. He has really exceeded all bounds.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, put my heart at peace for me,

verses.text: And ease for me my task
verses.translation: and make my task easy for me

verses.text: And untie the knot from my tongue
verses.translation: and remove the knot from my tongue,

verses.text: That they may understand my speech.
verses.translation: so that they may understand my speech.

verses.text: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
verses.translation: And make for me an assistant from my own family,

verses.text: Aaron, my brother.
verses.translation: that is, Hārūn, my brother.

verses.text: Increase through him my strength
verses.translation: Enhance with him my strength,

verses.text: And let him share my task
verses.translation: and make him share my task,

verses.text: That we may exalt You much
verses.translation: so that we proclaim Your purity in abundance

verses.text: And remember You much.
verses.translation: and remember You in abundance.

verses.text: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
verses.translation: You are certainly watchful over us.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
verses.translation: He said, “You have been granted your request O Mūsā.

verses.text: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
verses.translation: And We had bestowed Our favour on you another time,

verses.text: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
verses.translation: when We revealed to your mother what was to be revealed,

verses.text: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
verses.translation: that is, ‘Put him (the baby) in the chest, then cast it into the river, then let the river throw it by the shore, and it will be picked up by one who is enemy to Me and enemy to him.’ And I had cast love on you from Myself (so that you might be favourite of all), and that you might be brought up under My eye.

verses.text: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
verses.translation: (Remember) when your sister was going (to the family of Pharaoh) and was saying, ‘Shall I lead you to one who nurses him?’ Thus We brought you back to your mother, so that her eyes might have comfort and she might not grieve. And you had killed a person, then We brought you out of the trouble; and We tested you with a great ordeal. Then you lived a number of years amidst the people of Madyan. After all this, you came O Mūsā, to a destined point of time.

verses.text: And I produced you for Myself.
verses.translation: I have fashioned you for Myself.

verses.text: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
verses.translation: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and do not be slack in My remembrance.

verses.text: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
verses.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh; he has indeed transgressed all limits.

verses.text: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [ Allah ]."
verses.translation: So speak to him in soft words. May be, he accepts the advice or fears (Allah)”.

verses.text: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
verses.translation: They said, “Our Lord, we fear that he will hasten against us, or will become (more) rebellious (against You).”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
verses.translation: He said, “Do not be afraid. I AM surely with you both. I hear and I see.

verses.text: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
verses.translation: So, come to him and say, ‘We are the messengers of your Lord. So, let the children of Isrā’īl go with us, and do not persecute them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord; and peace be upon the one who follows the guidance.

verses.text: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "
verses.translation: Verily, it has been revealed to us that the punishment is for the one who denies and turns away.’”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
verses.translation: He (Pharaoh) said, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Mūsā?”

verses.text: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “Our Lord is the One who gave everything its due shape, then guided it.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
verses.translation: He said, “Then, what is the status of the earlier generations?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
verses.translation: He replied, “The knowledge about those is with my Lord in a Book. My Lord does neither err nor forget.”

verses.text: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
verses.translation: (He is) the One who made the earth a cradle for you, and made in it pathways for you to move, and sent down water from the heavens; and We brought forth with it pairs of different vegetations :

verses.text: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
verses.translation: Eat, and graze your cattle. Surely, in that there are signs for the people of understanding.

verses.text: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
verses.translation: From this (dust) We created you, and in this we shall put you back, and from this We shall raise you up once again.

verses.text: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
verses.translation: And We showed him (Pharaoh) all Our signs, yet he rejected and refused.

verses.text: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
verses.translation: Said he, “Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your sorcery, O Mūsā?

verses.text: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
verses.translation: We will, then, bring to you a similar sorcery. So, make an appointment between you and us for an even place, not to be backed out, neither by us nor by you.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “Your appointment is the festival day, and the people should be assembled at forenoon.”

verses.text: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
verses.translation: So, Pharaoh turned back, and put his plot together, then came.

verses.text: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
verses.translation: Mūsā said to them, “Pity on you, do not fabricate a lie against Allah, lest He should destroy you with a punishment. And loser is he who fabricates a lie.”

verses.text: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
verses.translation: Then, they disputed among themselves in their matter, and kept their talk secret.

verses.text: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
verses.translation: Said they, “Certainly, these two are sorcerers who wish to drive you out from your land, and do away with your excellent way of life.

verses.text: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
verses.translation: So, make your plot firm and come forth in one row. Successful today is the one who prevails.”

verses.text: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
verses.translation: They said, “O Mūsā, either you throw (first), or shall we be first to throw?”

verses.text: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
verses.translation: He said, “Rather, you throw.” Then, suddenly their ropes and sticks seemed to him, due to their magic, as if they were running.

verses.text: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
verses.translation: So, Mūsā concealed some fear in his heart.

verses.text: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
verses.translation: We said, “Do not be scared. Certainly, you are to be the upper most.

verses.text: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
verses.translation: And throw what is in your right hand, and it will devour what they have concocted. What they have concocted is but a sleight of a magician. And the magician does not succeed wherever he comes from.”

verses.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
verses.translation: So, the magicians were led (by the truth) to fall in prostration. They said, “We have (now) believed in the Lord of Hārūn and Mūsā.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
verses.translation: He (Pharaoh) said, “You have believed in him before I permit you. This man is in fact your master who has taught you the magic. So I will certainly cut off your hands and your legs from opposite sides, and will crucify you on the trunks of palm-trees, and you shall know whose punishment, out of us, is more severe and more lasting.”

verses.text: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
verses.translation: They said, “We will never prefer you over the clear signs that have come to us, and over Him who has created us. So, decide whatever you have to decide. You will decide only for this worldly life.

verses.text: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."
verses.translation: We have put our faith in our Lord, so that He forgives us for our sins and for the magic you compelled us to perform. And Allah is the Best and Everlasting.”

verses.text: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
verses.translation: Surely whoever comes to his Lord as a sinner, for him there is Jahannam in which he neither will die nor will live (a happy life).

verses.text: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
verses.translation: And whoever will come to Him as believer, having done righteous deeds, for such people there are the highest ranks,

verses.text: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
verses.translation: the eternal gardens beneath which rivers flow, in which they shall live for ever. That is the reward for the one who has purified himself.

verses.text: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
verses.translation: And We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Set out with my servants at night, then make for them a dry path across the sea (with the strike of your staff), neither fearing to be caught up, nor having any fear (of drowning).”

verses.text: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh chased them with his troops. So, they were encircled by that (huge wave) from the sea which overwhelmed them.

verses.text: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
verses.translation: Pharaoh held his people astray, and did not show them the right path.

verses.text: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
verses.translation: O children of Isrā’īl , We delivered you from your enemy and appointed for you the right side of the mount Tūr (Sinai), and sent down for you the Mann and Salwā :

verses.text: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."
verses.translation: Eat from the good things We have provided to you, and do not exceed the limits in it, lest My wrath should descend on you. The one upon whom My wrath descends certainly falls into destruction.

verses.text: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
verses.translation: Surely I am the Most-Forgiving for him who repents and believes and acts righteously, then follows the right path.

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
verses.translation: “What has caused you to hurry before your people, O Mūsā?”

verses.text: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
verses.translation: He said, “Here they are just behind me, and I hurried towards You, my Lord, so that You be pleased.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."
verses.translation: He said, “We have then put your people to test after you (left them) and Sāmiriyy has misguided them.”

verses.text: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
verses.translation: So, Mūsā went back to his people, angry and sad. He said, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Did then the time become too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord befalls you, and hence you broke your promise to me?”

verses.text: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."
verses.translation: They said, “We did not break our promise to you of our own accord, but we were burdened with loads from the ornaments of the people;so we threw them, and thus did Sāmiriyy cast.”

verses.text: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
verses.translation: Then he brought forth for them a calf, which was (merely) a body with a lowing sound. Then they said, “This is your god and the god of Mūsā, and he (Mūsā) erred.”

verses.text: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
verses.translation: Have they not been seeing that it did not respond to them (even) with a word, nor did it have power to harm or benefit them?

verses.text: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
verses.translation: Hārūn had already said to them, “O my people, you have only been led astray with it, and your Lord is the RaHmān (All-Merciful). So follow me and obey my command.”

verses.text: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."
verses.translation: They said, “We will never cease to stay with it in devotion, until Mūsā returns to us.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “O Hārūn, what did prevent you from following me when you saw them going astray?

verses.text: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
verses.translation: Did you then disobey my command?”

verses.text: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "
verses.translation: He said, “O son of my mother, do not hold me by my beard, nor by my head. I feared that you would say, ‘You have caused discord among the children of Isrā’īl and did not observe my advice.’”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “What then is your case, O Sāmiriyy?”

verses.text: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
verses.translation: He said, “I perceived something they did not perceive. So I picked up a handful from under the footstep of the messenger. Then, I cast it. And thus my inner self tempted me.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “Then go away; it is destined for you that, throughout your life, you will say: ‘Do not touch me’. And, of course, you have another promise that will not be broken for you. And look at your god to which you stayed devoted. We will certainly burn it, then we will scatter it thoroughly in the sea.

verses.text: Your god is only Allah , except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
verses.translation: Your God is Allah other than whom there is no god. He encompasses everything with knowledge.”

verses.text: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.
verses.translation: This is how We narrate to you certain events of what has passed, and We have given to you, from Ourself, a (book of) advice.

verses.text: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
verses.translation: Whoever turns away from it shall certainly bear a heavy burden on Doomsday,

verses.text: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
verses.translation: all such people living under it forever. And how evil for them will be that burden on the Doomsday!

verses.text: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
verses.translation: The Day when the Horn (Sūr) will be blown, and We shall gather them together while they will have turned blue on that day,

verses.text: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
verses.translation: and will be whispering among themselves, “You did not remain (in graves) more than ten (days)”.

verses.text: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."
verses.translation: We know very well what they say, when the best of them in his ways will say, “You did not remain more than one day.”

verses.text: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
verses.translation: They ask you about the mountains. So, say (to them), “My Lord will crush them into dust thoroughly,

verses.text: And He will leave the earth a level plain;
verses.translation: then will turn them into a leveled plain

verses.text: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
verses.translation: in which you will see neither a curve nor an uneven place.”

verses.text: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
verses.translation: That day they will follow the caller who will find no deviation (from anyone). And the voices will turn low in awe for the RaHmān (All-Merciful, Allah). So, you will hear not but whispering.

verses.text: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
verses.translation: That day no intercession will be of any use to anyone, except the one whom the RaHmān (All-Merciful, Allah) has permitted and was pleased with his word.

verses.text: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.
verses.translation: He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them, and they do not encompass Him in (their) knowledge.

verses.text: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
verses.translation: All faces will be humbled before (Allah,) the Ever-Alive, the All-Sustaining; and the loser will be the one who bears (the burden of his) injustice.

verses.text: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
verses.translation: But whoever does righteous deeds, while he is a believer, shall fear neither injustice nor curtailment (of his rewards).

verses.text: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
verses.translation: And in this way We have sent it down to you as an Arabic Qur’ān, and have detailed in it some warnings in various ways, so that they may fear, or it may produce a lesson for them.

verses.text: So high [above all] is Allah , the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
verses.translation: So High above all is Allah, the True King! And do not hasten with (reciting) the Qur’ān before its revelation to you is concluded, and say, “My Lord, improve me in knowledge.”

verses.text: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
verses.translation: We had given a directive to ’Ādam earlier, then he forgot, and We did not find in him a firm resolve.

verses.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
verses.translation: When We said to the angels, “Prostrate yourselves to ’Ādam”. So, all of them fell prostrate, except Iblīs , who refused.

verses.text: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
verses.translation: So, We said “’Ādam, this is an enemy to you and to your wife. So let him not expel you from Paradise, lest you should get into trouble.

verses.text: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
verses.translation: Here you have the privilege that you will not be hungry nor will you be unclad,

verses.text: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
verses.translation: and you will not be thirsty, nor will you be exposed to sun.”

verses.text: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
verses.translation: Then the Satan instigated him. He said, “’Ādam, shall I guide you to the tree of eternity and to an empire that does not decay?”

verses.text: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
verses.translation: So, both of them Ādam and Hawwā’ (Eve)] ate from it, and their parts of shame were exposed to them, and they started stitching on themselves some of the leaves of Paradise. And ’Ādam disobeyed his Lord, and erred.

verses.text: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
verses.translation: Thereafter his Lord chose him. So He accepted his repentance and gave (him) guidance.

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
verses.translation: He said (to ’Ādam and Iblīs), “Go down from here, all of you, some of you enemies of some others. Then, should some guidance come to you from Me, the one who follows My guidance shall not go astray, nor shall he be in trouble.

verses.text: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
verses.translation: As for the one who turns away from My message, he shall have a straitened life, and We shall raise him blind on the Day of Judgment.”

verses.text: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
verses.translation: He will say, “My Lord, why did you raise me blind while I was sighted?”

verses.text: [ Allah ] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
verses.translation: He will say, “In the similar manner as Our signs came to you, and you had ignored them. In the same way you will be ignored today.”

verses.text: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
verses.translation: Thus We recompense him who exceeds the limits and does not believe in the signs of his Lord. Certainly the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting.

verses.text: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
verses.translation: Did it give them no guidance (to realize) how many generations We have destroyed prior to them in whose dwellings they (often) walk around? Surely, in this there are signs for the men of reason.

verses.text: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
verses.translation: But for a word from your Lord that had passed earlier, and an appointed time that had been fixed, it (the punishment) would have been inevitable (for them).

verses.text: So be patient over what they say and exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
verses.translation: So, (O messenger,) endure with patience what they say, and proclaim the purity and praise of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And in some hours of night, proclaim His purity, and at points of the day as well, so that you may be pleased.

verses.text: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
verses.translation: Never stretch your eyes towards the things We have given to some groups of them to enjoy, so that We put them to test thereby, it being merely glamour of the worldly life. And the bounty of your Lord is much better and more lasting.

verses.text: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
verses.translation: Bid your family to perform Salāh, and adhere to it yourself. We ask no provision from you. We give provision to you. And the ultimate end is in favour of Taqwā (God-fearing, and piety).

verses.text: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
verses.translation: They say, “Why does he not bring to us a sign from his Lord?” Has there not come to them the clear sign of what is contained in the earlier Scriptures?

verses.text: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
verses.translation: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before it, they would have said, “Our Lord, why did you not send a messenger to us, so that we might have followed Your signs before we were humiliated and put to disgrace?”

verses.text: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
verses.translation: Say, “Everyone is waiting. So wait, then you will know who the people of the straight path are and who has followed the right guidance.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
verses.translation: The reckoning of the people has drawn near to them, while they are in negligence, turning away (from its signs).

verses.text: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
verses.translation: No fresh message of advice comes to them from their Lord, but they listen to it as if they were playing,

verses.text: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
verses.translation: their hearts paying no heed. And the wrongdoers whisper in secret, “This one is nothing but a mortal like you. Would you then go along with sorcery while you can see (the reality)?”

verses.text: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
verses.translation: He (the prophet) said, “My Lord knows all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”

verses.text: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
verses.translation: Further they said, “(The Qur’ān is) a mixture of jumble dreams. Rather, he (the prophet) has fabricated it. Rather, he is a poet. So, let him bring a sign to us, as the earlier ones were sent with.”

verses.text: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
verses.translation: Not a single town from those whom We destroyed came to believe before them. So, will they believe?

verses.text: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
verses.translation: And We did not send before you messengers except men whom We inspired with revelation. So, ask the people (having the knowledge) of the Message, if you do not know.

verses.text: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
verses.translation: We did not make them such bodies as ate no food, nor were they immortal.

verses.text: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
verses.translation: Then We caused the promise to come true for them, so We saved them and those whom We willed, and destroyed the transgressors.

verses.text: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
verses.translation: Surely, We have sent down to you (O people of Arabia) a book having a good counsel for you. So, do you not understand?

verses.text: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
verses.translation: How many a town, that were unjust, have We crushed and raised up after them another people!

verses.text: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
verses.translation: So, as soon as they sensed Our punishment (approaching them), they started fleeing from it.

verses.text: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
verses.translation: (It was said to them,) “Do not flee, and go back to the luxuries you were made to enjoy, and to your dwellings. May be you are asked questions.”

verses.text: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
verses.translation: They said, “Alas for us! We were wrongdoers indeed.”

verses.text: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
verses.translation: Then, this continued to be their cry till We turned them into stubble, totally extinguished.

verses.text: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what lies between them for play.

verses.text: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
verses.translation: Had We intended to have a pastime, We would have had it from Our own, if We were ever to do so.

verses.text: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
verses.translation: Instead, We launch the truth against falsehood, which gets it smashed, and in no time it is gone. Alas to you for what you describe!

verses.text: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
verses.translation: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those who are near to Him are not arrogant against His worship, nor are they sluggish.

verses.text: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
verses.translation: They proclaim His purity night and day, never slackening.

verses.text: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
verses.translation: Or have they adopted gods from the earth, who raise the dead?

verses.text: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah , they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah , Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.translation: Had there been gods beside Allah, in the heavens and the earth, both of them would have fallen in disorder. So pure is Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from what they describe.

verses.text: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
verses.translation: He is not questioned of what He does, and they are questioned.

verses.text: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
verses.translation: Is it that they have adopted gods besides Him? Say, “Bring your proof.” Here is the (book carrying) advice for those with me, and the (books carrying) advice for those before me. Yet most of them do not know the truth, and therefore they are averse.

verses.text: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
verses.translation: We did not send before you any messenger but We revealed to him that there is no god but I, so worship Me.”

verses.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
verses.translation: They said, “The RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah) has taken children for Himself.” Pure is He (from having children). They are but (His) honored servants.

verses.text: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
verses.translation: They do not precede Him in speech, and only under His command they act.

verses.text: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
verses.translation: He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them, and they make recommendation for none but for whom He likes, and in awe of Him they are fearful.

verses.text: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: Should any one of them say, “I am god besides Him”, We will recompense him with Jahannam (Hell). This is how We recompense the transgressors.

verses.text: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
verses.translation: Did the disbelievers not observe that the heavens and the earth were closed, then We opened them? And We created from water every living thing. Would they still not believe?

verses.text: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
verses.translation: And We created mountains on the earth, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein paths and ways, so that they are guided.

verses.text: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
verses.translation: We made the sky a protected roof; and they are averse to its signs.

verses.text: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
verses.translation: He is the One who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each floating in an orbit.

verses.text: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
verses.translation: We did not assign immortality to any human (even) before you. So, if you die, will they live for ever?

verses.text: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
verses.translation: Every one has to taste death, and We test you through bad and good (situations) with a trial, and to Us you are to be returned.

verses.text: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
verses.translation: When disbelievers see you, they do nothing but take you in jest (saying to one another,) “Is this the one who talks of your gods?” - while they themselves reject even talking of the RaHmān (All-Merciful).

verses.text: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.
verses.translation: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My signs, so do not seek haste from Me.

verses.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.translation: They say, “When will this promise be (fulfilled), if you are true?”

verses.text: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
verses.translation: Only if the disbelievers were to know the time when they will not (be able to) keep off the fire from their faces or from their backs, nor will they be helped.

verses.text: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
verses.translation: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and will baffle them. So they will not be able to turn it back, nor will they be given respite.

verses.text: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: In fact, messengers have been mocked at prior to you. So those who laughed at them were besieged by what they used to ridicule.

verses.text: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
verses.translation: Say, “Who will guard you, during night and day, against the RaHmān (All-Merciful, Allah)?” Rather, to the remembrance of their Lord they are averse.

verses.text: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
verses.translation: Or do they have gods who protect them besides Us? They are not able to help even themselves, nor will they have anyone to side with them against Us.

verses.text: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
verses.translation: But We have given benefits to these and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. So do they not see that We are coming to the land narrowing it down from all its sides? Then, are they the ones to prevail?

verses.text: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
verses.translation: Say, “I warn you only by revelation, but the deaf do not listen to the call when they are warned.”

verses.text: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
verses.translation: If a whiff of your Lord’s torment were to touch them, they would certainly say, “Alas to us! We were wrongdoers indeed.”

verses.text: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
verses.translation: We shall place scales to do justice on the Day of Judgment. So no one shall be wronged in the least. Even if it (a deed) is to the measure of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth, and We are enough to take account.

verses.text: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
verses.translation: And We gave Mūsā and Hārūn the Criterion, and a light and an advice for the God-fearing,

verses.text: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
verses.translation: - those who have awe of their Lord without having seen Him, and are fearful of the Hour (of Judgment).

verses.text: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
verses.translation: And this is a blessed advice We have sent down. Are you still rejecting it?

verses.text: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
verses.translation: Even earlier We had given Ibrāhīm his right course, and We knew him well

verses.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
verses.translation: when he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues you are devoted to?”

verses.text: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
verses.translation: They said, “We found our fathers worshipping them,”

verses.text: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
verses.translation: He said, “Surely you and your fathers have been in open error.”

verses.text: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
verses.translation: They said, “Did you come to us with truth or are you one of the triflers?”

verses.text: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
verses.translation: He said, “No, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who has created them, and I am one of those who bear witness to it.

verses.text: And [I swear] by Allah , I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
verses.translation: And I swear by Allah that I will devise something against your idols after you have gone away turning your backs.”

verses.text: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
verses.translation: Then, he turned all of them into pieces, except the big one of them, so that they may come back to it.

verses.text: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
verses.translation: They said, “Who has done this to our gods? He is one of the wrongdoers indeed.”

verses.text: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
verses.translation: Some of them said, “We have heard a youth talking about them. He is called Ibrāhīm.”

verses.text: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
verses.translation: They said, “Then, bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may see”.

verses.text: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
verses.translation: They said, “Is it you O Ibrāhīm who has done this to our gods?”

verses.text: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
verses.translation: He said, “Rather, this is done by this chief of theirs. So, ask them if they can speak.”

verses.text: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
verses.translation: So they turned to one another and said, “In fact, you yourselves are the wrongdoers.”

verses.text: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
verses.translation: Then, hanging their heads they reversed their position (and replied to Ibrāhīm,) “You already knew that they do not speak.”

verses.text: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
verses.translation: He said, “Do you then worship, beside Allah, what does neither benefit you in the least nor harm you?

verses.text: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah . Then will you not use reason?"
verses.translation: Fie upon you and upon what you worship other than Allah. Do you then not understand?”

verses.text: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
verses.translation: They said, “(O people) burn him and help your gods, if you are to take action.”

verses.text: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
verses.translation: We said, “O fire, be cold and safe for Ibrāhīm.”

verses.text: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
verses.translation: And they intended to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

verses.text: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.
verses.translation: And We rescued him and LūT towards the land we blessed for all the worlds.

verses.text: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
verses.translation: And We blessed him with IsHāq and Ya‘qūb as gift, and each one of them We made righteous.

verses.text: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.
verses.translation: And We made them the Imams who guided (people) under Our command, and We inspired them to do good deeds and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh, and Us alone they worshipped.

verses.text: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: As for LūT, We gave him wisdom and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town that used to do dirty deeds. Indeed, they were the people of evil, the sinners.

verses.text: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
verses.translation: And We admitted him to Our mercy. Indeed, He was of the righteous.

verses.text: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah ] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.
verses.translation: And (remember) NūH, when he called (for help) earlier, so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the terrible agony,

verses.text: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
verses.translation: and helped him against the people who gave the lie to Our verses. Indeed, they were the people of evil, therefore, We drowned them all.

verses.text: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
verses.translation: And (remember) Dawūd (David) and Sulaimān (Solomon), when they were adjudicating about the tillage in which the goats of other people wandered at night (and trampled it), and We were witness to their judgment.

verses.text: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
verses.translation: So, We enabled Sulaimān to understand it. And to each one of them We gave wisdom and knowledge. And with Dawūd We subjugated the mountains that pronounced tasbīH (Allah’s purity), and the birds as well. And We were the One who did (it).

verses.text: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
verses.translation: We taught him the skill of making armor as dress for you to protect you from what may harm you (in combat). So are you grateful?

verses.text: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
verses.translation: And for Sulaimān, (We subjugated) the violent wind that blew under his command to the land in which We placed Our blessings. And We were the One who knew everything.

verses.text: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
verses.translation: And from the devils, (We subjugated for him) those who dived in water for him and did jobs other than that. And We were the One who kept watch over them.

verses.text: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
verses.translation: And (remember) Ayyūb (Job), when he called his Lord saying, “Here I am, afflicted by pain and You are the most merciful of all the merciful.”

verses.text: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah ].
verses.translation: So, We answered his prayer and removed whatever pain he had, and gave him (back) his family and the like thereof along with them, as a mercy from Our own Self and as a lesson for the worshippers.

verses.text: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
verses.translation: And (remember) Ismā‘īl and Idrīs and Dhul-Kifl. Each one of them was of those who observed patience.

verses.text: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
verses.translation: And We admitted them to Our mercy. Surely, they were of the righteous.

verses.text: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
verses.translation: And (remember) Dhunnūn (the man of the fish, namely Yūnus X), when he walked away in anger and thought that We would never put him to trouble. Then, he called (Us) in depths of darkness saying, “There is no god but You. Pure are You. Indeed I was among the wrongdoers”.

verses.text: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
verses.translation: So We responded to him and rescued him from the distress. And this is how We rescue the believers.

verses.text: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."
verses.translation: And (remember) Zakariyyā when he called his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me alone and You are the best of inheritors.”

verses.text: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
verses.translation: So, We responded to him and gave him YaHyā and made his wife good for him. They used to race towards the good deeds and call Us with hope and fear; and they were humble to Us.

verses.text: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
verses.translation: And (remember) her who protected her private part (that is, Maryam). So, We blew in her (a life) through Our Spirit, and made her and her son (‘Īsā X) a sign for all the worlds.

verses.text: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
verses.translation: Surely, this is the fraternity of your Faith, a single Faith, and I am your Lord; so worship Me.

verses.text: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.
verses.translation: But they have separated their ways from one another. All of them have to return to Us.

verses.text: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.
verses.translation: So, whoever does righteous deeds, while he is a believer, his effort will not be rejected, and We are to put it on record.

verses.text: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
verses.translation: It is banned for (the people of) a town that We destroyed that they come back

verses.text: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
verses.translation: until when the Ya’jūj and Ma’jūj (Gog and Magog) are released, while they run down from every height,

verses.text: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
verses.translation: and the True Promise draws near, then it will so happen that the eyes of the disbelievers shall remain upraised (in terror, and they will say,) “Alas to us! We were in negligence about this; rather we were transgressors.”

verses.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
verses.translation: Surely, you and whatever you worship other than Allah are the fuel of Jahannam.. There you will have to arrive.

verses.text: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
verses.translation: Had they been gods, they would not have arrived at it, and all of them will remain there forever.

verses.text: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
verses.translation: For them, there will be screams in it and they will not hear.

verses.text: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
verses.translation: As for those for whom the good (news) from Us has come earlier, they will be kept far away from it.

verses.text: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
verses.translation: They will not hear the slightest of its sound, and they will remain forever in what their souls desire.

verses.text: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
verses.translation: They shall not be grieved by the Biggest Panic, and the angels shall receive them (saying), “This is your day that you had been promised”

verses.text: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
verses.translation: - the Day when We roll up the sky like a scroll rolls up the writings. Just as We originated the first creation, so We shall bring it back again - a promise (undertaken to be binding) on Us. We are sure to do it.

verses.text: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
verses.translation: And We have written in Zabūr (Psalms) after the advice that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.

verses.text: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people.
verses.translation: Surely, in this (Qur’ān) there is a message conveyed to a people who worship (Allah).

verses.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
verses.translation: And We have not sent you but as mercy for all the worlds.

verses.text: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
verses.translation: Say, “What is revealed to me is simply that your God is One God. So do you submit?”

verses.text: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
verses.translation: But, if they turn away, then say (to them), “I have warned you all alike, and I do not know whether what you have been warned of is near or far.

verses.text: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
verses.translation: Surely, He knows what is spoken openly and He knows what you conceal.

verses.text: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
verses.translation: And I do not know; perhaps it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a while.”

verses.text: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
verses.translation: He (Our Messenger) said, “My Lord, judge with truth. And Our Lord is the RaHmān (All-Merciful), the One whose help is sought against what you describe.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
verses.translation: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed the quake of the (destined) Hour is something terrible.

verses.text: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe.
