verses.text: But the hypocrites say, "We have believed in Allah and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.
verses.translation: They say, “We have believed in Allah and in the messenger, and have adopted obedience”, then a group from them goes back after all this. Those are no believers.

verses.text: And when they are called to [the words of] Allah and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].
verses.translation: When they are summoned to Allah and His messenger that he (the messenger) may judge between them, in no time a group of them turns averse.

verses.text: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.
verses.translation: And if the right is theirs, they would come to him as (if they are) submissive ones.

verses.text: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allah will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: Is there a malady in their hearts or do they have doubt or do they fear that Allah and His messenger will do injustice to them? Rather they themselves are the unjust.

verses.text: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.
verses.translation: The only reply of the (true) believers, when they are summoned to Allah and His messenger that he (the messenger) may judge between them, is that they say, “We listen and obey.” Such people are the successful.

verses.text: And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger and fears Allah and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.
verses.translation: Whoever obeys Allah and His messenger and has awe of Him and observes Taqwā for His sake, then such people are the victorious.

verses.text: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allah 's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with that which you do."
verses.translation: And they (the hypocrites) swear by Allah on forceful oaths that if you (O prophet) order them, they will certainly leave (their homes for Jihād ). Say, “do not swear, (the reality of your) obedience is known. Indeed Allah is fully aware of what you do.”

verses.text: Say, "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."
verses.translation: Say, “Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if you turn away, then on him (the messenger) lies (the responsibility of) what he is burdened with, and on you lies (the responsibility of) what you are burdened with. And if you obey him, you will get the right path. The duty of the Messenger is no more than to convey the message clearly.”

verses.text: Allah has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: Allah has promised those of you who believe and do good deeds that He will certainly make them (His) vicegerents in the land, as He made those before them, and will certainly establish for them their religion which He has chosen for them, and will certainly give them peace in place of fear in which they were before; (provided that) they worship Me, ascribing no partner to Me. And those who turn infidel after that are the transgressors.

verses.text: And establish prayer and give zakah and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.
verses.translation: Establish Salāh and pay Zakāh and obey the messenger, so that you may be favored with mercy.

verses.text: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allah ] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.
verses.translation: Never think that the disbelievers are (able) to frustrate (Allah’s plan) on the earth. Their abode is the Fire. Indeed it is an evil terminus.

verses.text: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: O you who believe, the slaves owned by you, and those of you who have not reached puberty, must seek your permission (to see you) at three times: before the prayer of Fajr, and when you take off your clothes at noon, and after the prayer of ‘Ishā’. These are three times of privacy for you. There is no harm, neither to you nor to them, after these (three times). They are your frequent visitors, as some of you are (frequent visitors) of the others. This is how Allah explains the verses to you. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.text: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: When the children from among you reach puberty, they must seek permission, as the permission is sought by those before them. This is how Allah explains His verses to you. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.text: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.translation: And those old women who have no hope for marriage, there is no sin on them, if they take off their (extra) clothes while they do not display their adornment. Still, that they refrain (even from this) is better for them. Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

verses.text: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allah , blessed and good. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.
verses.translation: There is no blame on a blind person, nor is there any blame on any lame one, nor is there any blame on a sick person, nor on yourselves in that you eat (something) from your own homes or from the homes of your fathers or the homes of your mothers or the homes of your brothers or the homes of your sisters or the homes of your paternal uncles, or the homes of your paternal aunts or the homes of your maternal uncles or the homes of your maternal aunts or from the places the keys of which you have under your control, or from (the home of) your friend.There is no sin on you if you eat together or separately. So when you enter homes, greet one another with Salām , a greeting prescribed by Allah, which is blessed, pleasant. This is how Allah explains the verses to you, so that you may understand.

verses.text: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muhammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission for something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allah . Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His messenger and who, when they are with him for a collective matter, do not leave unless they seek his permission. Surely, those who seek your permission are the ones who believe in Allah and His messenger. So, if they seek permission from you for some business of theirs, give permission to whom you wish from among them, and pray to Allah for their forgiveness. Surely, Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allah knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from the Prophet's order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.
verses.translation: Do not take the call of the messenger among you as a call of one of you to another. Allah definitely knows those of you who sneak out hiding themselves under the cover of others. So, those who violate his (messenger’s) order must beware, lest they are visited by a trial or they are visited by a painful punishment.

verses.text: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allah is Knowing of all things.
verses.translation: Remember! To Allah belongs all that is there in the heavens and the earth. He knows the condition in which you are at present; and the Day on which they will be returned to Him, He will tell them what they did. Allah is fully aware of everything.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
verses.translation: Glorious is the One who has revealed the Criterion to His servant, so that he may be a warner to all the worlds,

verses.text: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
verses.translation: the One to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and who did neither have a son, nor is there any partner to him in the Kingdom, and who has created everything and designed it in a perfect measure.

verses.text: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
verses.translation: Yet they have adopted other gods, beside Him, who do not create any thing, as they themselves are created, and they possess no power to cause harm or benefit even to themselves, nor do they have any control over death or life or resurrection.

verses.text: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur'an] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
verses.translation: The disbelievers said, “This is nothing but a lie he (the messenger) has fabricated and some other people have helped him in it.” Thus they came up with sheer injustice and falsehood.

verses.text: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
verses.translation: And they said, “(These are) the tales of the ancients he (the messenger) has caused to be written, and they are read out to him at morn and eve.”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.translation: Say, “It is sent down by the One who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth. Indeed He is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
verses.translation: They said, “What sort of messenger is this who eats food and walks in the markets? Why is it that an angel has not been sent down to him who would have been a warner along with him.

verses.text: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
verses.translation: Or a treasure should have been thrown down to him, or he should have a garden to eat from it?” And the transgressors said (to the believers,) “You are following none but a bewitched man.”

verses.text: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
verses.translation: See how they coined similes for you, so they have gone astray and cannot find a way.

verses.text: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
verses.translation: Glorious is the One who, if He so wills, would give you better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow, and would give you palaces.

verses.text: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
verses.translation: But they have disbelieved the Hour (the Day of Judgment) and for those who disbelieve the Hour, We have prepared a flaming fire.

verses.text: When the Hellfire sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
verses.translation: When it will see them from a distant place, they will hear (the sounds of) its raging and breathing,

verses.text: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
verses.translation: and when they will be thrown into a narrow place therein, while they will be chained together, they will call for death.

verses.text: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
verses.translation: (Then it will be said to them,) “Do not call for one death today, but call for many a death.”

verses.text: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
verses.translation: Say, “Is that better or the eternal paradise the God-fearing are promised?” It will be a reward for them and a final abode.

verses.text: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
verses.translation: For them there will be whatever they wish, while they will be eternal. This is a promise undertaken by your Lord, (the fulfillment of) which is worth praying for.

verses.text: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
verses.translation: (Remember) the Day when He will gather them and what they used to worship beside Allah and will say (to the latter ones), “Did you mislead these My servants, or did they themselves lose the way?”

verses.text: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
verses.translation: They will say, “Pure are You. It was not for us to adopt other guardians than You. Instead, You gave them and their fathers (worldly) benefits till they forgot the advice, and became a ruined people.”

verses.text: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
verses.translation: Thus they will refute you in what you say, and you will not be able to repulse (the punishment,) or to receive help. Whoever commits injustice from among you, We will make him taste a painful punishment.

verses.text: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
verses.translation: We did not send any messengers before you (O prophet,) but all of them used to eat food and walk in the markets. And We have made some of you a test for some others. Would you observe patience? And your Lord is Ever-seeing.

verses.text: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
verses.translation: Said those who do not even expect to meet Us, “Why the angels are not sent down to us or why do we not see our Lord?” Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and have gone too far in rebellion.

verses.text: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
verses.translation: The Day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the sinners that day, and they will say, “(We need) a shelter, fully protected!”

verses.text: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
verses.translation: And We will proceed to whatever deeds they did, and will turn them into scattered dust.

verses.text: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
verses.translation: The people of Paradise, on that day, will be the best in (terms of their) abode and best in (terms of their) resting-place.

verses.text: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
verses.translation: The Day the sky will break open with a cloud, and the angels will be sent down in a majestic descent,

verses.text: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
verses.translation: the Kingdom on that day will be for the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah), and it will be a difficult day for the disbelievers.

verses.text: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
verses.translation: And (Be mindful of) the Day the wrongdoer will bite his hands saying, “Would that I had taken a path along with the messenger!

verses.text: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
verses.translation: Woe to me! Would that I had not taken so-and-so for my friend!

verses.text: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
verses.translation: Indeed he led me astray from the advice after it had come to me.” And the Satan is man’s betrayer.

verses.text: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."
verses.translation: And the messenger will say, “O my Lord, my people had taken this Qur’ān as deserted.”

verses.text: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
verses.translation: In a similar way We made for every prophet an enemy from among the sinners, but your Lord suffices as a guide and as a supporter.

verses.text: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
verses.translation: Said those who disbelieved, “Why has the Qur’ān not been revealed to him all at once?” (It has been sent down) in this way (i.e. in parts) so that We make your heart firm, and We revealed it little by little.

verses.text: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
verses.translation: They bring to you no hypothesis, but We bring to you the correct position and (an answer) better explained.

verses.text: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
verses.translation: Those who will be driven on their faces to Hell - they are the worst in situation and far more astray from the path.

verses.text: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
verses.translation: Surely We gave Mūsā the Book, and appointed his brother Hārūn as a minister with him.

verses.text: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
verses.translation: So we said, “Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs” Then We annihilated them totally.

verses.text: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
verses.translation: As for the people of NūH, when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them and made them an example for mankind, and We have prepared a painful punishment for the transgressors.

verses.text: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
verses.translation: And (We annihilated also the peoples of) ‘Ād and Thamūd and the people of Rass, and many generations in between them.

verses.text: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
verses.translation: To each (of them) We cited examples, and each of them We brought to utter ruin.

verses.text: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
verses.translation: Indeed they (the pagans of Makkah) have passed by the town that was afflicted by an evil rain sent down to it. So, have they not been seeing it? Rather, they do not believe in Resurrection.

verses.text: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
verses.translation: When they see you, they take you only as a laughing stock, (saying) “Is this the man whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

verses.text: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
verses.translation: He would have almost led us astray from our gods, had we not been so firm towards them.” They will know when they will see the punishment, who is farther astray in his way.

verses.text: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
verses.translation: Tell me about the one who has taken his desire as his god, would you then, become a guardian for him?

verses.text: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
verses.translation: Or do you think that most of them listen or understand? They are but like cattle. Rather, they are even farther astray from the (right) way.

verses.text: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
verses.translation: Have you not observed how your Lord stretched out the shadow (of the sun)? If He so willed, He would have made it stand still. Then We made the sun an indicator for it.

verses.text: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
verses.translation: Then We pulled it toward Us in a gradual manner.

verses.text: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
verses.translation: He is the One who has made the night an apparel for you, and the sleep a means of rest, and has made the day a means of revival.

verses.text: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
verses.translation: And He is the One who has sent the winds conveying good news before His mercy, and We have sent down purifying water from the heavens,

verses.text: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
verses.translation: so that We revive a dead land therewith, and give drink to the many cattle and humans created by Us.

verses.text: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
verses.translation: And We have distributed it (the water) among them, so that they may take lesson. Yet most of the people refused all but ungratefulness.

verses.text: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
verses.translation: Had We so willed, We would have sent a (separate) warner for every town, (but, according to Our wisdom, We have sent Muhammad as a prophet for all these towns)

verses.text: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.
verses.translation: So, (O Prophet,) do not obey the infidels, and strive against them with it (the Qur’ān), in utmost endeavor.

verses.text: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
verses.translation: He is the One who joined the two seas, so as this is sweet, very sweet, and this is bitter, very bitter, and made between them a buffer and an insurmountable barrier.

verses.text: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
verses.translation: And He is the One who created man from water, then made of him relations created by lineage and relations created by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.

verses.text: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
verses.translation: They worship, instead of Allah, what can neither give them any benefit nor can cause them any harm. The disbeliever is always a supporter (of Satan) against his Lord.

verses.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
verses.translation: We did not send you but as a bearer of good news and as a warner.

verses.text: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
verses.translation: Say, “I do not demand from you any return, except that one should adopt the (proper) way to his Lord, if he so wills.

verses.text: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [ Allah ] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
verses.translation: And place your trust in the Ever-Living who cannot die, and proclaim His purity along with His praise. Enough is He to be aware of the sins of His servants,

verses.text: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
verses.translation: the One who created in six days the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them, then He positioned Himself on the Throne. (He is) the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah). So ask about Him someone who knows.

verses.text: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, “Prostrate yourselves to the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah),” they say “What is RaHmān? Shall we prostrate ourselves to the one to whom you direct us?” And it increases nothing in them except aversion.

verses.text: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
verses.translation: Glorious is the One who made stellar formations in the sky, and placed therein a lamp (i.e. the sun) and a bright moon.

verses.text: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
verses.translation: And He is the One who made the day and the night following each other, for the one who wishes to be mindful or wishes to show gratitude.

verses.text: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
verses.translation: The servants of the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah) are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the ignorant people speak to them, they reply peacefully,

verses.text: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
verses.translation: and those who pass the night prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord,

verses.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
verses.translation: and those who say, “Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Jahannam (the Hell); indeed, its punishment is a persisting affliction.”

verses.text: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
verses.translation: Indeed, it is evil as an abode and a place to dwell in

verses.text: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
verses.translation: - and those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor miserly, and it (i.e. their spending) is moderate in between (the two extremes,)

verses.text: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
verses.translation: - and those who do not invoke any other god along with Allah, and do not kill a person whom Allah has given sanctity, except rightfully, nor do they fornicate; and whoever does it, shall face the recompense of his sin,

verses.text: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
verses.translation: the punishment will be doubled for him, and he will remain there disdained, for ever,

verses.text: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: except the one who repents and believes and does good deeds, then Allah will replace the evils of such people by good deeds, and Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
verses.translation: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds turns to Allah truly

verses.text: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
verses.translation: - and those who do not witness falsehood, and when they pass by the absurd things, Pass by them with dignity,

verses.text: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
verses.translation: and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall at them as deaf and blind ones,

verses.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
verses.translation: - and those who say, “Our Lord, Give us, from our spouses and our children, comfort of eyes, and make us heads of the God-fearing.”

verses.text: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
verses.translation: Such people will be rewarded with the high place - because they observed patience - and will be received therein with prayers of their eternal life and peace,

verses.text: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
verses.translation: living in it (the Paradise) for ever. It is best as an abode and as a place to dwell in.

verses.text: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet), “My Lord will never care about you, if you will not invoke Him. Now since you rejected (the truth), the punishment will be inseparable from you.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ta, Seen, Meem.
verses.translation: Tā sīn mīm.

verses.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.
verses.translation: These are the verses of the manifest Book.

verses.text: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
verses.translation: (O Prophet,) perhaps you are going to let yourself collapse in grief because they do not believe.

verses.text: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
verses.translation: If We so will, We can send down to them a sign from the sky, for which their necks will stay bent in submission.

verses.text: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
verses.translation: Never a new message comes to them from the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah), but they become averse to it.

verses.text: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: Thus they rejected (the Truth); well, soon will come to them the real descriptions of what they used to ridicule.

verses.text: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
verses.translation: Have they not looked at the earth, how many of the noble pairs (of vegetation) We have caused to grow in it?

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.text: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
verses.translation: (Remember) when your Lord called Mūsā saying, “Go to the transgressing people,

verses.text: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah ?"
verses.translation: the people of Pharaoh. Do they not fear Allah?”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “My Lord, I fear that they will reject me.

verses.text: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
verses.translation: My heart gets straitened, and my tongue is not fluent; so send for Hārūn.

verses.text: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
verses.translation: Moreover, they have (leveled) a charge of offence against me, and I fear they will kill me;”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
verses.translation: He (Allah) said, “Never! (They will not be able to kill you.) So go, both of you, with Our signs. We are with you, listening (to the conversation you will have with him.)

verses.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
verses.translation: So go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, ‘We both are messengers of the Lord of all the worlds,

verses.text: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
verses.translation: (sent with the message) that you must send the children of Isrā’īl with us’”.

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
verses.translation: He (Pharaoh) said, “Did we not nourish you among us as a child? And you remained amidst us for years,

verses.text: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
verses.translation: and you did the blunder you did; still you are ungrateful.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
verses.translation: He said, “I did that at a time when I was mistaken.

verses.text: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
verses.translation: Then I fled away from you when I feared you. Thereafter my Lord granted wisdom to me, and made me one of the messengers.

verses.text: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
verses.translation: As for the favor with which you are obliging me, it is that you have enslaved the children of Isrā’īl.”

verses.text: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “What is the Lord of the worlds?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever there is between them, if you are to believe”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
verses.translation: He (The Pharaoh) said to those around him, “Are you not hearing?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your early forefathers”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
verses.translation: He (Pharaoh) said, “Your messenger who is sent to you is a mad man indeed.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the East and the West and whatever lies between them, if you are to understand.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
verses.translation: He (Pharaoh) said, “If you adopt a God other than me, I will certainly put you to prison.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
verses.translation: He (Mūsā) said “Will you (do this) even if I bring to you something evident?”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: He said, “Then bring it, if you are truthful.”

verses.text: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
verses.translation: So, he threw down his staff, and in no time it was a serpent, clearly visible,

verses.text: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
verses.translation: and he drew out his hand, and right then it was a white light to the onlookers.

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
verses.translation: He (Pharaoh) said to the chiefs around him “This man is certainly an expert sorcerer”.

verses.text: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
verses.translation: He wants to expel you from your land with his sorcery. So what do you suggest?”

verses.text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
verses.translation: They said, “Leave him and his brother alone for some time, and send heralds to the cities,

verses.text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
verses.translation: so that they bring to you every highly expert sorcerer.”

verses.text: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
verses.translation: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointed time of a known day,

verses.text: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
verses.translation: and it was said to the people, “Would you assemble,

verses.text: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
verses.translation: so that we may follow the sorcerers if they are victorious?”

verses.text: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
verses.translation: So, when the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a sure reward for us, if we are the victorious?”

verses.text: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
verses.translation: He said, “Yes, and of course, you will then be among the closer ones.”

verses.text: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
verses.translation: Mūsā said to them, “Throw you down what you are to throw.”

verses.text: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
verses.translation: So they threw down their ropes and their staffs and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the triumphant for sure.”

verses.text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
verses.translation: Then Mūsā threw down his staff, and in no time it started swallowing the falsehood they invented.

verses.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah ].
verses.translation: So the sorcerers were made (by the truth they saw) to fall down in prostration.

verses.text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
verses.translation: They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

verses.text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
verses.translation: the Lord of Mūsā and Hārūn.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
verses.translation: He (Pharaoh) said, “You have believed in him before I permit you. Surely, he (Mūsā) is the chief of you all, who has taught you sorcery. So you will soon know (your fate). I will cut off your hands and feet from different sides, and will crucify you all together.

verses.text: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
verses.translation: They said, “There is no harm. We will return to our Lord.

verses.text: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
verses.translation: We really hope that our Lord will forgive us our faults, as we are the first of the believers.”

verses.text: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
verses.translation: And We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Make My servants travel at night. You will be pursued.”

verses.text: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
verses.translation: So Pharaoh sent into the cities (his) men to muster (people)

verses.text: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
verses.translation: saying, “These are a small band,

verses.text: And indeed, they are enraging us,
verses.translation: and indeed they are enraging us,

verses.text: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
verses.translation: and we are a host, well-armed.”

verses.text: So We removed them from gardens and springs
verses.translation: Thus We expelled them (i.e. the people of Pharaoh) from gardens and springs,

verses.text: And treasures and honorable station -
verses.translation: and from treasures and a noble abode.

verses.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
verses.translation: Thus it was. And We made the children of Isrā’īl inherit all such things.

verses.text: So they pursued them at sunrise.
verses.translation: So they (the people of Pharaoh) pursued them (the people of Mūsā) at the time of sunrise.

verses.text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
verses.translation: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mūsā said, “Surely we are overtaken.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
verses.translation: He said, “Never! Indeed with me is my Lord. He will guide me.”

verses.text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
verses.translation: So We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Strike the sea with your staff.” So it was severed apart, and each part became like a big mountain.

verses.text: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
verses.translation: Then We brought others close to that place.

verses.text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
verses.translation: And We saved Mūsā and all those with him.

verses.text: Then We drowned the others.
verses.translation: Then we drowned the others.

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
verses.translation: And recite before them the narrative of Ibrāhīm,

verses.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
verses.translation: when he said to his father and to his people, “What do you worship?”

verses.text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
verses.translation: They said, “We worship idols, and stay devoted to them.”

verses.text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
verses.translation: He said, “Do they listen to you when you call (them)

verses.text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
verses.translation: or do they bring benefit to you or harm?”

verses.text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
verses.translation: They said, “No, but we have found our fathers doing like this.”

verses.text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
verses.translation: He said, “Have you then ever considered what you have been worshipping,

verses.text: You and your ancient forefathers?
verses.translation: you and your ancient fathers,

verses.text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
verses.translation: they all are an enemy to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

verses.text: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
verses.translation: who created me, and who guides me,

verses.text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
verses.translation: and Who feeds me and gives me drink,

verses.text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
verses.translation: and when I become sick, He heals me,

verses.text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
verses.translation: and who will make me die, then will give me life,

verses.text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
verses.translation: and who, I hope, will forgive my fault on the Day of Retribution.

verses.text: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
verses.translation: O my Lord, give me wisdom, and make me join the righteous,

verses.text: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
verses.translation: and destine for me a truthful description among the next generations,

verses.text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
verses.translation: and make me among those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,

verses.text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
verses.translation: and forgive my father. Indeed he was one of those who went astray,

verses.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
verses.translation: and do not put me to disgrace on the Day when all will be raised to life,

verses.text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
verses.translation: the Day when neither wealth will be of any use (to any one) nor sons,

verses.text: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
verses.translation: except to him who will come to Allah with a sound heart,

verses.text: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
verses.translation: and the Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing

verses.text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
verses.translation: and the Hell will be fully uncovered for the perverse,

verses.text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
verses.translation: and it will be said to them, ‘Where is that which you used to worship

verses.text: Other than Allah ? Can they help you or help themselves?"
verses.translation: beside Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?’

verses.text: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
verses.translation: So they (their false gods) will be thrown on their faces into it - they and the erring people

verses.text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
verses.translation: and the entire army of Iblīs (Satan), all together.

verses.text: They will say while they dispute therein,
verses.translation: They will say when they will be quarreling there with each other,

verses.text: "By Allah , we were indeed in manifest error
verses.translation: ‘By Allah, we were in open error

verses.text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: when we used to equate you with the Lord of the worlds,

verses.text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
verses.translation: and it is only the sinners who misguided us.

verses.text: So now we have no intercessors
verses.translation: Now we have neither any intercessors

verses.text: And not a devoted friend.
verses.translation: nor any true friend.

verses.text: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
verses.translation: Would that we have a chance to return whereby we may join the believers!’”

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers
verses.translation: The people of NūH rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother NūH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am an honest messenger for you.

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So, fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds;

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me."
verses.translation: so, fear Allah and obey me.”

verses.text: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
verses.translation: They said, “Shall we believe in you while you are followed by the lowest people?”

verses.text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
verses.translation: He said, “I do not know about what they do;

verses.text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
verses.translation: their account is with none but with my Lord, if you have sense.

verses.text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
verses.translation: And I am not the one who would drive the believers away;

verses.text: I am only a clear warner."
verses.translation: I am no more than a plain warner.”

verses.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
verses.translation: They said, “Should you not stop, O NūH, you will surely be stoned.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, my people have rejected me.

verses.text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
verses.translation: So judge between me and them with an open verdict, and save me and all the believers who are with me.”

verses.text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
verses.translation: So We saved him and those with him in the Ark that was fully occupied.

verses.text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
verses.translation: Then We drowned, after that, all the remaining.

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Very-Merciful.

verses.text: 'Aad denied the messengers
verses.translation: The (people of) ‘Ād rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother Hūd said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am an honest messenger for you,

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: so fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
verses.translation: Do you erect on every height a monument, having no sound purpose,

verses.text: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
verses.translation: and take the objects of architecture as if you are going to live forever,

verses.text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
verses.translation: and when you seize (someone) you seize as tyrants?

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
verses.translation: And fear the One who has supported you with what you know.

verses.text: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
verses.translation: He has supported you with cattle and sons,

verses.text: And gardens and springs.
verses.translation: and with gardens and springs.

verses.text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.translation: In fact I fear for you the punishment of a horrible day.”

verses.text: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
verses.translation: They said, “It is all equal for us, whether you give us advice or you do not become one of the advisors.

verses.text: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
verses.translation: This is nothing but the practice of the ancient,

verses.text: And we are not to be punished."
verses.translation: and we are not going to be punished.”

verses.text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Thus they rejected him, so We destroyed them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.text: Thamud denied the messengers
verses.translation: The (people of) Thamūd rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother SāliH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am an honest messenger for you.

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So, fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
verses.translation: Will you be left secure in whatever is here,

verses.text: Within gardens and springs
verses.translation: in gardens and springs,

verses.text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
verses.translation: and in farms and date-palms, the spathes of which are interwoven?

verses.text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
verses.translation: You hew out houses from the hills with pride.

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me,

verses.text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
verses.translation: and do not obey the order of the transgressors

verses.text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
verses.translation: who make mischief on the land and who do not set things right”.

verses.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
verses.translation: They said, “You are merely one of those bewitched.

verses.text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: You are nothing but a human like us. So, bring a sign if you are one of the truthful.”

verses.text: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
verses.translation: He said, “This is a she-camel. She has a share of water, and you have a share of water on a specified day.

verses.text: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.translation: So do not touch her with evil (intent), lest you should be seized by a painful punishment.”

verses.text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
verses.translation: But they killed her, then they became remorseful,

verses.text: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: and the punishment seized them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.text: The people of Lot denied the messengers
verses.translation: The people of LūT rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother LūT said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am an honest messenger for you.

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: Do you approach males among the worlds
verses.translation: Do you go to the males (for having sex) out of the whole universe,

verses.text: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
verses.translation: and leave your wives whom your Lord has created for you? Indeed you are a people who cross (all) limits.”

verses.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
verses.translation: They said, “If you do not stop O LūT, you shall be included among the outcast.”

verses.text: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
verses.translation: He said “Indeed, I am annoyed with your act.

verses.text: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
verses.translation: My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.”

verses.text: So We saved him and his family, all,
verses.translation: So We saved him and his family, all of them

verses.text: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
verses.translation: except an old woman among those who remained behind.

verses.text: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.translation: Then We destroyed the others,

verses.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
verses.translation: and subjected them to a terrible rain. So evil was the rain of those who were warned.

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.text: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
verses.translation: The people of Aaikah rejected the messengers

verses.text: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when Shu‘aib said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am an honest messenger for you.

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: And I do not claim from you any reward for it; my reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
verses.translation: Give full measure, and do not be among those who bring loss to others.

verses.text: And weigh with an even balance.
verses.translation: Weigh with an even balance,

verses.text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
verses.translation: and do not make people short of their things, and do not spread disorder in the land as mischief-makers,

verses.text: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
verses.translation: and be fearful of the One who created you and the former generations.”

verses.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
verses.translation: They said, “You are but one of the bewitched men.

verses.text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
verses.translation: You are no more than a human like us, and in fact we consider you to be one of the liars.

verses.text: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: So cause a piece from the sky to fall down upon us, if you are one of the truthful.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord knows well what you do.”

verses.text: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
verses.translation: Thus they rejected him, so they were seized by the torment of the Day of Canopy. Indeed it was the punishment of a terrible day.

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.text: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: This (Qur’ān) is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
verses.translation: The Trusted Spirit has brought it down

verses.text: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
verses.translation: upon your heart, so that you become one of the warners

verses.text: In a clear Arabic language.
verses.translation: in plain Arabic language.

verses.text: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
verses.translation: And of course, it is (mentioned) in the Scriptures of the former people.

verses.text: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
verses.translation: Is it not a proof for them that the knowledgeable of the children of Isrā’īl recognize him (the prophet)?

verses.text: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
verses.translation: Even if We had revealed it to a Non-Arab,

verses.text: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
verses.translation: and he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.

verses.text: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
verses.translation: This is how We have made it pass through the hearts of the sinners.

verses.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
verses.translation: They will not believe in it until they will see the painful punishment

verses.text: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
verses.translation: and it will come to them suddenly while they will not be anticipating (it),

verses.text: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
verses.translation: and (then) they will say, “Is it (possible) that we are given some respite?”

verses.text: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.translation: Is it then Our punishment that they are trying to hasten up?

verses.text: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
verses.translation: So tell me, if We give them enjoyment for years,

verses.text: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
verses.translation: then comes to them what they are warned of,

verses.text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
verses.translation: what help can they receive from the comforts they were given to enjoy?

verses.text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
verses.translation: We did not destroy any town unless it has had warners

verses.text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
verses.translation: to give advice, and We have never been unjust.

verses.text: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
verses.translation: And this (Qur’ān) is not brought down by devils.

verses.text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
verses.translation: It neither suits them, nor are they able to (do this).

verses.text: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
verses.translation: In fact, they are kept far away from hearing (it at the time of revelation).

verses.text: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
verses.translation: So do not invoke any other god along with Allah, otherwise you will be among those who are to be punished.

verses.text: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
verses.translation: And warn the nearest people of your clan,

verses.text: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
verses.translation: and be kind with humbleness to the believers who followed you.

verses.text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
verses.translation: So if they disobey you, then say, “I disown what you do,”

verses.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.translation: and place your trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,

verses.text: Who sees you when you arise
verses.translation: Who sees you when you stand (in prayer,)

verses.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.
verses.translation: and (sees) your movement among those who prostrate themselves.

verses.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.translation: Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
verses.translation: Shall I tell you on whom the devils descend?

verses.text: They descend upon every sinful liar.
verses.translation: They descend on every sinful liar.

verses.text: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
verses.translation: They give ear to hear (secretly,) and most of them tell lies.

verses.text: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
verses.translation: As for the poets, they are followed by the straying people.

verses.text: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
verses.translation: Did you not see that they wander in every valley,

verses.text: And that they say what they do not do? -
verses.translation: and that they say what they do not?

verses.text: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
verses.translation: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah very much, and defend themselves after they are wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know to which place they are going to return.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
verses.translation: Tā Sīn . These are the verses of the Qur’ān and an enlightening book,

verses.text: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
verses.translation: a guidance and good news to the believers

verses.text: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
verses.translation: who establish Salāh and pay Zakāh and who have faith in the Hereafter.

verses.text: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
verses.translation: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds look beautiful to them. So they are wandering astray.

verses.text: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
verses.translation: Those are the people who deserve the worst punishment and who are the worst losers in the Hereafter.

verses.text: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.
verses.translation: Indeed you are being given the Qur’ān by a Wise, Knowledgeable Being.

verses.text: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
verses.translation: (Remember) when Mūsā said to his family, “I have noticed a fire. I shall bring to you some news from it, or bring to you a live ember, so that you may warm yourselves.”

verses.text: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah , Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: So when he came to it, he was called: “Blessed is the one who is in the fire and the one who is around it. And pure is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.translation: O Mūsā, the fact is that I AM ALLAH, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.text: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [ Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
verses.translation: And cast your staff down.” So when he saw it moving, as if it was a snake, he retreated turning his back, and did not look behind. “O Mūsā, be not scared. I am such that the messengers are not scared before Me,

verses.text: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: except him who did wrong, then after (having done) evil, replaced (it) with good, then I am Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
verses.translation: And put your hand into your bosom, and it will come out white, without any evil, as one of the nine signs (sent) to Pharaoh and his people. Surely they have been a sinful people.

verses.text: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
verses.translation: So when Our signs came to them as eye-openers, they said, “This is a clear magic.”

verses.text: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
verses.translation: And they denied them out of sheer injustice and arrogance, though their hearts believed them (to be true). See, then, how was the fate of the mischief-makers.

verses.text: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah , who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
verses.translation: Surely We gave knowledge to Dāwūd and Sulaimān, and they said, “Praise belongs to Allah who made us excel many of His believing servants.

verses.text: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
verses.translation: And Sulaimān inherited (the traits of) Dāwūd and said, “O people we have been taught the speech of birds, and all sorts of things are given to us. Indeed, this is the evident grace (of Allah).”

verses.text: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.
verses.translation: And mustered for Sulaimān were his forces from among the Jinns and the humans and the birds. So all of them were kept under (his) control,

verses.text: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
verses.translation: until when they reached the valley of the ants, one of the ants said, “O ants, enter your dwelling places, lest Sulaimān and his armies crush you unknowingly.”

verses.text: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
verses.translation: So he (Sulaimān) smiled, laughing on her speech and said, “My Lord, enable me to become grateful to Your favor that you have bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do good deeds that You like, and admit me, with Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.”

verses.text: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
verses.translation: And (once) he (Sulaimān) checked the birds and said, “How is it with me that I do not see the hudhud (hoopoe)? Rather he has disappeared.

verses.text: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
verses.translation: I will punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings to me a clear plea.”

verses.text: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
verses.translation: Then the hoopoe did not take long and said (to Sulaimān), “I have discovered what you did not, and have brought to you a sure information from Saba’ (Sheba).

verses.text: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
verses.translation: I have found a woman ruling over them, and all sorts of things are given to her, and she has a great throne.

verses.text: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah , and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
verses.translation: I have found her and her people prostrating themselves to the sun, instead of Allah, and the Satan has beautified their deeds for them, and has prevented them from the way, so they do not take the right path,

verses.text: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah , who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
verses.translation: that is, they do not prostrate to Allah who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and the earth,-and who knows whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal.”

verses.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
verses.translation: Allah! There is no god but He, the Lord of the Great Throne.

verses.text: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
verses.translation: He (Sulaimān) said, “We shall see whether you have told the truth or you are one of the liars.

verses.text: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
verses.translation: Go with this letter of mine, and deliver it down to them, then turn back from them, and see how they react.”

verses.text: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
verses.translation: She (the queen) said (to her officials after receiving the letter), “O chieftains, there has been delivered to me an esteemed letter.

verses.text: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
verses.translation: It is from Sulaimān, and it is (in the following words :) With the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Very-Merciful.

verses.text: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].' "
verses.translation: Do not rebel against me, and come to me in submission.”
