verses.text: And when We decreed for Solomon death, nothing indicated to the jinn his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.
verses.translation: So, when We decided (that) death (should come) upon him, nothing gave them any indication of his death, except a creature of the earth that had eaten up his sceptre. So, when he fell down, the Jinns came to know that if they had the knowledge of the Unseen, they would not have stayed (so long) in the humiliating punishment.

verses.text: There was for [the tribe of] Saba' in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [They were told], "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land [have you], and a forgiving Lord."
verses.translation: There was indeed a sign for (the community of) Saba’ in their home-land: two gardens, (one) on the right and (one) on the left. “Eat of the provision from your Lord, and be grateful to Him - (You have) an excellent city, and a Most-Forgiving Lord.”

verses.text: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.
verses.translation: Then they turned away. So We sent to them the flood of the dam, and replaced their two gardens with two gardens having fruits of bitter taste, and tamarisk and some bushes of wild lotes.

verses.text: [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?
verses.translation: Thus We punished them because of their ungratefulness. We do not give (such a) punishment but to the ungrateful.

verses.text: And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed [many] visible cities. And We determined between them the [distances of] journey, [saying], "Travel between them by night or day in safety."
verses.translation: And We had set visible townships, all the way between them and the towns blessed by Us, and phased the journey between them in measured phases: “Travel along them at nights and days peacefully.”

verses.text: But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
verses.translation: Then they said, “Our Lord, make (the phases of) our journeys more distant.” And they wronged themselves, therefore We turned them into stories, and tore them into pieces. Surely in this there are signs for everyone who is ever-patient, fully grateful.

verses.text: And Iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers.
verses.translation: Iblīs (Satan)has found his assessment true about them. So they followed him, except a group of the believers.

verses.text: And he had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian.
verses.translation: He did not have any power over them, but for the reason that We should recognize the one who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from the one who is in doubt about it; and your Lord is Watchful over every thing.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Invoke those you claim [as deities] besides Allah ." They do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with Him], nor is there for Him from among them any assistant.
verses.translation: Say. “Call upon those whom you claim (to be your gods) beside Allah. They do not possess (any thing) even to the measure of a particle, neither in the heavens nor in the earth. They have no contribution at all in either of the two, nor is any of them a helper for Him (Allah).

verses.text: And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. [And those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts, they will say [to one another], "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand.
verses.translation: Intercession before Him is of no benefit, but for the one whom He has permitted. (And those who receive a command from Allah remain fearful) until when fear is removed from their hearts, they say (to each other), “What did your Lord say?” They say, “The Truth.” He is the High, the Great.

verses.text: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, " Allah . And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."
verses.translation: Say, “Who gives you sustenance from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah”. And We or you are either on the right path or in open error.”

verses.text: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."
verses.translation: Say, “You will not be asked about the sins we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do.”

verses.text: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."
verses.translation: Say, “Our Lord will assemble us together, then will judge between us with truth. He is the best Judge, the All-Knowing.”

verses.text: Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.translation: Say, “Show me the ones whom you have associated with Him as partners. Never! (You can never produce such partners.) He is but Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.”

verses.text: And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.
verses.translation: We did not send you (O prophet,) but to the entire mankind, as a bearer of good news and as a warner, but most people do not know.

verses.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.translation: They say, “ When will this promise (of the Day of Judgment) be fulfilled, if you are truthful?”

verses.text: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."
verses.translation: Say, “You hold an appointment for a day that you can neither put back for a while, nor can you put it forward.

verses.text: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur'an nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each other's words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve say, “We will never believe in this Qur’ān, nor in that which was before it.” But if only you could see when the wrongdoers will be made to stand before their Lord, repulsing words (of blame) to one another! Those who were held as weak will say to the overbearing, “Had you not been there, we would have been believers.”

verses.text: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."
verses.translation: Those who were overbearing will say to those weak, “Had we stopped you from (accepting) guidance after it came to you? Rather, you yourselves were guilty.”

verses.text: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allah and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?
verses.translation: And those weak will say to those overbearing, “But (it was your) intriguing day and night (that stopped us from accepting guidance), when you were directing us to disbelieve in Allah and to set up rivals to Him.” And all of them will conceal (their) regrets when they will see the punishment. And We will place iron-collars around the necks of those who disbelieved. They will not be recompensed except for what they used to do.

verses.text: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
verses.translation: We did not send a warner to a township, but said those who lived a luxurious life in it, “We reject what you have been sent with.”

verses.text: And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."
verses.translation: And they said, “We are superior in riches and children, and we are not going to be punished”.

verses.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."
verses.translation: Say, “In fact, my Lord extends provision to whom He wills, and straitens (it for whom He wills), but most of the people do not know”.

verses.text: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].
verses.translation: Your riches or your children are not the things that bring you near Us closely; however, the one who believes and acts righteously (is close to Us). Therefore, such people will have the double reward for what they did, and they will be at peace in the upper chambers (of Paradise).

verses.text: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
verses.translation: As for those who strive against our signs trying to frustrate (them), they will be arraigned into the torment.

verses.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."
verses.translation: Say, “ Surely, my Lord extends provision for whomsoever He wills, and straitens (it) for him. And whatever thing you spend, He replaces it, and He is the best of the sustainers.

verses.text: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"
verses.translation: (Remember) the Day when He will gather all of them together, then will say to the angels, “Is it you that these people used to worship?”

verses.text: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allah ], are our benefactor not them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."
verses.translation: They will say, “Pure are You! You are our mentor, not these. Rather, they used to worship the Jinns. Most of these believed in them.”

verses.text: But today you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."
verses.translation: So, you have no power today to benefit or harm one another, and We will say to the wrongdoers, “Taste the punishment of the Fire that you used to deny.”

verses.text: And when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."
verses.translation: When Our evident verses are recited to them, they say, “He is nothing but a man who wishes to divert you from what your fathers used to worship.” And they say, “This is nothing but a forged lie.” And the disbelievers say about the Truth, when it came to them, “This is nothing but an explicit magic.”

verses.text: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muhammad], any warner.
verses.translation: We did not give them any books that they might study, nor did We send to them any warner before you.

verses.text: And those before them denied, and the people of Makkah have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But the former peoples denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.translation: And those before them had rejected (the prophets), while these (infidels of Makkah) have not reached even one tenth of what We gave to those (before them). So, they rejected my Messengers. Then (imagine) how was My censure!

verses.text: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allah , [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.
verses.translation: Say, “I advise you for one thing only: that you stand up before Allah, in pairs and in singles, then reflect; (you will easily appreciate that) there is no madness in your fellow (the Holy Prophet).” He is none but a warner to you in the face of a stern torment.

verses.text: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allah , and He is, over all things, Witness."
verses.translation: Say, “If I had ever claimed any reward from you, then it is yours. My reward is with none but Allah. And He is witness over every thing.”

verses.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth. Knower of the unseen."
verses.translation: Say, “My Lord sends forth the Truth. He is the Best-Knower of the Unseen.”

verses.text: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."
verses.translation: Say, “Truth has come, and falsehood (has vanished, and it) has no power to produce or reproduce (anything).”

verses.text: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."
verses.translation: Say, “If I go astray, I shall go astray only to my own detriment. And if I follow the right path, it is because of what my Lord reveals to me. Surely He is All-Hearer, Ever-Near.”

verses.text: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
verses.translation: And if you could only see when they will be terrified! Then there will be no escape, and they will be seized from a place near at hand.

verses.text: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?
verses.translation: And they will say, “We believe in Him.” And how can they grasp at it (the faith) from a place (so) far off,

verses.text: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.
verses.translation: while they had rejected it before, and used to make conjectures from a remote place?

verses.text: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting denial.
verses.translation: And a barrier will be placed between them and that which they desire, as it will be done with the people of their kind who were before (them). They have been in a perplexing doubt.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: [All] praise is [due] to Allah , Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
verses.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, who appoints the angels as messengers having wings, in twos, threes and fours. He adds to the creation what He wills. Indeed, Allah is powerful to do every thing.

verses.text: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: Whatever blessing Allah opens for the people, there is none to hold it back, and whatever He holds back, there is none to release it thereafter. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.text: O mankind, remember the favor of Allah upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
verses.translation: O mankind, remember Allah’s blessing upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who gives you provision from the sky and the earth? There is no god but He. So, to where are you being turned around (by your desires)?

verses.text: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - already were messengers denied before you. And to Allah are returned [all] matters.
verses.translation: (O Prophet,) if they reject you, (it is not something new, because) many messengers have been rejected before you. It is to Allah that all matters are to be referred.

verses.text: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.
verses.translation: O mankind, Allah’s promise is definitely true, therefore, the worldly life must not deceive you, nor should you be deceived about Allah by the big deceiver (Satan).

verses.text: Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.
verses.translation: Surely ShaiTān (Satan) is an enemy for you. So, take him as an enemy. He only invites his group (to falsehood) so that they become inmates of the blazing fire.

verses.text: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment; and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.text: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do.
verses.translation: Then, can the one whose evil deed is so much adorned for him that he deems it really good (be equal to the one who differentiates between good and evil)? The fact, therefore, is that Allah lets go astray whomsoever He wills, and leads to the right path whomsoever He wills. So, (O Prophet,) let not your soul collapse in grief for them. Surely Allah knows well what they are doing.

verses.text: And it is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.
verses.translation: Allah is the One who sends the winds, then they raise up the clouds, then We drive them to a dead land and revive the land through them after its death. In similar way shall be the Resurrection.

verses.text: Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allah belongs all honor. To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.
verses.translation: Whoever desires honor, then all honor lies with Allah alone. Towards Him ascends the pure word, and the righteous deed uplifts it. As for those who plot evils, for them there is a severe punishment, and their plot itself will perish.

verses.text: And Allah created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allah is easy.
verses.translation: Allah has created you from dust, then from a drop of semen, then He made you couples. No female conceives (a baby) nor gives birth (to it) without His knowledge; and no aged person is made to advance in age, nor is a part curtailed from his age, but all this is (recorded) in a book. Surely all this is easy for Allah.

verses.text: And not alike are the two bodies of water. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.translation: And two seas are not alike; this one is sweet, saturating, pleasant to drink, and that one is salt, bitter. But from each, you eat fresh meat, and derive ornaments that you wear. And you see the boats therein cleaving through water, so that you may search for His grace, and that you may be grateful.

verses.text: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allah , your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.
verses.translation: He makes the night enter into the day and makes the day enter into the night, and He has subjugated the sun and the moon; each one of them is running towards an appointed time. That is Allah, your Lord. To Him belongs the kingdom. And those whom you invoke beside Him do not own even the membrane on a date-stone.

verses.text: If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association. And none can inform you like [one] Acquainted [with all matters].
verses.translation: If you call them, they do not hear your call, and even if they were to hear, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Judgment they will deny your having held them as Allah’s partners. And none can inform you like Him who is Aware.

verses.text: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah , while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: O men, you are the ones who need Allah, and Allah is Free-of-All-Needs, the Ever-Praised.

verses.text: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.
verses.translation: If He so wills, He can do away with you and bring a new creation.

verses.text: And that is for Allah not difficult.
verses.translation: For Allah, that is not something difficult.

verses.text: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allah is the [final] destination.
verses.translation: No bearer will bear the burden of any other person. If a person carrying a heavy load calls (someone) to (share) his load, nothing from it shall be carried (by the latter), even though he be a near of kin. You can warn only those who fear their Lord, while He is unseen, and establish Salāh. Whoever gets purified gets purified for his own benefit. And to Allah is the final return.

verses.text: Not equal are the blind and the seeing,
verses.translation: The blind and the sighted are not equal,

verses.text: Nor are the darknesses and the light,
verses.translation: nor are darkness and light,

verses.text: Nor are the shade and the heat,
verses.translation: nor shade and heat of the sun.

verses.text: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allah causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.
verses.translation: And the living and the dead are not alike. Allah makes to hear whomsoever He wills. And you cannot make to hear those who are in the graves.

verses.text: You, [O Muhammad], are not but a warner.
verses.translation: You are but a warner.

verses.text: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.
verses.translation: Surely We have sent you with truth as a bearer of good news and as a warner, and there was no community without a warner having passed among them.

verses.text: And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.
verses.translation: If they reject you, (it is not something new, because) those before them have (also) rejected (messengers). Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and with scriptures and with the enlightening book.

verses.text: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.translation: Then I seized those who disbelieved. So, how was My censure !

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.
verses.translation: Did you not see that Allah has sent down water from the sky? Then We brought forth with it fruits having different colours. And among the mountains there are tracks, white and red- of different colours, and ( others) utterly black.

verses.text: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allah , from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.
verses.translation: And among humans and beasts and cattle, there are those having different colours as well. Only those of His slaves fear Allah who are knowledgeable. Surely Allah is Mighty, Forgiving.

verses.text: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allah and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a profit that will never perish -
verses.translation: Surely those who recite Allah’s Book and have established Salāh and have spent, secretly and openly, from what We have provided to them - they hope for a trade that will never crash,

verses.text: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
verses.translation: so that He pays them their rewards in full, and gives them more out of His grace. Surely He is Most-Forgiving, Very-Appreciative.

verses.text: And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed, Allah , of His servants, is Acquainted and Seeing.
verses.translation: The Book We have revealed to you is the Truth, confirming what was (revealed) before it. Surely Allah, in respect of His slaves, is All-Aware, All-Seeing.

verses.text: Then we caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself, and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allah . That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.
verses.translation: Then We conveyed the Book as an heritage to those of Our slaves whom We chose. Now, some of them are those who wrong their own selves, and some of them are mediocre, and some of them are those who outpace (others) in righteous deeds with Allah’s permission. That is the great bounty,

verses.text: [For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
verses.translation: gardens of eternity they enter. They will be ornamented with bracelets of gold and with pearls, and their dress therein will be (of) silk.

verses.text: And they will say, "Praise to Allah , who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -
verses.translation: And they will say, “Praise be to Allah who has removed all sorrow from us. Surely our Lord is Most-Forgiving, Very-Appreciative,

verses.text: He who has settled us in the home of duration out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."
verses.translation: who, out of His grace, has made us land at a home of eternal living where we are neither touched by weariness, nor are we touched by boredom.”

verses.text: And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do we recompense every ungrateful one.
verses.translation: As for those who disbelieve, for them shall be the fire of Jahannam; neither they will be sentenced to death, so that they could die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. It is in this way that We punish every infidel.

verses.text: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.
verses.translation: And they will be crying therein, “Our Lord, take us out (from here), and we will act righteously, not in the way we have been doing before.” (Allah will say to them,) “Did We not give you an age in your life in which lesson could have been learnt by the one who wished to take lesson? And (furthermore) the warner had (also) come to you. So, have a taste, because the wrongdoers will have no supporter.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.translation: Surely Allah is the Knower of the unseen in the heavens and the earth. Indeed He fully knows what lies in the hearts.

verses.text: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.
verses.translation: He is the One who has made you successors (of the past generations) on the earth. So the one who becomes infidel, his infidelity will go against himself. Their infidelity adds nothing to the infidels but anger from their Lord, and their infidelity adds nothing to the infidels but loss.

verses.text: Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allah ? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."
verses.translation: Say, “Tell me about your (presumed) co-gods whom you invoke beside Allah. Show me that part of the earth that they have created. Or do they have a share in the (creation) of the heavens?” Or have We given them a book so that they are upon a clear proof from it? No, but the wrongdoers promise one another nothing but delusion.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, Allah holds back the heavens and the earth from leaving their existing state, and if they were to leave, there is none who can hold them back, except Him. Surely He is Forbearing, Most-Forgiving.

verses.text: And they swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion.
verses.translation: They had sworn forceful oaths that if a warner would come to them, they would be more receptive to guidance than any other community. But when a warner came to them, it added nothing to them but aversion,

verses.text: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change, and you will never find in the way of Allah any alteration.
verses.translation: because of their showing arrogance in the land and plotting of evil. And the evil plot engulfs none but its own people (who make it). So, they are looking for nothing but the (divine) practice with the earlier people. So you will never find in Allah’s practice any change, and you will never find in Allah’s practice any diversion.

verses.text: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
verses.translation: Did they not travel in the land and see how was the end of those before them? They were stronger than these in power. Allah is not such that something in the heavens or the earth can frustrate Him. Surely He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

verses.text: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon the earth any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allah has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
verses.translation: If Allah were to take mankind to task for what they did, He would have not left a living creature on its back, but He delays them upto an appointed time. So when their time will come, then Allah is the One who will see His slaves.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ya, Seen.
verses.translation: Yā Sīn

verses.text: By the wise Qur'an.
verses.translation: By the Qur’ān, that is full of wisdom,

verses.text: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
verses.translation: You are truly one of the messengers of Allah,

verses.text: On a straight path.
verses.translation: (and you are) on a straight path,

verses.text: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.translation: (this Qur’ān being) a revelation from the All- Mighty, the Very-Merciful,

verses.text: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
verses.translation: so that you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, and hence, they are unaware.

verses.text: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
verses.translation: The word has indeed come true about most of them, so they will not believe.

verses.text: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
verses.translation: We have placed iron collars on their necks, so they are reaching up to their chins, and their heads are forced to remain upwards.

verses.text: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
verses.translation: And We have placed a barrier in front of them and a barrier behind them, and (thus) they are encircled by Us; so they do not see.

verses.text: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
verses.translation: It is all equal for them whether you warn them or do not warn them, they will not believe.

verses.text: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
verses.translation: You can (usefully) warn only the one who follows the advice and fears the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) without seeing (Him). So give him the good news of forgiveness and of a noble reward.

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
verses.translation: Surely We will give new life to the dead, and We are recording whatever (deeds) they send before them and whatever effects they leave behind. Every thing is fully computed by Us in a manifest book of record.

verses.text: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
verses.translation: Cite to them the example of the People of the Town, when the messengers came to it,

verses.text: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
verses.translation: when We sent to them two (apostles), and they rejected both of them, so We confirmed them with a third one. So they said, “We are sent to you.”

verses.text: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
verses.translation: They (the people of the Town) said, “You are no more than human beings like us, and the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) has not sent down any thing. You are but telling a lie.”

verses.text: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
verses.translation: They (the messengers) said, “Our Lord knows that we are undoubtedly sent to you.

verses.text: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
verses.translation: Our obligation is no more than to convey the message clearly.”

verses.text: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
verses.translation: They (the People of the Town) said, “We take you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you and you will be afflicted by a painful punishment from us.”

verses.text: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
verses.translation: They said, “Your bad omen is with yourselves. (Do you take it as bad omen) if you are given a good counsel? Rather, you are a people who cross all limits.”

verses.text: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
verses.translation: And there came a man rushing from the farthest part of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the messengers.

verses.text: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
verses.translation: Follow those who do not claim any reward from you, and who are on the right path.

verses.text: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
verses.translation: What excuse do I have if I do not worship the One who has created me and to whom you will be returned?

verses.text: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
verses.translation: Shall I adopt those gods besides Him whose intercession, if RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) intends to do harm to me, cannot help me in the least, nor can they come to my rescue?

verses.text: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
verses.translation: In that case, I will be in open error indeed.

verses.text: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
verses.translation: Undoubtedly I have believed in your Lord; so listen to me.”

verses.text: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
verses.translation: (Thereafter when his people killed him,) it was said to him, “Enter the Paradise”. He said, “Would that my people knew

verses.text: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
verses.translation: how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured ones!”

verses.text: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
verses.translation: And We did not send down to his people any army from the heavens after him, nor were We (in need) to send down.

verses.text: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
verses.translation: It was no more than a single Cry, and in no time they were extinguished.

verses.text: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.translation: Alas for the slaves (of Allah)! No messenger came to them, but they have been mocking at him.

verses.text: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
verses.translation: Did they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them who will not come back to them?

verses.text: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
verses.translation: All of them are but to be assembled together (and) to be arraigned before Us.

verses.text: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
verses.translation: And a sign for them is the dead land. We gave it life and brought forth grain from it; so from it they eat.

verses.text: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
verses.translation: And We have placed gardens of date-palms and grapes, and caused springs to gush forth therein,

verses.text: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
verses.translation: so that they may eat fruits thereof, while it was not made by their hands. Would they not then offer gratitude?

verses.text: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
verses.translation: Pure (from every fault) is the One who has created all the pairs of whatever the earth grows and of the humans themselves and of that which they do not know.

verses.text: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
verses.translation: And a sign for them is the night. We strip (the cover of) the day from it, and they are suddenly in darkness.

verses.text: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.translation: And the sun is quickly proceeding towards its destination. That is the designing of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

verses.text: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
verses.translation: And for the moon We have appointed measured phases, until it turned (pale, curved and fine) like an old branch of date palm.

verses.text: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
verses.translation: Neither it is for the sun to overtake the moon, nor can the night outpace the day. Each one is floating in an orbit.

verses.text: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
verses.translation: And it is a sign for them that We boarded their children in the loaded ship,

verses.text: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
verses.translation: and created for them things similar to it on which they ride.

verses.text: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
verses.translation: And if We so will, We can drown them; then no one will respond to their cry, nor will they be rescued,

verses.text: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
verses.translation: unless there be mercy from Us, and (unless) We let them enjoy for a while.

verses.text: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
verses.translation: And (they pay no heed) when it is said to them, “Save yourselves from that (punishment) which is before you (in this world) and that which will come after you (die), so that you may receive mercy”.

verses.text: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
verses.translation: There comes to them no sign from the signs of your Lord, but they turn averse to it.

verses.text: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, “Spend (to the needy) from the provision Allah has given to you”, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Shall we feed those whom Allah could have fed, if Allah so willed? You are but in open error.”

verses.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.translation: And they say, “When will this promise come true, if you are truthful?”

verses.text: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
verses.translation: They are looking for nothing but for a single Cry that will seize them when they will be quarrelling.

verses.text: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
verses.translation: So they will not be able to make a bequest, nor will they return to their household.

verses.text: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
verses.translation: And the Horn will be blown, and suddenly they will be rushing from their graves towards their Lord.

verses.text: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
verses.translation: They will say, “Woe to us! Who has raised us from our sleeping place? “This is what RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) had promised, and the messengers had told the truth.

verses.text: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
verses.translation: It will be no more than a single Cry, and in no time they will all be arraigned before Us.

verses.text: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
verses.translation: Then, nobody will be subjected to injustice in the least, and you will not be recompensed but for what you used to do.

verses.text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
verses.translation: The people of the Paradise are engaged today in (their) activities, happily enjoying (them).

verses.text: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
verses.translation: They and their spouses are in pleasant shades, reclining on couches.

verses.text: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
verses.translation: For them there are fruits, and for them there is whatever they ask for.

verses.text: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
verses.translation: “Salām ”(Peace upon you) is the word (they receive) from Merciful Lord.

verses.text: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
verses.translation: And (it will be said to the infidels,) “Get apart (from the believers) today O the guilty ones.

verses.text: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
verses.translation: Did I not direct you, O children of ’Ādam (Adam), that you must not worship the Satan, (because) he is an open enemy for you,

verses.text: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
verses.translation: and that you must worship Me, (because) this is the straight path?

verses.text: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
verses.translation: He had misguided lot many people from among you. So, did you not have sense?

verses.text: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
verses.translation: (Now) this is the Jahannam of which you were consistently warned.

verses.text: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
verses.translation: Enter it today, because you have been persistently denying (the truth).”

verses.text: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
verses.translation: Today We will set a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness about what they used to do.

verses.text: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
verses.translation: If We so will, We would wipe out their eyes (right here in this world), and they would be racing towards the way, but how would they see?

verses.text: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
verses.translation: And If We so will, We would disfigure them at their places, and they would not be able to move, nor would they return.

verses.text: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
verses.translation: And whomsoever We give long life, we reverse him in creation. Then, do they have no sense?

verses.text: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
verses.translation: We did not teach him (the Holy Prophet) poetry, and it is not proper for him. It is nothing (of that sort,) but (it is) an advice and a readable book that explains (the Truth),

verses.text: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
verses.translation: so that it may warn him who is alive (to listen to the truth), and so that the word may prove true against the disbelievers.

verses.text: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
verses.translation: Did they not see that We have created for them cattle, among things made (directly) by Our hands, and then they become their owners?

verses.text: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
verses.translation: And We have brought them under their control, so as some of them are their means of transport, and some of them they eat.

verses.text: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
verses.translation: And for them there are (other) benefits in them and things to drink. So, would they not be grateful?

verses.text: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
verses.translation: They have adopted gods other than Allah, so that they may be helped (by them).

verses.text: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
verses.translation: They cannot help them, rather they (the disbelievers themselves) are (like) an army brought forth for (protecting) them (the so-called co-gods)

verses.text: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
verses.translation: So, their remarks must not grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they disclose.

verses.text: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
verses.translation: Did man not see that We have created him from a drop of semen? Then suddenly he stood as an open adversary (to Us).

verses.text: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
verses.translation: He has set up an argument about Us and forgot his creation. He said, “Who will give life to the bones when they are decayed?”

verses.text: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
verses.translation: Say, “These will be revived by the same One who had created them for the first time, and who is fully aware of every creation,

verses.text: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
verses.translation: - the One who created for you fire from the green tree, and in no time you kindle from it.”

verses.text: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
verses.translation: Is it that the One who has created the heavens and the earth has no power to create ones like them? Why not? He is the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing.

verses.text: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.translation: His practice, when He intends to do something, is no more than He says, “Be”, and it comes to be.

verses.text: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.translation: So, pure (from every fault) is the One in whose hand is the dominion of all things. And towards Him you are to be returned.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows
verses.translation: (I swear) by those who stand in rows,

verses.text: And those who drive [the clouds]
verses.translation: then by those who prevent firmly,

verses.text: And those who recite the message,
verses.translation: then by those who recite the dhikr,

verses.text: Indeed, your God is One,
verses.translation: surely your God is but One,

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.

verses.text: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
verses.translation: Verily, We have decorated the nearest sky with an adornment, the stars,

verses.text: And as protection against every rebellious devil
verses.translation: and (have made them) a security against every rebellious devil.

verses.text: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
verses.translation: They cannot listen to the Upper Realm and are hit from every side

verses.text: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
verses.translation: to be driven off, and for them there is a lasting punishment;

verses.text: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
verses.translation: however, if one snatches a little bit, he is pursued by a bright flame.

verses.text: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
verses.translation: Now ask them, “Are they stronger in the formation of their bodies, or those (other beings) that We have created?” Certainly, We did create them from sticky clay.

verses.text: But you wonder, while they mock,
verses.translation: But you wonder (at their denial), and they mock (at the idea of an Hereafter).

verses.text: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
verses.translation: And when any advice is given to them, they pay no heed to it.

verses.text: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
verses.translation: And when they see a sign, they make fun of it,

verses.text: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
verses.translation: and say, “This is nothing but an open magic.

verses.text: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.translation: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones, that we shall be raised again,

verses.text: And our forefathers [as well]?"
verses.translation: and even our fathers of aforetime?”

verses.text: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
verses.translation: Say, “Yes, and you shall be disgraced (too)!”

verses.text: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
verses.translation: So, it will be only a single castigating call, and all of a sudden they will begin to see.

verses.text: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
verses.translation: And they will be saying, “Woe to us; this is the Day of Retribution.”

verses.text: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
verses.translation: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Judgment that you used to deny.”

verses.text: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
verses.translation: (It will be said to the angels,) “Muster all those who were unjust, and their fellows, and whatever they used to worship

verses.text: Other than Allah , and guide them to the path of Hellfire
verses.translation: other than Allah, and show them the way to Jahannam ,

verses.text: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
verses.translation: and stop them (for a while,) for they are to be asked some questions.”

verses.text: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
verses.translation: (Then they will be asked, “What is wrong with you that you do not help each other?”

verses.text: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
verses.translation: On the contrary, that day all of them will have totally surrendered.

verses.text: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
verses.translation: And some of them (the followers of their chiefs) will turn to others (the chiefs), asking questions from one another.

verses.text: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
verses.translation: They (the followers) will say, “You were the ones who used to come to (mislead) us forcefully.”

verses.text: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
verses.translation: They (the chiefs) will say, “On the contrary, you yourselves were not believers.

verses.text: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
verses.translation: We had no authority over you at all, but you yourselves were a transgressing people.

verses.text: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
verses.translation: So, the word of our Lord has come true against us. Indeed, we have to taste (the punishment).

verses.text: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
verses.translation: We did misguide you, (because) we were ourselves erroneous”.

verses.text: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
verses.translation: So, that day, they will share each other in punishment.

verses.text: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
verses.translation: This is how We deal with the criminals.

verses.text: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah ," were arrogant
verses.translation: They were those to whom when it was said: “There is no god but Allah”, they waxed proud,

verses.text: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
verses.translation: and used to say, “Are we really to leave our gods because of an insane poet?”

verses.text: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
verses.translation: No, he has come with Truth and has confirmed all the messengers (of Allah).

verses.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
verses.translation: Surely you have to taste the painful punishment,-

verses.text: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
verses.translation: And you will be recompensed for nothing but for what you used to do-

verses.text: But not the chosen servants of Allah .
verses.translation: unlike Allah’s chosen servants.

verses.text: Those will have a provision determined -
verses.translation: Those are the people for whom there is a known provision,

verses.text: Fruits; and they will be honored
verses.translation: the fruits; and they will be honored

verses.text: In gardens of pleasure
verses.translation: in Gardens of Bliss

verses.text: On thrones facing one another.
verses.translation: facing each other on couches.

verses.text: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
verses.translation: They will be served with a cup from a flowing drink,

verses.text: White and delicious to the drinkers;
verses.translation: (that will be) white (and) delicious for those who drink.

verses.text: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
verses.translation: There will be no headache therein, nor will they be intoxicated with it,

verses.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
verses.translation: and by their side there will be females restricting their gazes (to their husbands), having pretty big eyes,

verses.text: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
verses.translation: as if they were eggs hidden (under feathers, protected from pollution).

verses.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.translation: Then they will turn to each other asking questions mutually.

verses.text: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
verses.translation: A speaker from them will say, “I had a companion (in the worldly life)

verses.text: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
verses.translation: who used to say (to me), “Are you one of those who believe?

verses.text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
verses.translation: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones? Is it true that we are going to be recompensed (for our deeds)?”

verses.text: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
verses.translation: He (the speaker) will say (to other people in Paradise) “Would you like to have a look (at Jahannam to find out what happened to that companion of mine)?”

verses.text: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
verses.translation: So he will look and will see him in the middle of Jahannam.

verses.text: He will say, "By Allah , you almost ruined me.
verses.translation: He (the speaker) will say (to his companion seen in Jahannam ), “By Allah, you were going almost to ruin me.

verses.text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
verses.translation: But for the favor of my Lord, I would have been among those produced for punishment.”

verses.text: Then, are we not to die
verses.translation: (Then the speaker will address other people of Paradise in delight and wonder, saying,) “Are we not then to die anymore

verses.text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
verses.translation: beyond our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”

verses.text: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
verses.translation: This is, indeed, the great achievement.

verses.text: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
verses.translation: For this kind (of achievement), all workers must work.

verses.text: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
verses.translation: Is that (blissful Paradise) better for hospitality or the tree of zaqqūm ?

verses.text: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: We have made it a test for the unjust.

verses.text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
verses.translation: It is a tree that comes forth in the bottom of Jahannam.

verses.text: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
verses.translation: Its fruits are like the heads of devils.

verses.text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
verses.translation: So, they have to eat from it and have to fill their bellies with it.

verses.text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
verses.translation: Then they will have, on top of it, a mixture made of boiling water.

verses.text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
verses.translation: Then, their final return is to the Fire.

verses.text: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
verses.translation: They found their fathers on the wrong path.

verses.text: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
verses.translation: So, they used to run in their footsteps.

verses.text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
verses.translation: Most of the earlier ones (too) had gone astray before them.

verses.text: And We had already sent among them warners.
verses.translation: We did send warners among them.

verses.text: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
verses.translation: So look, how was the end of those warned -

verses.text: But not the chosen servants of Allah .
verses.translation: except Allah’s chosen servants.

verses.text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
verses.translation: And NūH did call Us (for help after he was disappointed with his people), so (We accepted his prayer, as) We are the best to respond.

verses.text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
verses.translation: And We delivered him and his family from the great agony,

verses.text: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
verses.translation: and made his progeny the sole survivors (from the Deluge).

verses.text: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: And We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people, (that is):

verses.text: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
verses.translation: Salām be on NūH among (the people of) all the worlds.

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: Certainly, this is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

verses.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: He was one of Our believing servants.

verses.text: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
verses.translation: Then, we drowned others.

verses.text: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
verses.translation: And certainly one of his adherents was Ibrāhīm.

verses.text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
verses.translation: (Remember) when he came to his Lord with a pure heart,

verses.text: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
verses.translation: when he said to his father and his people, “What is that which you worship?

verses.text: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
verses.translation: Do you wish (to have) fallacious gods other than Allah?

verses.text: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.translation: Then, what do you think about the Lord of the worlds?”

verses.text: And he cast a look at the stars
verses.translation: Then, he cast a look at the stars,

verses.text: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
verses.translation: and then said, “I feel indisposed”

verses.text: So they turned away from him, departing.
verses.translation: So they went away from him, turning their backs.

verses.text: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
verses.translation: And he made his way to their ‘gods’ and said to them, “Why would you not eat?

verses.text: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
verses.translation: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”

verses.text: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
verses.translation: Then he attacked them striking with his right hand.

verses.text: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
verses.translation: Then, they (the idolaters) came to him rushing.

verses.text: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
verses.translation: He said, “Do you worship what is carved by yourselves,

verses.text: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
verses.translation: while Allah has created you and what you make?”

verses.text: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
verses.translation: They said, “Build for him a structure, and throw him into the blazing fire.”

verses.text: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
verses.translation: So, they intended to bring harm to him, but We made them the lowest (by frustrating their plan).

verses.text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
verses.translation: And he said, “I am going to my Lord. He will show me the way.

verses.text: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
verses.translation: O my Lord, bless me with a righteous son.”

verses.text: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
verses.translation: So, We gave him the good news of a forbearing boy.

verses.text: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
verses.translation: Thereafter, when he (the boy) reached an age in which he could work with him, he (Ibrāhīm) said, “O my little son, I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you, so consider, what is your opinion?” He said, “O my dear father, do what you have been ordered to do. You will find me, inshā’allah , (if Allah wills) one of those who endure patiently.”

verses.text: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
verses.translation: So, (it was a great episode) when both of them submitted themselves (to Allah’s will), and he laid him on his forehead (to slaughter him),

verses.text: We called to him, "O Abraham,
verses.translation: and then We called out to him, “O Ibrāhīm,

verses.text: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: you did make the dream come true.” This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

verses.text: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
verses.translation: This was indeed a trial that clearly demonstrated (their obedience).

verses.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
verses.translation: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

verses.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: and We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people,

verses.text: "Peace upon Abraham."
verses.translation: (that is,) “Salām be on Ibrāhīm!

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

verses.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: Surely, he is among Our believing servants.

verses.text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
verses.translation: And We gave him the good news of IsHāq (Isaac), a prophet from among the righteous.

verses.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
verses.translation: And We did bless him, and IsHāq. And among the progeny of both of them, some are good and some are utterly unjust to their own selves.

verses.text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
verses.translation: Certainly We bestowed favors upon Mūsā and Hārūn,

verses.text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
verses.translation: and We delivered them and their people from the great agony,

verses.text: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
verses.translation: and We helped them, so they became victors,

verses.text: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
verses.translation: and We gave them the clear book,

verses.text: And We guided them on the straight path.
verses.translation: and guided them to the straight path.

verses.text: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: And We left for them (a word of praise) among the later people,

verses.text: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
verses.translation: (that is,) Salām be on Mūsā and Hārūn!

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

verses.text: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: Surely, both of them were among Our believing servants.

verses.text: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
verses.translation: And surely, Ilyās is one of the messengers.

verses.text: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: (Remember) when he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.text: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
verses.translation: Do you invoke Ba‘l, and ignore the Best of the creators,

verses.text: Allah , your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
verses.translation: that is, Allah who is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

verses.text: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
verses.translation: Then they rejected him. Therefore, they will be arraigned -

verses.text: Except the chosen servants of Allah .
verses.translation: except Allah’s chosen servants.

verses.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: And We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people,

verses.text: "Peace upon Elias."
verses.translation: (that is,) “Salām on Ilyāsīn (Ilyās).

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

verses.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: Surely, he was from among Our believing servants.

verses.text: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
verses.translation: And surely, LūT is one of the messengers.

verses.text: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
verses.translation: (Remember) when We saved him and his family, all of them,

verses.text: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
verses.translation: except an old woman among those remaining behind.

verses.text: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.translation: After that, We destroyed others

verses.text: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
verses.translation: and you do pass by them at daybreak

verses.text: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
verses.translation: and by nightfall. Would you still not understand?

verses.text: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
verses.translation: And surely, Yūnus (Jonah) is from among the messengers.

verses.text: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
verses.translation: (Remember) when he ran away towards the boat that was already loaded.

verses.text: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
verses.translation: Then he participated in drawing lots (to offload one of the passengers) and was the one who was defeated.

verses.text: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
verses.translation: Then the fish swallowed him while he was reproaching his own self.

verses.text: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah ,
verses.translation: Had he not been of those who proclaim Allah’s purity,

verses.text: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
verses.translation: he would have definitely lived in its belly till the day when the dead will be raised.

verses.text: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
verses.translation: Then We cast him ashore in the open while he was ill,

verses.text: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
verses.translation: and We caused a tree of ourds to grow over him.

verses.text: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
verses.translation: And We had sent him (as messenger) to one hundred thousand, or more.

verses.text: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
verses.translation: So, they believed, then, We let them enjoy for a time.

verses.text: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
verses.translation: So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”

verses.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
verses.translation: Or, had We created angels as females while they were witnessing?

verses.text: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
verses.translation: Beware! They are the ones who, by way of a lie of theirs, (have the audacity to) say,

verses.text: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
verses.translation: “Allah has children” - and they are absolute liars.

verses.text: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
verses.translation: Is it that Allah has chosen daughters (for Himself) instead of sons?

verses.text: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
verses.translation: What is the matter with you? How (arbitrarily) do you judge?

verses.text: Then will you not be reminded?
verses.translation: Then, is it that you do not think about it?

verses.text: Or do you have a clear authority?
verses.translation: Or, is it that there is some open authority with you?

verses.text: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
verses.translation: Then bring your book, if you are truthful.

verses.text: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
verses.translation: And they have made up between Him (Allah) and the Jinns some kinship, while the Jinns already know that they are bound to be seized.-

verses.text: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
verses.translation: -Pure is Allah from what they describe-

verses.text: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
verses.translation: except Allah’s chosen servants.

verses.text: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
verses.translation: So, you and those whom you worship,

verses.text: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
verses.translation: none of you can make anyone turn away from Him (Allah),

verses.text: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
verses.translation: except him who is to burn in Jahannam.

verses.text: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
verses.translation: And (the angels say,) “There is no one among us who does not have a known station,

verses.text: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
verses.translation: and We, surely We, are those who stand in rows

verses.text: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah ."
verses.translation: and We, surely We, are those who proclaim Allah’s purity.”

verses.text: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
verses.translation: And they (the pagans) used to say,
