verses.text: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
verses.translation: “Had there been a scripture with us like that of the former people,

verses.text: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah ."
verses.translation: we would have certainly been Allah’s chosen servants.”

verses.text: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
verses.translation: Then (once the divine book came to them,) they disbelieved in it. So, very soon they will come to know.

verses.text: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
verses.translation: And Our Word has already come to pass in favor of Our servants, the messengers

verses.text: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
verses.translation: (that) they are the ones who will be supported,

verses.text: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
verses.translation: and verily it is Our army (of chosen servants) that prevails.

verses.text: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
verses.translation: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time.

verses.text: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
verses.translation: But, watch them. They shall soon see (the reality).

verses.text: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.translation: Are they asking for Our punishment to come sooner?

verses.text: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
verses.translation: So, when it will descend in their courtyard, then, evil will be the morning of those warned.

verses.text: And leave them for a time.
verses.translation: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time,

verses.text: And see, for they are going to see.
verses.translation: and watch. They shall soon see (the reality).

verses.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
verses.translation: Pure is your Lord, the Lord of all might and honor, from what they describe

verses.text: And peace upon the messengers.
verses.translation: and Salām be on the messengers

verses.text: And praise to Allah , Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: and praised is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
verses.translation: Sād . I swear by the Qur’ān, (the book) containing advice, (this is true,)

verses.text: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
verses.translation: but those who disbelieve are (involved) in false pride and opposition.

verses.text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
verses.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, so they cried out (for mercy), while no time was left for having any refuge.

verses.text: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
verses.translation: They (the pagans) wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a sheer liar.

verses.text: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
verses.translation: Has he (not) turned all the gods into a single God? It is a very strange thing indeed.”

verses.text: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
verses.translation: And the leaders among them walked out saying (to their followers), “Walk away (from the Prophet,) and stay firm on (adhering to) your gods. This (call of the Prophet) is surely something designed (for his personal benefit).

verses.text: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
verses.translation: We never heard of it in the classical faith (of ours). This is nothing but a false invention.

verses.text: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
verses.translation: Is it (believable) that the message of advice has been sent down to him (alone) from among all of us?” The fact is that they are in doubt about My message; rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

verses.text: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
verses.translation: Do they have the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the Mighty, the Bountiful?

verses.text: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
verses.translation: Or do they have the ownership of the heavens and the earth and what lies between them? Then let them ascend (to the sky) by ropes.

verses.text: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
verses.translation: What is there (in Makkah) is just a host of the (opposing) groups that has to be defeated.

verses.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
verses.translation: Even before them, the people of NūH and ‘Ād and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of stakes,

verses.text: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
verses.translation: and Thamūd and the people of LūT and the people of Aaikah have rejected (the messengers). They were the (strong) groups.

verses.text: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
verses.translation: All of them did nothing but declare the messengers as liars; hence, My punishment became due.

verses.text: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
verses.translation: And these people are waiting for nothing but for a single Cry (the sound of the Trumpet to be blown on Doomsday) that will have no pause.

verses.text: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
verses.translation: And they say, “O our Lord, give us our share (of the punishment) sooner, before the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.text: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah ].
verses.translation: Bear patiently with what they say, and remember Our servant Dawūd, the man of might. Surely he was ever-turning to Allah.

verses.text: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [ Allah ] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
verses.translation: We had subjugated the mountains to join him (in) making tasbīH (i.e. pronouncing Allah’s purity) at evening and sunrise,

verses.text: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
verses.translation: and the birds as well, mustered together. All were turning to Allah with him.

verses.text: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
verses.translation: And We made his kingdom strong, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.

verses.text: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of the litigants, when they entered the sanctuary by climbing over the wall?

verses.text: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
verses.translation: When they entered upon Dawūd, and he was scared of them, they said, “Be not scared. We are two litigants; one of us has wronged the other, so decide between us with truth, and do not cross the limits, and guide us to the right path.

verses.text: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
verses.translation: This is my brother; he has ninety nine ewes, and I have a single ewe; still he said, ‘Give it into my charge.’ And he overpowered me in speech.”

verses.text: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah ].
verses.translation: He (Dawūd) said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding your ewe to be added to his ewe. Many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and very few they are.” And Dawūd realized that We had put him to a test, so he prayed to his Lord for forgiveness, and bowing down, he fell in prostration, and turned (to Allah).

verses.text: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.translation: So we forgave him that (lapse), and surely he has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent resort.

verses.text: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah ." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
verses.translation: O Dawūd, We have made you a vicegerent on earth, so judge between people with truth, and do not follow the selfish desire, lest it should lead you astray from Allah’s path. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s path will have a severe punishment, because they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.

verses.text: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them in vain. That is the thinking of those who disbelieve. So, woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire (they have to face).

verses.text: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
verses.translation: Shall We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who commit mischief on the earth? Or shall We make the God-fearing equal to the sinners?

verses.text: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
verses.translation: This is a blessed Book We have revealed to you, so that they deliberate in its verses, and so that the men of understanding may heed to advice.

verses.text: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah ].
verses.translation: And We blessed Dawūd with Sulaimān. He was an excellent servant (of Allah). Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).

verses.text: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
verses.translation: (Worth remembering is the incident) when the swift horses of high breeding were presented before him in the evening.

verses.text: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
verses.translation: He said, “I held the love of the good things (i.e. these horses) because of the remembrance of my Lord.” until it went behind the veil.

verses.text: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
verses.translation: (Then he said,) “Bring them back to me” - and he started passing his hands over the shanks and the necks (of the horses).

verses.text: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
verses.translation: And indeed We tested Sulaimān while We threw on his throne a body after which he turned (to Us).

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
verses.translation: He said, “O my Lord, forgive me, and bless me with a kingdom that will not be available to anyone after me. Surely, You are the Bountiful.”

verses.text: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
verses.translation: Then We subjugated the wind for him that blew smoothly on his command to wherever he wished,

verses.text: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
verses.translation: and (We subjugated to him) the devils (among Jinns), all builders and divers,

verses.text: And others bound together in shackles.
verses.translation: and many others held in chains.

verses.text: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
verses.translation: This is Our gift. So, do favor (to someone) or withhold (it), with no (requirement to give) account.

verses.text: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.translation: He has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent end.

verses.text: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
verses.translation: And remember Our servant, Ayyūb - when he called his Lord saying, “The ShaiTān (Satan) has inflicted weariness and pain upon me.”

verses.text: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
verses.translation: (Allah said to him,) “Strike (the ground) with your foot: Here is a cool water to bathe, and a drink!”

verses.text: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.translation: And We let him have his family and the like of them besides, as a mercy from Us, and a reminder for the people of understanding.

verses.text: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah ].
verses.translation: And (We said to him,) “Take (a bundle of) thin twigs in your hand, and strike with it, and do not violate your oath. Surely, We found him very enduring. He was really an excellent servant. Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).

verses.text: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
verses.translation: And remember Our servants - Ibrāhīm and IsHāq and Ya‘qūb - the men of strength and the men of vision.

verses.text: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
verses.translation: We chose them for a trait of remembering the (eternal) Home (in the Hereafter).

verses.text: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
verses.translation: And surely they are, in Our sight, among the chosen, the best of the righteous.

verses.text: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
verses.translation: And remember Ismā‘īl and Al-Yasa‘ and Dhul-Kifl. Each one of them was among the best of the righteous.

verses.text: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
verses.translation: This is a reminder (of what has passed). And surely the God-fearing will have the best place to return:

verses.text: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
verses.translation: - everlasting gardens, with (their) doors opened for them.

verses.text: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
verses.translation: They will be relaxing in it, calling there for plenteous fruits and drinks;

verses.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
verses.translation: and in their company there will be females restricting their glances (to their husbands, and) of matching ages.

verses.text: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
verses.translation: This is what you are being promised for the Day of Reckoning.

verses.text: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
verses.translation: Surely, that is provision provided by Us, to which there is no end.

verses.text: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
verses.translation: Having said this, the transgressors will surely have the most evil place to return:

verses.text: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
verses.translation: the Jahannam , in which they will enter. So, how evil is that place to rest?

verses.text: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
verses.translation: Let them taste this: hot water and pus,

verses.text: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
verses.translation: and other things similar to it of various kinds.

verses.text: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
verses.translation: (When the leaders of the infidels will see their followers entering the Hell after them, they will say to each other,) “This is a multitude rushing into (the Hell) with you - they are not welcome - they are to burn in the Fire.”

verses.text: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
verses.translation: They (the followers) will say (to their leaders) “No, it is you who are not welcome; you are the ones who brought this upon us.” So, how evil is the place to stay (for ever)!”

verses.text: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
verses.translation: They (the followers) will say, “Our Lord, whoever has brought this on us, do increase his punishment twofold in the Fire.”

verses.text: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
verses.translation: And they (the infidels) will say, “What is the matter with us that we do not see those men (here in Hell) whom we used to count amongst the worst? (i.e the Muslims whom the infidels used to treat as the worst people among them)

verses.text: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
verses.translation: Had we taken them as a laughing-stock (unjustly), or have our eyes missed them?”

verses.text: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
verses.translation: That is going to happen definitely, that is, the mutual quarrel of the people of the Fire.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah , the One, the Prevailing.
verses.translation: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god but Allah, the One, the All-Dominant,

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Mighty, the Very-Forgiving.”

verses.text: Say, "It is great news
verses.translation: Say, “It is a great news

verses.text: From which you turn away.
verses.translation: to which you are averse.

verses.text: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
verses.translation: I had no knowledge of the Heavenly Beings when they were debating (about the creation of ’Ādam).

verses.text: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
verses.translation: Revelation is sent to me only because I am a plain warner.

verses.text: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
verses.translation: When your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create man from clay.

verses.text: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.translation: So, once I make him perfectly and breath My spirit into him, you must fall down in prostration before him.”

verses.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
verses.translation: Then, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together -

verses.text: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
verses.translation: except Iblīs (Satan). He waxed proud, and became one of the disbelievers.

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
verses.translation: He (Allah) said, “O Iblīs, what did prevent you from prostrating yourself before what I created with My hands? Did you wax proud or were you among the lofty ones?”

verses.text: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
verses.translation: He said, “I am better than him. You created me from fire, and created him from clay.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.translation: He said, “Then, get out from here, for you are accursed,

verses.text: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.translation: and on you shall remain My curse till the Day of Judgment.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.translation: He said, “O my Lord, then give me respite till the day they are raised again.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.translation: He said, “Then, you have been given respite,

verses.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.translation: until the Day of the Appointed Time.”

verses.text: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
verses.translation: He said, “Then, I swear by Your Might, that I will definitely lead them astray, all of them -

verses.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.translation: except Your chosen servants among them.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
verses.translation: He (Allah) said, “Then, the truth is-and it is (always) the truth that I speak-

verses.text: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
verses.translation: that I will definitely fill the Jahannam with you and with those who will follow you from among them, all together.”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
verses.translation: Say (O Prophet to the unbelievers,) “I do not demand from you any fee for it, nor am I from among those who make up things artificially.

verses.text: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
verses.translation: It is nothing but an advice for all the worlds.

verses.text: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
verses.translation: And you will come to know its reality after a while.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: This is the revelation of the Book from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.text: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion.
verses.translation: Surely We have revealed the Book to you with truth; so worship Allah making your submission exclusive for Him.

verses.text: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
verses.translation: Remember, Allah alone deserves the exclusive submission. As for those who have adopted guardians other than Him (saying), “We worship them for no other reason but because they would bring us near to Allah closely”, Allah will judge between them in the matters in which they are differing. Surely, Allah does not guide anyone who is liar, highly infidel.

verses.text: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah , the One, the Prevailing.
verses.translation: Had Allah opted to have a son of His own, He would have definitely chosen anyone, as He wished, out of what He had created. (But), Pure is He. He is Allah, the Only One, the All-Dominant.

verses.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.translation: He created the heavens and the earth for just purpose. He wraps the night over the day and He wraps the day over the night, and He has put the sun and the moon under His command, each one of them moving for an appointed term. Remember, He is the Mighty, the Most-Forgiving.

verses.text: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah , your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
verses.translation: He created you from a single person, then (once this person was created,) He made his match from him, and sent down for you eight pairs of the cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in three layers of darkness. That is your Allah, your Lord. To Him belongs the whole Kingdom. There is no god but He. Then, to where are you being diverted (by your whims)?

verses.text: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.translation: If you disbelieve, then, Allah does not need you at all, however He does not like for His servants to be disbelievers; and if you are grateful, He will like it for you. No one will bear the burden of someone else. Then, to your Lord is your return; so He will tell you about what you used to do. He is aware of whatever lies in the hearts.

verses.text: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
verses.translation: And when man is afflicted by pain, he calls his Lord turning to Him passionately. Thereafter, when He blesses him with some favor from Him, he forgets that for which he was calling Him earlier, and sets up partners for Allah, so that he leads others astray from His way. Say, “Enjoy (the pleasure of) your disbelief for a while, (then) surely, you are from among the people of the Fire.”

verses.text: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
verses.translation: Can (such people be equal to) the one who worships during the hours of night, prostrating himself and standing, fearing the Hereafter and having hopes in his Lord’s mercy? Say, “Can those who know and those who do not know become equal?” It is only the people of understanding who are receptive of the advice.

verses.text: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
verses.translation: Say (on My behalf) “O My servants who believe, fear your Lord. Those who do good deeds in this world will have a good return, and the earth of Allah is wide. Certainly those who observe patience will be given their reward in full without measure.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion.
verses.translation: Say, “I have been ordered to worship Allah, making my submission exclusive to Him.

verses.text: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
verses.translation: And I have been ordered to be the first of those who submit.”

verses.text: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
verses.translation: Say, “If I were to disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of a great day.”

verses.text: Say, " Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
verses.translation: Say, “It is Allah whom I worship, making my submission exclusive to Him.

verses.text: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
verses.translation: So, worship what you wish other than Him.” Say, “Indeed, the losers are those who (will) lose their selves and their people on the Day of Judgment. Beware, that is really the obvious loss.”

verses.text: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
verses.translation: For them there are canopies of fire on top of them and canopies (of fire) underneath them. That is the thing against which Allah warns His servants. “So, O servants of Mine, fear Me.”

verses.text: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
verses.translation: And those who abstain from worshipping the Tāghūt and turn fervently to Allah, for them there is good news. So, give the good news to My servants

verses.text: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
verses.translation: who listen to what is said, then, follow the best of it. Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, and those are the ones who possess understanding.

verses.text: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
verses.translation: So tell Me about the one for whom the word of punishment is destined, - is it you, then, who would save someone who is already in the Fire?

verses.text: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah . Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
verses.translation: But, for those who fear their Lord, there are chambers with chambers built on top of them, with rivers running from underneath them. This is Allah’s promise. Allah does not go back on any promise.

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.translation: Have you not seen that Allah sent down water from the sky, then made it penetrate into the earth (and gush forth) in the form of springs? Then He brings forth with it crops of different colors, and afterwards they wither, and you see them turned yellow, then He makes them chaff. Surely in that there is a lesson for the people of understanding.

verses.text: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah . Those are in manifest error.
verses.translation: So I ask about a person whose heart Allah has opened up for Islam, and consequently he proceeds in a light from his Lord. (Can he be equal to the one whose heart is hardened?) So, woe to those whose hearts are too hard to remember Allah. Those are wandering in open error.

verses.text: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah . That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
verses.translation: Allah has sent down the best discourse, a book containing subjects resembling each other, mentioned again and again, shivered from which are the skins of those who have awe of their Lord. Then, their skins and their hearts become soft enough to tend to the remembrance of Allah. This is the Guidance of Allah with which He brings to the right path whomsoever He wills. As for the one whom Allah lets go astray, for him there is no one to guide.

verses.text: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
verses.translation: Tell Me about the one who tries to save himself from the worst punishment with his face on the Day of Judgment, (whether he is equal to the one who is not liable to any punishment.) And it will be said to the wrongdoers, “Have a taste of what you used to earn.”

verses.text: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
verses.translation: Those before them had also rejected (the messengers) and consequently, the punishment came upon them in a way that they had never imagined.

verses.text: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
verses.translation: Then Allah made them taste disgrace in the worldly life, and of course the punishment of the Hereafter is much greater. Only if they knew!

verses.text: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
verses.translation: And We have cited for people all sorts of examples in this Qur’ān, so that they may receive the message

verses.text: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
verses.translation: through an Arabic Qur’ān that has no digression (from the truth), so that they may be God-fearing.

verses.text: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah ! But most of them do not know.
verses.translation: Allah has given an example: There is a man (enslaved and) owned by some partners having rivalry with each other, and (on the other hand,) there is a man solely owned by a single man. Can they be equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! (The truth stands established). But, most of them do not know.

verses.text: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
verses.translation: Verily, you are to die and they are to die.

verses.text: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
verses.translation: After that, on the Day of Doom, you will surely place your disputes before your Lord.

verses.text: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
verses.translation: So, who is more unjust than him who forges a lie against Allah and rejects the truth when it reached him? Is it not that in Jahannam (Hell) there is an abode for the disbelievers?

verses.text: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
verses.translation: As for the one who has come with the truth and believed it to be true, then such people are the ones who are God-fearing.

verses.text: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
verses.translation: For them, with their Lord, there is what they wish. That is the reward of those who are good in their deeds,

verses.text: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
verses.translation: so that Allah wipes out from them the worst deeds they did, and gives their reward to them for the best of what they used to do.

verses.text: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
verses.translation: Is Allah not sufficient for (the protection of) His slave? They are frightening you of those (false gods whom they worship) other than Him. Whomsoever Allah would let go astray, for him there is no one to guide.

verses.text: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
verses.translation: And whomsoever Allah gives guidance, for him there is no one to misguide. Is it not that Allah is Mighty, Powerful to avenge?

verses.text: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, " Allah ." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah ? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah ; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
verses.translation: If you ask them as to who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah.” Say, “Then, tell me about those whom you invoke other than Allah, if Allah intends to cause some harm to me, are they (able) to remove the harm caused by Him? Or if He intends to bless me with mercy, are they (able) to hold back His mercy (from me)?” Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him trust those who (rightly) trust (in someone).”

verses.text: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
verses.translation: Say, “O my people, do at your place (what you are doing). I am to do (what I have been ordered to). Very soon, you will come to know

verses.text: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
verses.translation: as to who will be visited by a punishment that will disgrace him, and upon whom a lasting punishment will rest.

verses.text: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them.
verses.translation: We have sent down to you the Book for the people with truth. So, whoever follows the guidance, it is for his own good, and whoever goes astray, he will go astray only to his own detriment - and you are not responsible for them.

verses.text: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.translation: Allah fully takes away the souls (of the people) at the time of their death, and (of) those who do not die, in their sleep. Then He withholds those on whom He had decreed death, and sends others back, up to an appointed term. Surely, in this, there are signs for a people who ponder.

verses.text: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
verses.translation: Is it that they have adopted intercessors out of those (whom they invoke) other than Allah? Say, “(Do you take them as intercessors) even though they have no power at all, nor do they understand?”

verses.text: Say, "To Allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."
verses.translation: Say, “Intercession belongs entirely to Allah.” To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.”

verses.text: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
verses.translation: When Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are filled with disgust, and when those (whom they worship) other than Him are mentioned, they become happy forthwith.

verses.text: Say, "O Allah , Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."
verses.translation: Say, “O Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, the Knower of the unseen and the seen, you will judge between Your servants in that about which they used to differ.

verses.text: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account.
verses.translation: Were the wrongdoers to own all that is on earth, and even twice as much, they would surely seek to ransom themselves with it against the evil punishment on the Day of Judgment. There will appear to them from Allah what they have never imagined.

verses.text: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: Unveiled to them will be the evils of what they used to earn; and encircled they will be by what they used to ridicule.

verses.text: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: When man is visited by a trouble, he prays to Us, but when, after that, We favor him with some blessing from Us, he says, “This is given to me because of (my) knowledge.” No, but this is a trial, yet most of them do not know.

verses.text: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
verses.translation: The same was said by those before them, but what they used to earn was of no avail to them,

verses.text: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
verses.translation: and they were overtaken by the evils of what they had earned; and the wrongdoers from these (infidels too) will be overtaken by the evils of what they have earned - and they will not be able to escape.

verses.text: Do they not know that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.translation: Do they not know that it is Allah who extends provision to whomsoever He wills, and straitens (it for whomsoever He wills). Surely in that, there are signs for a people who believe.

verses.text: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah . Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
verses.translation: Say (on My behalf), “O servants of Mine who have acted recklessly against their own selves, do not despair of Allah’s mercy. Surely, Allah will forgive all sins. Surely, He is the One who is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
verses.translation: Turn passionately towards your Lord, and submit to Him before the punishment comes to you, after which you will not be helped.

verses.text: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
verses.translation: And follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Lord before the punishment comes to you suddenly when you do not even expect,

verses.text: Lest a soul should say, "Oh [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah and that I was among the mockers."
verses.translation: lest someone should say, “Pity on me, because I fell short in respect of (observing the rights of) Allah and in fact, I was one of those who mocked”,

verses.text: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."
verses.translation: or, (lest) someone should say, “If Allah were to show me the way, I would have surely been among those who fear Allah”,

verses.text: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
verses.translation: or, (lest) someone should say when he sees the punishment, “Would that I have a chance to return, so that I may become one of those who are good in their deeds.”

verses.text: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
verses.translation: No! My verses had reached you, but you called them untrue, and waxed proud, and became of those who disbelieved.

verses.text: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
verses.translation: And on the Day of Judgment, you will see those who had forged lies against Allah (in a state) that their faces are turned black. Is it not that in Jahannam there is an abode for the arrogant?

verses.text: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
verses.translation: And Allah will save the God-fearing (from Jahannam ), with utmost success granted to them, so as no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

verses.text: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
verses.translation: Allah is Creator of everything, and He is the Guardian over everything.

verses.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers.
verses.translation: To Him belong the keys to the heavens and the earth. As for those who have rejected the verses of Allah, it is they who are the losers.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"
verses.translation: Say, “Is it, then, someone other than Allah that you ask me to worship, O ignorant people?”

verses.text: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah , your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers."
verses.translation: It has already been revealed to you and to those before you (that): If you associate (partners with Allah), your deeds shall be rendered useless, and you shall be among the losers.

verses.text: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful.
verses.translation: On the contrary, it is Allah whom you should worship; and be among the grateful.

verses.text: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
verses.translation: They did not hold Allah in His true esteem. The whole earth will be in a single grip of His hand on the Day of Doom, and the heavens (will be) rolled up on his right hand. Pure is He, far too higher than what they associate with Him.

verses.text: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.
verses.translation: And Horn (Sūr ) will be blown, and all those in the heavens and all those in the earth will faint, except the one whom Allah wills (otherwise). Thereafter, it will be blown once again, and suddenly they will stand up, looking around.

verses.text: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.
verses.translation: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the book (of everyone’s deeds) will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and matters will be decided between them with justice, and they will not be wronged.

verses.text: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
verses.translation: And everyone will be paid in full for what he did - and He knows best what they do.

verses.text: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved will be driven towards Jahannam in groups, until when they reach it, its gates will be opened, and its keepers will say to them, “Did messengers from among you not come to you reciting to you the verses of your Lord, and warning you about the meeting of this day of yours?” They will say, “Yes (they did),but the word of punishment had become certain against those who disbelieved.”

verses.text: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
verses.translation: It will be said, “Enter the gates of Jahannam to live in it forever.” So, how evil is the dwelling-place of the arrogant!

verses.text: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].
verses.translation: And those who used to fear their Lord will be led towards Jannah (Paradise) in groups, until when they reach it, while its gates will be (already) opened (for them), and its keepers will say to them, “Salāmun-’alaikum (peace be on you). How good are you! So, enter it to live here forever.”

verses.text: And they will say, "Praise to Allah , who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."
verses.translation: And they will say, “AlHamdulillāh : Praise belongs to Allah who made His promise come true for us, and made us inherit the territory, so as we can dwell anywhere we wish in Jannah (Paradise) . So, excellent is the reward of those who did (good) deeds.

verses.text: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [ Allah ] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allah , Lord of the worlds."
verses.translation: And you will see the angels ringed around the Throne proclaiming the purity of their Lord, along with His praise, and matters will stand settled between them rightfully, and it will be said: “AlHamdulillāhi-rabbil‘ālamīn : Praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Hā Mīm .

verses.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.translation: This is revelation of the Book from Allah, the Mighty, the All-Knowing,

verses.text: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
verses.translation: the One who forgives sins and accepts repentance, the One who is severe in punishment, the One who is the source of all power. There is no god but He. To Him is the ultimate return (of all).

verses.text: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.
verses.translation: No one quarrels about the verses of Allah, except those who disbelieve. So, their (prosperous) movements in the cities should not deceive you.

verses.text: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
verses.translation: Before these, the people of NūH and the groups after them had rejected (the messengers). Every group intended to seize their messenger, and raised disputes on the basis of falsehood, so that they might refute the truth with it, hence I seized them. So, how was My punishment?

verses.text: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
verses.translation: And similarly, the word of your Lord has become due against those who disbelieve-that they are the people of the Fire.

verses.text: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [ Allah ] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
verses.translation: Those who are bearing the Throne and those who are around it pronounce the purity of your Lord along with His praise, and believe in Him, and pray for the forgiveness of those who believe, (saying): “Our Lord, Your mercy and knowledge comprehends everything; so forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and save them from the punishment of the Fire.

verses.text: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: And, our Lord, admit them to the eternal gardens of Jannah (Paradise) that You have promised for them, and (admit) those as well who did good from among their fathers and wives and children. You, only You, are the Mighty, the Wise,

verses.text: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."
verses.translation: and save them from evils (of punishment). And whomsoever you save from evils that day, it is surely because you bless him with mercy. And that is the great achievement indeed.”

verses.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you refused."
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve will be addressed (by a voice saying): “Allah’s hatred (for you), when you were invited to the true faith and you refused, was greater than your hatred for yourselves (today when you are hating your own selves out of remorse).

verses.text: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"
verses.translation: They will say, “Our Lord, You gave us death twice and You gave us life twice. Now we confess our sins. So, is there any way to come out of here?”

verses.text: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah , the Most High, the Grand."
verses.translation: (The reply will be, “No.) This is because whenever Allah alone was invoked, you used to disbelieve, and if partners were associated with Him, you used to believe. Now the decision lies with Allah, the High, the Great.”

verses.text: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
verses.translation: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down provision for you from the sky; and no one takes lesson but the one who turns to Him.

verses.text: So invoke Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
verses.translation: So, worship Allah, making your submission exclusive for Him, even though the disbelievers dislike (it).

verses.text: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
verses.translation: He is High in stations, the Lord of the Throne. He sends the spirit down, under His command, on whomever He wills from among His servants, so that he warns of the Day of Encounter -

verses.text: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah . To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allah , the One, the Prevailing.
verses.translation: the day they will come in open view. Nothing about them will remain hidden from Allah. To whom belongs the kingdom today? To Allah alone, the One, the All-Dominant.

verses.text: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
verses.translation: Today, everyone will be recompensed for what one earned. There is no injustice today. Surely, Allah is swift in reckoning.

verses.text: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
verses.translation: And warn them of the Day of approaching horror, when hearts will jump up into the throats, (and they will be) choked. There will be neither a friend for the unjust, nor an intercessor to be listened to.

verses.text: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
verses.translation: He knows the treachery of the eyes and whatever is concealed by hearts.

verses.text: And Allah judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allah - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.translation: He will give His judgment with truth. And those whom they invoke beside Him cannot judge anything. Surely, it is Allah who is Hearing, Seeing.

verses.text: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allah seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allah any protector.
verses.translation: Have they not traveled through the earth and seen how was the fate of those who used to be before them? They were stronger than these in power and in traces left on the earth, but Allah seized them because of their sins. There was no one to save them from Allah.

verses.text: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allah seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.
verses.translation: That was because messengers used to come to them with clear signs, but they disbelieved. Then, Allah seized them. Surely, He is Strong, severe in punishment.

verses.text: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
verses.translation: Indeed We sent Mūsā with Our signs and a manifest proof

verses.text: To Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun; but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
verses.translation: to Pharaoh and Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, “He is a sorcerer, a liar.”

verses.text: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.
verses.translation: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who have accepted faith with him, and spare the lives of their women.” But the plot of the disbelievers is nothing but a failure.

verses.text: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Mūsā, and let him call his Lord. I am afraid that he will change your religion or he will cause havoc to appear in the land.”

verses.text: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."
verses.translation: And Mūsā said, “I have sought protection of my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant man who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.text: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allah ' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allah does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.
verses.translation: And said a believing man from the House of Pharaoh who had kept his faith secret, “Would you kill a man because he says - ‘Allah is my Lord’ - while he has come to you with clear signs from your Lord? If he is a liar, his lie will fall back on himself, and if he is truthful, some of that (punishment) of which he warns you will afflict you. Indeed, Allah does not give guidance to anyone who is transgressor, a liar.

verses.text: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allah if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."
verses.translation: O my people, the kingdom is yours today, while you are dominant on the land. But, who is going to help us against Allah’s punishment, if it comes upon us?” Pharaoh said, “I do not give you an opinion unless I myself believe it to be correct, and I do not direct you to anything but to the right way.”

verses.text: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -
verses.translation: Said he who had believed, “I fear for you something like a day of the (disbelieving) groups (of the past),

verses.text: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of 'Aad and Thamud and those after them. And Allah wants no injustice for [His] servants.
verses.translation: like the fate of the people of NūH and ‘Ād and Thamūd and those who were after them - and Allah does not intend to do any injustice to His servants.

verses.text: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -
verses.translation: And O my people, I fear for you a day in which people will call one another,

verses.text: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allah any protector. And whoever Allah leaves astray - there is not for him any guide.
verses.translation: a day when you will turn back on your heels, having no one to save you from Allah - but, whomever Allah lets go astray, for him there is no one to guide.

verses.text: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allah send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allah leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."
verses.translation: And Yūsuf had already come to you earlier with clear signs, but you remained in suspicion about what he brought to you - until when he died, you said, ‘Allah will never send a messenger after him.’ That is how Allah lets go astray anyone who crosses limits and lives in doubt, -

verses.text: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allah seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
verses.translation: those who quarrel in Allah’s verses without any authority having reached them. It is terribly hateful with Allah and with those who believe. That is how Allah stamps a seal on the entire heart of an arrogant tyrant.”

verses.text: And Pharaoh said, "O Haman, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -
verses.translation: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said, “O Hāmān, make a tower for me, perhaps I could reach the ways -

verses.text: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.
verses.translation: the ways to the heavens, and peek towards the God of Mūsā. And indeed I deem him a liar.” That is how his evil deeds were made attractive to Fir‘aun, and (how) he was held back from the way. The evil design of Fir‘aun was (to end) in nothing but ruin.

verses.text: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
verses.translation: And said he who had believed, “O my people, follow me, I will show you the path of guidance.

verses.text: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
verses.translation: O my people, this life of the world is only a (momentary) benefit, while the Hereafter is, indeed, the place of permanent living.

verses.text: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.
verses.translation: The one who does something evil will not be punished but in its equal proportion, but the one who does a righteous deed, be he male or female, while he is a believer, then, such people will enter the Jannah (Paradise) where they will be provided with bounties beyond reckoning.

verses.text: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
verses.translation: And O my people, what is wrong with me that I call you to salvation and you call me to the Fire?

verses.text: You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.translation: You invite me to reject my belief in Allah and ascribe to Him partners about whom I have no knowledge, while I invite you to (Him who is) the Mighty, the Most-Forgiving.

verses.text: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allah , and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.
verses.translation: It is obvious that those (gods) to whom you are inviting me are not worth calling, neither in this world nor in the world to come, and that we have to return back to Allah, and that the transgressors are indeed the people of the Fire.

verses.text: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah . Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants."
verses.translation: Soon you will remember what I am saying to you. And I entrust my matter with Allah. Surely, Allah has all (His) servants in sight.”

verses.text: So Allah protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
verses.translation: Then Allah saved him from the evils of what they designed, and the House of Pharaoh was encircled by an evil punishment.

verses.text: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
verses.translation: It is the Fire before which they are presented morning and evening. And on the day when the Hour (of final judgment) will take place, (the order will be released,): “Admit the family of Pharaoh into the most severe punishment.”

verses.text: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"
verses.translation: And (worth remembering is the time) when they (the infidels) will argue with each other in the Fire. So, the weak will say to those who were arrogant, “Surely, we used to be your followers, would you, then, stand for us in (suffering at least a) part of the (punishment of) Fire?”

verses.text: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allah has judged between the servants."
verses.translation: Those who were arrogant will say, “We all are in it. Allah has already passed the judgment between (His) servants.

verses.text: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."
verses.translation: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Jahannam (Hell), “Pray to your Lord to lighten the punishment for us some day.”

verses.text: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error."
verses.translation: They will say, “Had your messengers not been coming to you with open signs?” They will say, “Of course, (they had come).” They (the keepers) will say, “Then, keep praying” - but praying of disbelievers (in the Hereafter) is only in vain.

verses.text: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -
verses.translation: Surely, We do help Our messengers and the believers, in the worldly life, as well as (we will help them) on the day in which witnesses will stand (to give their testimony)-

verses.text: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home.
verses.translation: a day when apology of the unjust will bring them no benefit, and on them shall be the curse, and for them will be the evil abode.

verses.text: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture
verses.translation: We gave Guidance to Mūsā, while We made the children of Isrā’īl inherit the Book -

verses.text: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.translation: as a guide and advice for people of understanding.

verses.text: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
verses.translation: So, be patient - surely the promise of Allah is true - and seek forgiveness for your sins, and proclaim the purity and praise of your Lord in the afternoon and at dawn.

verses.text: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without [any] authority having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allah . Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.translation: Surely, those who quarrel in Allah’s verses without any authority having reached them, there is nothing in their hearts but pride of greatness that they are not (able) to reach. So, seek refuge with Allah. Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

verses.text: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.
verses.translation: Certainly, the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of human beings, but most human beings do not know.

verses.text: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.
verses.translation: The blind one and the sighted one are not equal, and those who believed and did good deeds and the evil ones are not (equal) either. Little you heed to the advice!

verses.text: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.
verses.translation: Certainly, the Hour is bound to come. There is no doubt in it, but most of the people do not believe.

verses.text: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.
verses.translation: Your Lord has said, “Call Me, I will respond to you. Definitely those who show arrogance against worshipping Me shall enter Jahannam (Hell) with disgrace.

verses.text: It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful.
verses.translation: Allah is the One who made for you the night, so that you may have rest in it, and the day to let you see. Surely, Allah is most kind to people, but most of the people do not offer gratitude.

verses.text: That is Allah , your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
verses.translation: This is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Then, from where are you being reversed (by your selfish desires)?

verses.text: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allah .
verses.translation: Similarly reversed were those who used to deny Our verses.

verses.text: It is Allah who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a ceiling and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allah , your Lord; then blessed is Allah , Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: Allah is the One who made for you the earth a place to live, and the sky a roof, and shaped you, and made your shapes so good - and provided you with a lot of good things. That is Allah, your Lord. So, Glorious is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allah , Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: He is Ever-living. There is no god but He. So worship Him making your submission exclusive for Him. All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds."
verses.translation: Say, “I have been ordered not to worship those whom you invoke beside Allah when clear signs from my Lord have (already) come to me, and I have been ordered that I should submit to the Lord of the worlds.”

verses.text: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.
verses.translation: He is the One who created you from dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clot. After that, He takes you out as an infant. Then, (He makes you grow) so that you reach your full maturity, and, thereafter, become old - and some of you die earlier - and so that you reach the appointed term, and so that you understand.

verses.text: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.translation: He is the One who gives life and brings death, and when He decides to do something, He only says to it: “Be” and it comes to be.

verses.text: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted?
verses.translation: Have you not seen those who quarrel in Allah’s verses? From where are they being turned away (by their selfish desires?)

verses.text: Those who deny the Book and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,
verses.translation: - those who rejected the Book and what We sent with Our messengers. So, they will soon come to know,

verses.text: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged
verses.translation: when shackles will be round their necks, and chains. They will be dragged

verses.text: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].
verses.translation: into the hot water after which they will be thrown into the Fire as a fuel.

verses.text: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]
verses.translation: Then, it will be said to them, “Where are those whom you used to associate (in worship)

verses.text: Other than Allah ?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers.
verses.translation: beside Allah?” They will say, “They are lost to us, rather, we used to invoke nothing at all.” This is how Allah makes disbelievers get lost.

verses.text: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.
verses.translation: (It will be said to them,) “This is because you used to rejoice on the earth wrongfully, and because you used to show arrogance.

verses.text: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
