verses.translation: Enter the gates of Jahannam to live in it forever. So, how evil is the abode of the arrogant.

verses.text: So be patient, [O Muhammad]; indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.
verses.translation: Therefore, be patient. Surely, Allah’s promise is true. Then, (O Prophet,) whether We show you (in your life) a part of the promise We are making to them, or make you die (before they are punished), in any case they have to be returned to Us.

verses.text: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allah . So when the command of Allah comes, it will be concluded in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].
verses.translation: We had sent messengers before you. Among them there are those whose history We have narrated to you, and of them there are those whose history We did not narrate to you. And it is not up to a messenger that he could come up with a sign without permission from Allah. So, when the command of Allah will come, matters will stand decided justly, and on that occasion all adherents of falsehood will turn into losers.

verses.text: It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.
verses.translation: Allah is the One who made for you the cattle, so that you may ride some of them,- and of them you eat;

verses.text: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried.
verses.translation: and for you there are (other) benefits in them- and so that, (by riding) on them, you meet any need you have in your hearts; and on them and on boats you are carried.

verses.text: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allah do you deny?
verses.translation: He shows you His signs. Then, which of the signs of Allah would you (still) deny?

verses.text: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
verses.translation: Have they not traveled through the earth and seen how was the fate of those before them? Most of them were more in numbers than these, and superior in vigor and vestiges left on the earth. So then, whatever they used to earn did not work for them at all.

verses.text: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: When their messengers came to them with manifest signs, they exulted because of whatever knowledge they had, and they were encircled by what they used to ridicule.

verses.text: And when they saw Our punishment, they said," We believe in Allah alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."
verses.translation: When they saw Our punishment, they said, “We have (now) come to believe in Allah alone, and We have rejected everything we used to ascribe (to Him) as partners.”

verses.text: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allah which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].
verses.translation: But, their profession of faith was not (competent) to benefit them, once they had seen Our punishment - a customary practice of Allah that has been there all along in the matter of His servants - and hence, the disbelievers became the losers.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Hā Mīm

verses.text: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -
verses.translation: This is a revelation from the All-Merciful, the Very-Merciful-

verses.text: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur'an for a people who know,
verses.translation: - a book whose verses are elaborated in the form of an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who understand,

verses.text: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.
verses.translation: as a bearer of good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away, so they do not listen.

verses.text: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working."
verses.translation: And they say, “Our hearts are (wrapped) in covers against that (faith) to which you invite us, and there is deafness in our ears, and there is a barrier between you and us. So, do (in your way). We too are doing (in our own way)”.

verses.text: Say, O [Muhammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allah -
verses.translation: Say, “I am but a human being like you; it is revealed to me that your god is only One God. So, turn straight towards Him, and seek forgiveness from Him, and woe to the Mushriks (those who ascribe partners to Allah)

verses.text: Those who do not give zakah, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.
verses.translation: who do not pay Zakāh ; and of the life of the Hereafter, they are deniers.”

verses.text: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them there is a reward that will never be interrupted.

verses.text: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."
verses.translation: Say, “Do you really disbelieve in the One who has created the earth in two days, and ascribe to Him partners? That is the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: And He placed on the earth firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information] of those who ask.
verses.translation: He has placed firm mountains in it (the earth) towering above it, and put blessings in it, and proportioned its foods therein, in four days, equal for those who ask.

verses.text: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
verses.translation: Then He turned straight to the sky, while it was a smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come (to My obedience), both of you, willingly or unwillingly.” Both said, “We come willingly.”

verses.text: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.translation: So He accomplished them as seven skies in two days, and settled in every sky its (due) thing. And We have decorated the closest sky with lamps, and protected it properly. All this is the determination of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

verses.text: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] 'Aad and Thamud.
verses.translation: So, if they turn away, then say, “I have warned you of a calamity like the calamity of ‘Ād and Thamūd,

verses.text: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allah ." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."
verses.translation: when the messengers came to them from their front and from their rear, saying, “Do not worship anyone but Allah.” They said, “Had our Lord (really) willed (to send someone as messenger), He would have sent down angels. So, we are deniers of what you have been sent with.”

verses.text: As for 'Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.
verses.translation: As for ‘Ād, they showed arrogance in the land with no right (to do so), and said, “Who is stronger than us in power?” Did they not see that Allah, who created them, is stronger than them in power? And they used to reject Our signs.

verses.text: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.
verses.translation: So, We let loose a wild wind on them in unlucky days to make them taste the humiliating punishment in the present life. And of course, the punishment of the Hereafter will be much more humiliating, and they will not be helped.

verses.text: And as for Thamud, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.
verses.translation: As for Thamūd, We showed them the way, but they preferred blindness to the guidance. Therefore, they were seized by the bang of the abasing punishment because of what they used to earn.

verses.text: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah .
verses.translation: And We saved those who believed and used to be God-fearing.

verses.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows,
verses.translation: (Remind them of) the day when Allah’s enemies will be mustered towards the Fire. So they will be kept under control,

verses.text: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.
verses.translation: until when they will come to it, their ears and their eyes and their skins will testify against them about what they used to do.

verses.text: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah , who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.
verses.translation: And they will say to their skins, “Why did you testify against us?” They (the skins) will say, “We were made to speak by Allah, the One who has made every thing to speak.” And He had created you the first time, and to Him you are going to be returned.

verses.text: And you were not covering yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do.
verses.translation: And you had not been hiding your selves (when committing sins) from your ears and your eyes and your skins that would bear witness against you, but you thought that Allah did not know much of what you did.

verses.text: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."
verses.translation: This thought of yours that you conceived about your Lord brought you to ruin, and you became among the losers.

verses.text: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [ Allah ], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.
verses.translation: Now, if they endure patiently, even then the Fire is their abode, and if they seek forgiveness, they are not among those (who could be) forgiven.

verses.text: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
verses.translation: And We had assigned for them fellows (in the worldly life) who beautified for them what was before them and what was behind them. And (thus) the word (of punishment) became due against them along with the communities that passed before them from Jinns and human beings. Surely they were the losers.

verses.text: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur'an and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."
verses.translation: And said those who disbelieved, “Do not listen to this Qur’ān, and make noise during its recitation, so that you may overcome.”

verses.text: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.
verses.translation: So, We will certainly make them taste a severe punishment, and will certainly recompense them for the worst of what they used to do.

verses.text: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.
verses.translation: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah- the Fire. For them there is the eternal home, as a recompense for their persistent denial of Our verses.

verses.text: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest."
verses.translation: And those who disbelieve will say, “Our Lord, show us the two, out of the Jinns and the humans, who led us astray and we will put both of them under our feet, so that they become among the lowest.”

verses.text: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.
verses.translation: Surely, those who have declared: “Our Lord is Allah”, then remained steadfast, on them the angels will descend, saying, “Do not fear, and do not grieve; and be happy with the good news of the Jannah (Paradise) that you had been promised.

verses.text: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]
verses.translation: We have been your friends in the worldly life, and (will remain as such) in the Hereafter. And for you here is whatever your souls desire, and for you here is whatever you call for

verses.text: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.translation: - a gift of welcome from the Most-forgiving, the Very-Merciful”.

verses.text: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
verses.translation: Who can be better in words than the one who calls towards Allah, and acts righteously and says, “I am one of those who submit themselves (to Allah)”?

verses.text: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
verses.translation: Good and evil are not equal. Repel (evil) with what is best, and you will see that the one you had mutual enmity with him will turn as if he were a close friend.

verses.text: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
verses.translation: And no one is blessed with this (attitude) but those who observe patience, and no one is blessed with this (attitude) but a man of great luck.

verses.text: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah . Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.translation: And should a stroke from ShaiTān (Satan) strike you, seek refuge with Allah. Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.text: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to Allah , who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.
verses.translation: Among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves to the sun, or to the moon. And prostrate yourselves to Allah who has created them, if it is Him whom you worship.

verses.text: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.
verses.translation: Still, if they show arrogance, then those who are with your Lord proclaim His purity night and day, and they do not get weary.

verses.text: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
verses.translation: And among His signs is that you see the land inactive; then, once We send down water thereto, it gets excited and swells. Surely, the One who has given life to it is the One who gives life to the dead. No doubt, He is powerful to do everything.

verses.text: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
verses.translation: Surely those who adopt perversity about Our verses are not hidden from Us. So, tell me which one is better: the one who is thrown into the Fire, or the one who will come safely on the Day of Judgment? Do whatever you wish. He is watchful of whatever you do.

verses.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.
verses.translation: Surely those who have rejected the advice (the Qur’ān) when it came to them (are the ones who adopted perversity, and are not hidden from Us). And surely, it is an unassailable book

verses.text: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: that cannot be approached by falsehood, neither from its front, nor from its behind -a revelation from the All-Wise, the Ever-Praised.

verses.text: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.
verses.translation: Nothing is being said to you but what has been said to the messengers before you. Your Lord is certainly the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of painful punishment.

verses.text: And if We had made it a non-Arabic Qur'an, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.
verses.translation: Had We made it a non-Arabic Qur’ān, they would have said, “Why are its verses not clearly explained? Is it a non-Arabic (book) and an Arab (messenger)?” Say, “For those who believe, it is guidance and cure. As for those who do not believe, there is deafness in their ears, and for them it is blindness. Such people are being called from a distant place.”

verses.text: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.
verses.translation: And We gave Mūsā the book, then it was disputed (as well). But for a word that had already come from your Lord, the matter would have been decided between them. They are in confounding doubt about it.

verses.text: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.
verses.translation: If someone acts righteously, he does so for the benefit of his own soul, and if someone commits evil, he does so against it. Your Lord is not unjust to His servants.

verses.text: To him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."
verses.translation: To Him alone the knowledge of the Hour (the exact time of Doomsday) is to be referred. No fruits come out of their sheaths, nor does a female conceive a baby, nor does she deliver it, but with His knowledge. And (remember) the Day when He will call them: “Where are My partners?” They will say, “We declare to you that no one of us is to testify (that you have partners).”

verses.text: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.
verses.translation: And whatever they used to invoke earlier will vanish from them, and they will realize that they have no way to escape.

verses.text: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.
verses.translation: Man does not get weary of craving for (all sorts of ) good things; and if he is touched by some evil, he is disappointed, devoid of any hope.

verses.text: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.
verses.translation: And if We give him a taste of some mercy from Us after some hardship that has touched him, he will surely say, “This is my right. And I do not think the Hour (the Day of Judgment) is going to occur. And even if I am brought back to my Lord, I will surely have the best (life) with Him (too).”So, We will let the disbelievers know what they did, and let them taste a stern punishment.

verses.text: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.
verses.translation: When We bestow Our favor upon man, he avoids (to appreciate it) and keeps himself far aside (from obedience), and when some evil touches him, he is full of lengthy prayers.

verses.text: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an is from Allah and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"
verses.translation: Say (to the disbelievers), “Tell me, if it (the Qur’ān) is from Allah, and still you reject it, then who can be more erroneous than him who is (involved) in far reaching schism?”

verses.text: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?
verses.translation: We will show them Our signs in the universe and within their own beings until it will become manifest to them that it is the truth. Is it not enough about your Lord that He is witness to everything?

verses.text: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.
verses.translation: Beware, they are in doubt about meeting their Lord. Beware, He is the One who encompasses everything.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Hā Mīm

verses.text: 'Ayn, Seen, Qaf.
verses.translation: ‘Ain Sīn Qāf

verses.text: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: This is how Allah, the Mighty, the Wise, sends revelation to you and to those who were before you.

verses.text: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.
verses.translation: To him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and He is the High, the Supreme.

verses.text: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [ Allah ] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.translation: The heavens almost burst apart from their above side, and angels proclaim the purity and praise of their Lord, and pray for forgiveness of those on the earth. Be aware that Allah is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muhammad], are not over them a manager.
verses.translation: And those who have adopted patrons instead of Him, Allah is on watch against them, and you are not responsible for them.

verses.text: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur'an that you may warn the Mother of Cities [Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.
verses.translation: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān, so that you may warn the mother town, and those around it, and warn (them) of the Day of Gathering, about which there is no doubt-(when) one group of people will be in Paradise, and another group in blazing Fire.

verses.text: And if Allah willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.
verses.translation: Had Allah willed, He would have made all of them a single group; but He admits whomsoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, they have neither a patron nor a helper.

verses.text: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
verses.translation: Is it that they have adopted patrons instead of Him? So, it is Allah who is the Patron, and He gives life to the dead, and He is Powerful to do every thing.

verses.text: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allah . [Say], "That is Allah , my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."
verses.translation: And (Say O prophet to your opponents,) “Whatever dispute you have in any matter, its judgment lies with Allah. That One is Allah, the Lord of mine; in Him alone I have placed my trust, and to Him alone I turn (in every matter).”

verses.text: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.translation: He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you pairs from among yourselves, and pairs from the cattle. He makes you expand in this way. Nothing is like Him. And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

verses.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
verses.translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whomsoever He wills, and straitens (it for whomsoever He wills). Surely He is All-Knowing in respect of every thing.

verses.text: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].
verses.translation: He has ordained for you people the same religion as He had enjoined upon NūH, and that which We have revealed to you (O prophet,) and that which We had enjoined upon Ibrāhīm and Mūsā and ‘Īsā by saying, “Establish the religion, and be not divided therein.” Arduous for the mushriks (polytheists) is that to which you are inviting them. Allah chooses (and pulls) toward Himself anyone He wills, and guides to Himself anyone who turns to Him (to seek guidance).

verses.text: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.
verses.translation: And they were not divided, in jealousy with each other, but after the knowledge had come to them. Had it not been for a word that had come forth earlier from your Lord (and was effective) until a specified time, the matter would have been decided between them. And those who were made to inherit the Book after them are in confounding doubt about it.

verses.text: So to that [religion of Allah ] invite, [O Muhammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allah has revealed of the Qur'an, and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."
verses.translation: So, (O prophet,) towards that (faith) invite (people), and be steadfast as you are commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say, “I believe in whatever book Allah has sent down. And I have been ordered to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you, your deeds. There is no argumentation between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the final return.”

verses.text: And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
verses.translation: Those who argue about Allah after He has been responded to, their argument is void in the sight of their Lord, and upon them is wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

verses.text: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.
verses.translation: Allah is the One who has sent down the Book with truth, and the Balance as well. And what can let you know? May be, the Hour (the Day of Judgment) is near.

verses.text: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
verses.translation: Those who do not believe in it demand that it should come soon, and those who believe are fearful of it, and they know for sure that it is the truth. Be aware that those who dispute concerning the Hour are wandering afar from the right path.

verses.text: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
verses.translation: Allah is kind to His servants. He gives provision to whom He wills, and He is the Strong, the Mighty.

verses.text: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest. And whoever desires the harvest of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.
verses.translation: Whoever intends (to have) the harvest of the Hereafter, We will increase in his harvest; and whoever intends (to have) the harvest of the world (only), We will give him thereof, while in the Hereafter he will have no share.

verses.text: Or have they other deities who have ordained for them a religion to which Allah has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.
verses.translation: Is it that they have associate-gods who have prescribed for them a religion that is not sanctioned by Allah? Had it not been for a decisive word, the matter would have been decided between them (here in this world). And of course, for the wrongdoers there is a painful punishment (in the Hereafter).

verses.text: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
verses.translation: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they earned, and it is sure to befall them. As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they will be in meadows of the Gardens. For them there is, with their Lord, whatever they wish. That is the great bounty.

verses.text: It is that of which Allah gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for this message any payment [but] only good will through kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative.
verses.translation: That is the good news that Allah gives to His servants who believed and did righteous deeds. Say, “I do not ask you any fee for it, except the love of kinship.” And whoever performs a good act, We will increase for him goodness therein. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Appreciative.

verses.text: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allah a lie"? But if Allah willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.translation: Is it that they say, “He has forged a lie against Allah”? So, if Allah wills, He may put a seal on your heart. And Allah blots out falsehood and establishes truth with His words. Surely, He is fully aware of what lies in the hearts.

verses.text: And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
verses.translation: And He is the One who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives evil deeds and knows whatever you do.

verses.text: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.
verses.translation: And He responds to (the prayer of) those who believe and do righteous deeds, and gives them more out of His grace. As for the disbelievers, for them there is a severe punishment.

verses.text: And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.
verses.translation: Should Allah expand the provision for His servants (to its full extent), they would spread mischief on earth; but He sends down what He wills in (due) measure. Surely, with regard to His slaves, He is All-Aware, Ever-Watchful.

verses.text: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: And He is the One who sends down rain after they have lost hope, and He extends His mercy. And He is the Guardian, Worthy of all praise.

verses.text: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
verses.translation: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the creatures He has spread in them. He is Powerful to assemble them whenever He so wills.

verses.text: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
verses.translation: Whatever hardship befalls you is because of what your own hands have committed, while He overlooks many (of your faults).

verses.text: And you will not cause failure [to Allah ] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.
verses.translation: You are not able to frustrate (Him) in the earth. And, besides Allah, you have neither someone to protect, nor someone to help.

verses.text: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
verses.translation: And among His signs are ships in the sea, like mountains.

verses.text: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
verses.translation: If He so wills, He may stop the wind, and they stand still on its surface. Surely in this, there are signs for everyone who is ever patient, fully grateful.

verses.text: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
verses.translation: Or He may destroy them because of what they earned, and may overlook many (whom He may save at least in this world),

verses.text: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
verses.translation: and (in such an event) those who raise disputes in Our verses will come to know that there is no way for them to escape.

verses.text: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
verses.translation: So, whatever thing has been given to you is an enjoyment of the worldly life. And that which is with Allah is much better, and much more durable for those who believe and place their trust in Allah,

verses.text: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
verses.translation: and (for) those who abstain from the major sins and from shameful acts; and (for those who) when they get angry, they forgive,

verses.text: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
verses.translation: and those who have responded to their Lord (in submission to Him), and have established Salāh, and whose affairs are (settled) with mutual consultation between them, and who spend out of what We have given to them,

verses.text: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves,
verses.translation: and those who, when they are subjected to aggression, defend themselves.

verses.text: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allah . Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
verses.translation: The recompense of evil is evil like it. Then the one who forgives and opts for compromise has his reward undertaken by Allah. Surely, He does not like the unjust.

verses.text: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
verses.translation: The one who defends himself after having been wronged, there is no blame on such people.

verses.text: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
verses.translation: Blame, in fact, is upon those who wrong people and make mischief on earth unjustly. For such people there is a painful punishment.

verses.text: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination.
verses.translation: And if one observes patience and forgives, it is, of course, one of the courageous conducts.

verses.text: And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
verses.translation: The one whom Allah lets go astray, there is no one for him to protect thereafter. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they will see the punishment, that they will say, “Is there any way to be sent back (to the world)? ”

verses.text: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
verses.translation: And you will see them that they will be presented to it (the Fire), downcast because of humiliation, looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say, “The real losers are those who have lost their own selves and their families on the Day of Judgment.” Be aware that the wrongdoers are in lasting punishment.

verses.text: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah . And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way.
verses.translation: And for them there will not be any friends who may help them besides Allah. And the one whom Allah lets go astray, for him there is no way (to save himself).

verses.text: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.
verses.translation: Respond to your Lord before there comes a day for which there will be no reversal from Allah’s side. For you there will be neither a refuge that day, nor an opportunity to question (Allah about your fate).

verses.text: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
verses.translation: So, if they turn away, then We did not send you (O Prophet,) as a supervisor over them. You are not responsible but for conveying the message. And when We make man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices with it, and if an evil befalls him because of what their hands sent ahead, then man becomes ungrateful.

verses.text: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
verses.translation: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills. He grants females to whom He wills, and grants males to whom He wills.

verses.text: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
verses.translation: Or He combines for them couples, both males and females, and makes whom He wills barren. Surely, He is All-Knowing, Very-Powerful.

verses.text: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
verses.translation: It is not (possible) for a human being that Allah speaks to him, except by way of revelation, or from behind a curtain, or that He sends a messenger, and he reveals, with His permission, what He wills. Surely, He is All-High, All-Wise.

verses.text: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -
verses.translation: In similar way, We have revealed to you a Spirit from Our command. You did not know earlier what was the Book or what was Īmān (true faith), but We have made it (the Qur’ān) a light with which We guide whomsoever We will from among Our servants. And indeed you are guiding (people) to a straight path,

verses.text: The path of Allah , to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve.
verses.translation: the path of Allah, the One to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Be aware that towards Allah all matters shall finally return.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Hā Mīm.

verses.text: By the clear Book,
verses.translation: By the manifest Book,

verses.text: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
verses.translation: We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān, so that you may understand.

verses.text: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
verses.translation: And it is, in the Mother of the Book (the Preserved Tablet) with us, surely sublime, full of wisdom.

verses.text: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
verses.translation: Shall We then take the advice away from you because you are a transgressing people?

verses.text: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
verses.translation: How many a messenger We have sent to the earlier people!

verses.text: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.translation: No messenger came to them, but they used to mock at him.

verses.text: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
verses.translation: So We have destroyed those who were stronger than these (people of Makkah) in power, and the example of the earlier people has already passed.

verses.text: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
verses.translation: Should you ask them as to who has created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “They are created by the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing,”

verses.text: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
verses.translation: the One who has made the earth a cradle for you, and has made for you pathways therein, so that you may be guided,

verses.text: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
verses.translation: and the One who has sent down water from the sky in due measure. Then We have revived with it a dead town. In the same way, you will be brought forth (alive from the graves),

verses.text: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
verses.translation: and the One who has created all the pairs, and has made for you the boats and the cattle that you ride,

verses.text: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
verses.translation: so that you may mount upon their back, then recall the favour of your Lord after having mounted upon it and say, “Pure is the One who has subjugated this for us, and We were not able to have control over it,

verses.text: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
verses.translation: and of course, towards our Lord we have to return.”

verses.text: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
verses.translation: They have attributed to Him (that He is composed of) parts, (and that too) out of His servants. Surely, man is clearly ungrateful.

verses.text: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
verses.translation: Is it that He has adopted daughters from those whom He has created, and chosen you for (having) sons?

verses.text: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
verses.translation: When one of them is given the good news of (the birth of) that which he has attributed to RaHmān (i.e. the daughters), his face turns black, and he becomes choked with sorrow.

verses.text: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah ]?
verses.translation: Is it that (Allah has chosen) those (as His offspring) who are grown up in ornaments and who cannot express themselves in debate clearly?

verses.text: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
verses.translation: They have held angels, who are the servants of RaHmān, as females. Have they witnessed their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

verses.text: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
verses.translation: They say, “Had the RaHmān so willed, we would not have worshipped them.” They have no knowledge of that. They do nothing but make conjectures.

verses.text: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
verses.translation: Or have We given to them a book before this, and they are adhering to it?

verses.text: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
verses.translation: Instead, they say, “We have found our fathers on a certain way, and we are on their footprints, fully guided.”

verses.text: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
verses.translation: Similarly, We did not send a warner to a town before you, but its affluent people said, “We have found our fathers on a certain way, and we are following their footprints.”

verses.text: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
verses.translation: He said, “Even if I bring to you something better in guidance than that on which you have found your fathers?” They said, “We totally disbelieve in what you are sent with.”

verses.text: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
verses.translation: So, We took revenge from them. Now look, how was the end of those who rejected (Our messengers).

verses.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
verses.translation: (Recall) when Ibrāhīm said to his father and to his people, “I disown that which you worship,

verses.text: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
verses.translation: except the One who has originated me; so He will guide me.”

verses.text: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
verses.translation: He made it a word lasting among his posterity, so that they may return.

verses.text: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
verses.translation: But, I gave these and their fathers enjoyment, until the truth came to them, and a messenger as well who explains (it).

verses.text: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
verses.translation: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally disbelieve in it.”

verses.text: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
verses.translation: They say, “Why was this Qur’ān not revealed on a great man from (either of) the two towns?”

verses.text: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
verses.translation: Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? We have allocated among them their livelihood in the worldly life, and have raised some of them over others in ranks, so that some of them may put some others to work. And the mercy of your Lord is much better than what they accumulate.

verses.text: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
verses.translation: Were it not that all people would become of a single creed (i.e. disbelief), We would have caused, for those who disbelieve in RaHmān, roofs of their houses to be made of silver, and the stairs as well, on which they would climb,

verses.text: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
verses.translation: and doors of their homes, and the coaches on which they would recline,

verses.text: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
verses.translation: and (would have made some of these things) of gold-ornaments. And all this is nothing but an enjoyment of the worldly life. And the Hereafter, with your Lord, is (destined) for the God-fearing.

verses.text: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
verses.translation: Whoever makes himself blind against the advice of RaHmān, We assign for him a devil who accompanies him all the time.

verses.text: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
verses.translation: And they (the devils) prevent such people from the (right) way, while they deem themselves to be on the right path,

verses.text: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
verses.translation: until when such a person will come to us, he will say (to the devil), “Would that there were the distance of East and West between me and you, because you were the worst companion.”

verses.text: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
verses.translation: And (it will be said to such people,) “Since you were wrongdoers, it will never benefit you today that you are sharing the punishment with each other.”

verses.text: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
verses.translation: So, can you (O prophet) make the deaf to hear, or can you show the way to the blind and the one who is in open error?

verses.text: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
verses.translation: So, even if We take you away, We will surely take vengeance on them.

verses.text: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: Or (if) We show you (in your life) that (punishment) with which We have threatened them, then We have full control over them.

verses.text: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
verses.translation: So, hold fast to that which has been revealed to you. Surely, you are on the straight path.

verses.text: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
verses.translation: And certainly this (Qur’ān) is a word of honour for you and your people, and you will be questioned.

verses.text: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
verses.translation: Ask Our messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed gods to be worshipped besides RaHmān.

verses.text: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
verses.translation: We sent Mūsā with Our signs to Fir’aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs; so he said, “I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”

verses.text: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
verses.translation: So, when he came to them with Our signs, they at once started laughing at them.

verses.text: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
verses.translation: And We did not show them a sign, but it used to be greater than the one that preceded it. And We seized them with punishment, so that they may return.

verses.text: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
verses.translation: And they said, “O magician, pray for us to your Lord by the covenant He has made with you; we will certainly come to guidance.”

verses.text: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
verses.translation: Then, once We removed the punishment from them, in no time they broke their promise.

verses.text: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
verses.translation: And Fir’aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people, saying, “Does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers are flowing right underneath me? Do you, then, not discern?

verses.text: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
verses.translation: Or (do you not see that) I am much better than this one (Mūsā) who is worthless and can hardly express himself?

verses.text: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
verses.translation: So why were the bracelets of gold not sent down to him, or (why) did the angels not come along with him as companions?”

verses.text: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah ].
verses.translation: Thus he made fool of his people, and they obeyed him. Surely they were a sinful people.

verses.text: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
verses.translation: So, when they provoked Our anger, We took vengeance on them, and drowned them all together,

verses.text: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
verses.translation: and made them a people of the past, and an example for the later generations.

verses.text: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
verses.translation: When the example of the son of Maryam was cited, your people started at once shouting at it (in joy),

verses.text: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
verses.translation: and said, “Are Our gods better or is he?” They did not cite it (the example) but for the sake of disputation. Rather, they are a quarrelsome people.

verses.text: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
verses.translation: He (‘Īsā) is no more than a servant (of Allah) whom We favoured and made an example for the children of Isrā’īl.

verses.text: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
verses.translation: And if We will, We may create angels from you who succeed you on the earth.

verses.text: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
verses.translation: And he (‘Īsā) is a source of knowledge of the Hour (the Day of Judgment); so do not be in doubt about it, and follow me. This is the straight way.

verses.text: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
verses.translation: And let not the ShaiTān (Satan) prevent you (from following this way). He is surely an open enemy for you.

verses.text: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: When ‘Īsā came with clear proofs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to explain to you some of those matters in which you differ. So, fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
verses.translation: Surely, it is Allah who is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is the straight way.”

verses.text: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
verses.translation: Then different groups, out of them, fell into disagreement. Woe to the wrongdoers because of the punishment of a painful day!

verses.text: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
verses.translation: They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they would not even imagine (it).

verses.text: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
verses.translation: Friends, on that day, will become enemies to one another, except the God-fearing,

verses.text: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
verses.translation: (to whom it will be said) “O my servants, there is no fear for you today, nor will you grieve-

verses.text: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
verses.translation: -O those (servants) who believed in Our signs, and remained obedient.

verses.text: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
verses.translation: - Enter the Paradise, you and your spouses, showered with bliss.”

verses.text: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
verses.translation: Circulated among them will be the bowls of gold, and glasses. And there will be whatever souls desire and that which eyes enjoy. “And you will be living in it for ever.

verses.text: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
verses.translation: That is the Paradise you are made to inherit because of what you used to do.

verses.text: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
verses.translation: For you there are fruits in abundance from which you will eat.”

verses.text: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
verses.translation: The sinners (on the other hand) will be in the punishment of Jahannam (Hell), living there forever.

verses.text: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
verses.translation: It will not be lightened for them, and they will be there, devoid of all hopes.

verses.text: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: We did not do injustice to them, rather, they themselves were the unjust.

verses.text: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
verses.translation: And they will call (Mālik, the keeper of the Hell,) “O Mālik, let your Lord do away with us.” He will say, “You have to stay on.”

verses.text: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
verses.translation: (O disbelievers,) indeed We have brought to you the truth, but it is the truth that most of you detest.

verses.text: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
verses.translation: Is it that they have firmly resolved to do something (harmful to Our messenger)? Then, We have firmly resolved (to frustrate their plan.)

verses.text: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
verses.translation: Do they think that We do not hear their secrets and their whispers? Yes of course, Our messengers (angels) are with them who record (whatever they plan).

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
verses.translation: Say, “Had there been a son for the RaHmān, I would have been the first to worship.”

verses.text: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.translation: Pure is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from what they attribute (to Him).

verses.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
verses.translation: So, let them indulge (in their fallacy) and play, until they face their Day that they are promised.

verses.text: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
verses.translation: He is the One who is God to be worshipped in the sky, and God to be worshipped on the earth. And He is the Wise, the All-Knowing.

verses.text: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
verses.translation: Glorious is the One to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and towards Him you are to be returned.

verses.text: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
verses.translation: And those whom they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede; but those who bear witness to the truth, while they have knowledge (may intercede for the believers with Allah’s permission).

verses.text: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, " Allah ." So how are they deluded?
verses.translation: And if you ask them as to who has created them, they will certainly say, “Allah”. Then, to where are they driven back (by their false desires)?

verses.text: And [ Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
verses.translation: And (Allah has the knowledge) of his (prophet’s) saying, “O my Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”

verses.text: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
verses.translation: So, turn away from them, and say, “Salām !” (good-bye!). Then, soon they will come to know (the end of their attitude).

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Hā Mīm .

verses.text: By the clear Book,
verses.translation: By the manifest Book,

verses.text: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
verses.translation: We have sent it down in a blessed night, (because) We had to warn (people).

verses.text: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
verses.translation: In that (night), every wise matter is allocated

verses.text: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
verses.translation: through a command from Us. We were to send the Messenger

verses.text: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.translation: as a mercy from your Lord, -Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing-

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever there is between them, if you are to believe.

verses.text: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
verses.translation: There is no god, but He. He gives life and brings death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

verses.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
verses.translation: But they, being in doubt, are playing around.

verses.text: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
verses.translation: So, wait for a day when the sky will come up with a visible smoke

verses.text: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
verses.translation: that will envelop people. This is a painful punishment.

verses.text: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
verses.translation: (Then they will say,) “O our Lord, remove from us the punishment; we will truly believe.”

verses.text: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
verses.translation: How will they take lesson, while there has already come to them a messenger making things clear?

verses.text: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
verses.translation: Then they turned away from him, and said, “(He is) tutored, crazy.”

verses.text: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
verses.translation: (Well,) We are going to remove the punishment for a while, (but) you will certainly go back (to your original position).

verses.text: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
verses.translation: (Then,) the day We will seize (you) with the greatest seizure, We will take vengeance.

verses.text: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
verses.translation: And We tested the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) prior to them, and a noble messenger came to them

verses.text: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah . Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
verses.translation: saying, “Deliver to me the servants of Allah. I am an honest messenger to you,”

verses.text: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah . Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
verses.translation: and saying, “Do not be haughty against Allah. I bring to you a clear proof.

verses.text: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
verses.translation: And I have sought refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death.

verses.text: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
verses.translation: And if you do not believe in me, then keep away from me.”

verses.text: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
verses.translation: Then he prayed to his Lord saying, “These are a guilty people.”

verses.text: [ Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
verses.translation: (So, Allah answered his prayer saying,) “Now, take away my servants at night. You will certainly be chased,

verses.text: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
verses.translation: and leave the sea in the state of stillness; they are an army that is sure to be drowned.”

verses.text: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
verses.translation: How many gardens and fountains have they left behind-

verses.text: And crops and noble sites
verses.translation: - and how many fields and noble sites,

verses.text: And comfort wherein they were amused.
verses.translation: and how many a luxury they used to rejoice in!

verses.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
verses.translation: This is how it happened. And We made other people inherit all this.

verses.text: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
verses.translation: So, neither the sky and earth wept over them, nor were they given a respite.

verses.text: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
verses.translation: And We delivered the children of Isrā’īl from the humiliating punishment,

verses.text: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
verses.translation: from Fir‘aun. Indeed, he was haughty, one of the transgressors.

verses.text: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
verses.translation: And We chose them, with knowledge, above all the worlds.

verses.text: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
verses.translation: And We gave them the clear signs in which there was a manifest blessing.

verses.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
verses.translation: These people say,

verses.text: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
verses.translation: “There is nothing more than our first death, and we are not going to be resurrected.

verses.text: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: So, (O believers,) bring our fathers, if you are true (in your belief in resurrection.)”

verses.text: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
verses.translation: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those who were before them? We have destroyed them. They were guilty indeed.

verses.text: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
verses.translation: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them just as players.

verses.text: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: We did not create them but with true purpose, but most of them do not know.

verses.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
verses.translation: The Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them-

verses.text: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
verses.translation: the day when no close relation will be of any use to any close relation, nor will they be helped,

verses.text: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: except the One on whom Allah has mercy. Of course, He is the All-Mighty, the Very-Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
verses.translation: Indeed the tree of zaqqūm

verses.text: Is food for the sinful.
verses.translation: is the food of the sinful,

verses.text: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
verses.translation: like dregs of oil. It will boil in the bellies

verses.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.
verses.translation: like the boiling of hot water.

verses.text: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
verses.translation: (It will be said to angels,) “Seize him, and drag him into the midst of the Hell.

verses.text: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
verses.translation: Then pour on his head some torment of boiling water.”

verses.text: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
verses.translation: “Have a taste! You are the ‘man of might’, the ‘man of honour’.

verses.text: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
verses.translation: This is the thing about which you used to be skeptic.”

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
verses.translation: Indeed the God-fearing will be in a place free from fear,

verses.text: Within gardens and springs,
verses.translation: in gardens and fountains.

verses.text: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
verses.translation: They will be dressed in fine silk and thick silk, facing each other.

verses.text: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.translation: Thus (it will happen,) and We will marry them with houris having big dark eyes.

verses.text: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
verses.translation: They will call therein for every fruit peacefully.

verses.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
verses.translation: They will not taste death therein beyond the first death (they faced in the world). And He (Allah) will save them from the torment of Hell,

verses.text: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
verses.translation: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great achievement.

verses.text: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
verses.translation: So, We had made it (the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue, so that they may take lesson.

verses.text: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
verses.translation: Now wait. They too are waiting.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Hā Mīm .

verses.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: This is revelation of the Book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.text: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
verses.translation: Surely in the heavens and the earth, there are signs for those who have faith.

verses.text: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
verses.translation: And in your creation and in the living beings that He scatters on the earth, there are signs for a people who believe.

verses.text: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
verses.translation: And in the alternation of the day and the night, and in the provision He has sent down from the sky, then has revived the earth after its death, and in changing of the winds, there are signs for a people who understand.
