verses.text: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
verses.translation: These are Allah’s verses that We recite to you rightly. Then, in which discourse, after Allah and His verses, will they believe?

verses.text: Woe to every sinful liar
verses.translation: Woe to every sinful liar,

verses.text: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
verses.translation: who hears Allah’s verses being recited to him, then he remains adamant out of arrogance, as if he never heard them. So give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment.

verses.text: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
verses.translation: When he learns about something of Our verses, he takes it as a laughing stock. For such people, there is a humiliating punishment.

verses.text: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
verses.translation: In front of them, there is Jahannam (Hell). And whatever they have earned will not be of any use to them, nor the patrons they have adopted instead of Allah. And for them, there is a horrible punishment.

verses.text: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
verses.translation: This is guidance, and those who reject the verses of their Lord, for them there is a painful punishment of the divine scourge.

verses.text: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.translation: Allah is the One who has subjugated for you the sea, so that the ships may sail in it with His command, and so that you may seek His grace, and so that you offer gratitude.

verses.text: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.translation: He has subjugated for you whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, all on His own. Surely in this there are signs for a people who reflect.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
verses.translation: Tell those who believe that they should forgive those who do not believe in Allah’s days, so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.

verses.text: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
verses.translation: Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own benefit, and who does evil, it is against his own soul. Then towards your Lord, you will be returned.

verses.text: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
verses.translation: We gave the children of Isrā’īl the book and the wisdom and the prophet-hood, and provided them with good things, and preferred them above all (people of) the world,

verses.text: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.translation: and We gave them clear proofs of the Matter (i.e. the religion). So they did not fall into disagreement out of mutual jealousy, but after the knowledge had come to them. Surely your Lord will judge between them, on the Day of Judgment, in the matters in which they used to differ.

verses.text: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
verses.translation: Then We have put you on a certain way of the Matter (i.e. the religion); so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.

verses.text: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
verses.translation: They will never help you against Allah in the least. The wrongdoers are friends to one another, and Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.

verses.text: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
verses.translation: These are insights for the people, and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

verses.text: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
verses.translation: Do those who have committed evils assume that We will make them like those who believe and do righteous deeds, so as their life and death becomes equal? Evil is what they judge.

verses.text: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
verses.translation: Allah has created the heavens and the earth with just purpose, and so that everybody is recompensed for what he (or she) earned, and they will not be wronged.

verses.text: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah ? Then will you not be reminded?
verses.translation: So, have you seen him who has taken his desires as his god, and Allah has let him go astray, despite having knowledge, and has sealed his ear and his heart, and put a cover on his eye? Now who will guide him after Allah? Still, do you not take lesson?

verses.text: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
verses.translation: And they say, “There is no life but our worldly life. We die and live, and nothing destroys us except time.” They have no knowledge about that; they do nothing but make conjectures.

verses.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, their argument is none but that they say, “Bring our fathers, if you are truthful.”

verses.text: Say, " Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
verses.translation: Say, “Allah gives you life, then makes you die, then He will assemble you on the Day of Judgement in which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know.

verses.text: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
verses.translation: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. The day the Hour will take place, it will be the day in which the adherents of falsehood shall lose,

verses.text: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
verses.translation: and you will see every community kneeling down. Every community will be called to its book (of record). Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

verses.text: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
verses.translation: This is Our book that speaks against you with truth. We used to get recorded all that you used to do.

verses.text: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
verses.translation: Then, as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His mercy. That is indeed the achievement, visible to all.

verses.text: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
verses.translation: And as to those who disbelieved, (it will be said to them,) “Had My verses not been recited to you? But you showed arrogance, and you were a guilty people;

verses.text: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "
verses.translation: and when it was said to you that Allah’s promise is true and there is no doubt in the (arrival of the) Hour, you used to say, ‘We do not know what the Hour is. We do not think (about it) but as an assumption, and we are not sure.’”

verses.text: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: And revealed to them will be the evils of what they did, and encircled they will be by what they used to ridicule.

verses.text: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
verses.translation: It will be said, “Today We will forget you, as you forgot facing this your day, and your abode is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers at all.

verses.text: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [ Allah ].
verses.translation: That is because you took Allah’s verses as a laughing stock, and the worldly life deceived you.” So today they will neither be brought out of it, nor will they be asked to repent.

verses.text: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: So, to Allah belongs all praise, who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: And to Him belongs majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Hā Mīm .

verses.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: This is revelation of the book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.text: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth but with true purpose and for a specified term. But those who disbelieve are averse to what they are warned of.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah ? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: Say, “Tell me about those whom you invoke instead of Allah, (and) show me what they have created from the earth; Or have they a share in (the creation of) the heavens? Bring to me a book (revealed) before this one, or a trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”

verses.text: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
verses.translation: Who is more astray than him who invokes, instead of Allah, those who will not respond to him up to the Day of Judgement; and they are totally unaware of their prayers,

verses.text: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
verses.translation: and when people will be assembled (on the Day of Judgment), they will be enemies to them, and will refuse even their having worshipped them.

verses.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say about the truth when it comes to them, “This is an open magic.”

verses.text: Or do they say, "He has invented it?" Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful."
verses.translation: Is it that they say, “He has forged it (the Qur’ān)”? Say, “If I have forged it, then you do not have any power to help me against Allah. He is well aware of what you are engaged in. He is enough as a witness between me and you, and He is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.”

verses.text: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
verses.translation: Say, “I am not something unprecedented among the messengers, and I do not know what will be done to me or to you. I do not follow anything but what is revealed to me, and I am only a clear warner.”

verses.text: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah , and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant... ?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
verses.translation: Say, “Tell me, If it (the Qur’ān) is from Allah and you reject it, and a witness from the children of Isrā’īl testifies about something similar to it and comes to believe (in it), while you persist in your arrogance, (then, how unjust you are!) Surely, Allah does not give guidance to the unjust people.

verses.text: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
verses.translation: The disbelievers say about the believers, “Had it (Islamic faith) been a good thing, these (weak and poor) people would not have preceded us (in proceeding) towards it.” Since they did not accept guidance through it (the Qur’ān), they will say, “This is a classical lie.”

verses.text: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
verses.translation: And before this there was the Book of Mūsā, a guide and a mercy. And this is a Book confirming (it) in Arabic tongue, so that it may warn the wrongdoers and give good news to those who are good in their deeds.

verses.text: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah ," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.translation: Surely, those who say, “Our Lord is Allah” and then stay firm, they will have no fear, nor shall they grieve.

verses.text: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
verses.translation: Those are the people of Paradise, who will live there for ever as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.text: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
verses.translation: And We have enjoined upon man to do good to his parents. His mother carried him with difficulty and delivered him with difficulty. And his carrying and his weaning is (in) thirty months, until when he attains his maturity and reaches forty years, he says, “My Lord, grant me that I offer gratitude for the favour You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and that I do righteous deeds that You like. And set righteousness, for my sake, in my progeny. Of course, I repent to you, and truly I am one of those who submit to You.”

verses.text: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
verses.translation: Such are the people from whom We accept the best of what they did, and overlook their evil deeds, (so as they will be) among the people of Paradise according to the true promise that was made to them.

verses.text: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allah for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former people" -
verses.translation: And (Contrary to this is the case of) the one who said to his parents, “Fie upon you both! Do you promise to me that I shall be brought out (from the grave), while generations have passed before me?” And they (the parents) were crying for Allah’s help, (and saying to their son,) “Woe to you. Accept the true faith. Allah’s promise is certainly true.” Then he says, “This is nothing but the tales of the ancients.”

verses.text: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
verses.translation: Such are the people on whom the word (of punishment) has come true along with the communities of the Jinn and the humans that have passed before them. Surely they were losers.

verses.text: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
verses.translation: For each (of these two groups) there are (different) ranks because of what they did, and so that He may repay them in full for their deeds; and they will not be wronged.

verses.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
verses.translation: And the day the disbelievers will be presented before the Fire, (it will be said to them,) “You have consumed your good things in your worldly life, and have enjoyed them. So, you will be punished today with the torment of humiliation for the arrogance you used to show on earth with no right (to do so), and for the sins you used to commit.

verses.text: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah . Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.translation: And recall the brother of (the nation of) ‘Ād, when he warned his people at the long, curved sand dunes- while many warners have passed before him and after him (with the same message)-saying, “Do not worship anyone except Allah. Surely I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day.”

verses.text: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: They said, “Have you come to make us deviate from our gods? So bring us that with which you are threatening us, if you are truthful.”

verses.text: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allah , and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
verses.translation: He said, “The knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am conveying to you what I am sent with, but I see you are a people who act ignorantly.”

verses.text: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
verses.translation: So, when they saw it as a cloud proceeding towards their valleys, they said, “This is a cloud that will bring us rain.” No, it is the very thing you asked to hasten up - a wind in which there is a painful punishment,

verses.text: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
verses.translation: that will destroy every thing with the command of its Lord! So they became such that nothing remained to be seen except their dwelling places. This is how We punish the guilty people.

verses.text: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allah ; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: And indeed We had established them in a powerful position in which We did not establish you (O people of Makkah), and had given to them ears and eyes and hearts, but neither their ears benefited them in the least, nor their eyes, nor their hearts, as they used to reject Allah’s signs; and they were encircled by what they used to ridicule.

verses.text: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].
verses.translation: And We have (also) destroyed (other) towns around you, while We had given to them a variety of signs, so that they might return (from disbelief).

verses.text: Then why did those they took besides Allah as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.
verses.translation: So, why is it that they were not helped by those whom they had taken as gods beside Allah in order to attain closeness (to Him)? Instead, they vanished from them. That was, in fact, their falsity and a thing they used to fabricate.

verses.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur'an. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen quietly." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
verses.translation: And (recall) when We directed a group of Jinns towards you, listening to the Qur’ān. So, when they attended it, they said (to each other), “Keep quiet.” Then once it was over, they went back to their people as warners.

verses.text: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
verses.translation: They said, “O our people, we have heard a book sent down after Mūsā, confirming what was before it, which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

verses.text: O our people, respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him; Allah will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
verses.translation: O our people, respond to Allah’s herald, and believe in him, and (once you do that,) Allah will forgive your sins for you, and will save you from a painful punishment.

verses.text: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allah will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
verses.translation: The one who does not respond to Allah’s herald is not (able) to frustrate (Allah by escaping) in the land, and for him there are no supporters besides Him. Such people are in open error.

verses.text: Do they not see that Allah , who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
verses.translation: Have they not seen that Allah who has created the heavens and the earth, and was not wearied by their creation, does have power to give life to the dead? Yes of course, He is powerful to do every thing.

verses.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."
verses.translation: The day the disbelievers will be presented to the Fire, (it will be said to them,) “Is this not true?” They will say, “Yes of course, Our Lord!” He will say, “Then taste the punishment, for you used to disbelieve.”

verses.text: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
verses.translation: So, (O prophet,) observe patience, as the resolute messengers observed patience, and be not in haste about them. The Day they will see what they are promised, (it will be) as if they did not stay (in the world) more than an hour in a single day. This is a message. So, none will be destroyed except the sinners.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved, and prevented (others) from Allah’s way, He (Allah) has rendered their deeds vain.

verses.text: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.
verses.translation: And those who believed and did righteous deeds and believed in that which is revealed to MuHammad,-and it is the truth (that has come) from their Lord-He will write off their evil deeds, and will set aright their state of affairs.

verses.text: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.
verses.translation: That is because the disbelievers have followed falsehood, while the believers have followed the truth (that has come) from their Lord. This is how Allah explains their (respective) situations to the people.

verses.text: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.
verses.translation: So, when you encounter those who disbelieve, then (aim at) smiting the necks, until when you have broken their strength thoroughly, then tie fast the bond, (by making them captives). Then choose (to release them) either (as) a favour (shown to them,), or (after receiving) ransom,until the war throws down its load of arms. That (is Our command.) If Allah willed, He would have (Himself) subjected them to retribution, but (Allah ordered you to fight,) so that He may test some of you through some others. And those who are killed in Allah’s way, He will never let their deeds go to waste.

verses.text: He will guide them and amend their condition
verses.translation: (Instead,) He will guide them, and will set aright their state of affairs,

verses.text: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
verses.translation: and will admit them to the Paradise He has identified for them.

verses.text: O you who have believed, if you support Allah , He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
verses.translation: O you who believe, if you will help (the religion prescribed by) Allah, He will help you, and will stabilize your footings.

verses.text: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.
verses.translation: As for those who disbelieve, (destined) for them is destruction, and He has rendered their deeds vain.

verses.text: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
verses.translation: That is because they hate what Allah has sent down; therefore Allah has nullified their deeds.

verses.text: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.
verses.translation: Have they not travelled in the land so that they might see how was the end of those before them? Allah brought utter destruction to them. And (ready) for (these) disbelievers are the likes thereof.

verses.text: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.
verses.translation: That is because Allah is the supporter of those who believe. As for the disbelievers, there is no supporter for them.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.
verses.translation: Surely, Allah will admit those who believe and do good deeds to the gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy (the worldly life), and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire is the final abode for them.

verses.text: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.
verses.translation: How many a town, stronger in might than your town that has expelled you, have We destroyed! Then, there was none to help them.

verses.text: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
verses.translation: Then, can one who holds on to a clear proof from his Lord be like those for whom their evil deeds are beautified, and who followed their desires?

verses.text: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
verses.translation: (Here is) a description of the Paradise that is promised for the God-fearing! In it there are rivers of water, never spoiling, and rivers of milk the taste of which would not go bad, and rivers of wine, delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of honey, fully purified. And for them there are all sorts of fruits, and forgiveness from their Lord. Are they like those who will live in Fire forever, and will be given boiling water to drink, and it will tear their bowels into pieces?

verses.text: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.
verses.translation: Among them there are ones who (pretend to) give ear to you, until when they go out from your presence, they say to those who have been given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are the ones on whose hearts Allah has put a seal, and they have followed their desires.

verses.text: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.
verses.translation: As for those who have adopted right path, Allah improves them in guidance, and gives them their piety.

verses.text: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?
verses.translation: They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour (of Doom) that it should come upon them suddenly. So, its signs have already come. Then, once it will come upon them, how would they have an opportunity to accept the advice (already) given to them?

verses.text: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.
verses.translation: So, be assured that there is no god but Allah, and seek forgiveness for your fault, and for (the faults of) the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows your moving from place to place and your permanent abode.

verses.text: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]
verses.translation: And the believers say, “Why has a (new) Sūrah not been revealed?” Then, once an operative Sūrah is sent down, and fighting (in Allah’s way) is mentioned in it, you notice those who have disease in their hearts, looking to you like one who is faint because of death. So, destruction is very close to them.

verses.text: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah , it would have been better for them.
verses.translation: The (reality of their) obedience and (truthfulness of their) speech is fully known (as being mere deception). So, had they been truthful to Allah when the matter had become serious, it would have been much better for them.

verses.text: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
verses.translation: So, (O hypocrites,) do you not apprehend that, in case you turn away (from Jihād ), you will spread disorder in the land and will sever your ties of kinship?

verses.text: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.
verses.translation: Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed; so He has made them deaf, and made their eyes blind.

verses.text: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
verses.translation: Then, do they not give serious thought to the Qur’ān, or do they have locks on their hearts?

verses.text: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.
verses.translation: Surely those who turn back after the guidance has appeared to them clearly, it is Satan who has tempted them and involved them in far-fetched fancies.

verses.text: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal.
verses.translation: That is because they say to those who hate that which Allah has revealed, “We will obey you in some respects.” And Allah knows their secret talk.

verses.text: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
verses.translation: So, how (miserable) will they be when the angels will exact their souls, smiting their faces and their backs?

verses.text: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
verses.translation: That is because they followed that which has angered Allah, and they disliked His pleasure; therefore He has nullified their deeds.

verses.text: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
verses.translation: Do those having malady in their hearts think that Allah will never expose their grudges (against Islam)?

verses.text: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds.
verses.translation: Had We willed, We would have shown them to you (by identifying each one of them,) so as you would definitely recognize them by their features. However, you will recognize them by the tone of (their) speech. And Allah knows (all) your deeds.

verses.text: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah ] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.
verses.translation: And We will certainly test you until We know those of you who carry out Jihād (struggle in Allah’s way) and observe patience, and until We check your episodes.

verses.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve and prevent (others) from Allah’s way, and oppose the Messenger, after the Guidance has appeared to them clearly, shall never bring harm to Allah in the least, and He will render their deeds vain.

verses.text: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.
verses.translation: O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not nullify your deeds.

verses.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved and prevented (others) from Allah’s way, then died as disbelievers, Allah will never forgive them.

verses.text: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
verses.translation: So, do not lose heart, and do not appeal for peace; you will be the uppermost, and Allah is with you; and He will never deprive you of your deeds.

verses.text: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah , He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.
verses.translation: The worldly life is but play and pastime. If you believe and be God-fearing, He will give you your rewards, and will not ask you your riches.

verses.text: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness.
verses.translation: If He were to ask you of it, and press you (to spend all your wealth), you would show miserliness, and He would expose your disgusts.

verses.text: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
verses.translation: Yes, you are such that you are called upon to spend in Allah’s way, but some of you withhold in miserliness- and he who withholds in miserliness withholds against himself- and Allah is the Need-Free, and you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you by some other people, then they will not be like you.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest
verses.translation: Surely, We have granted you an open victory,

verses.text: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
verses.translation: so that Allah may forgive you of your previous and subsequent faults, and may complete His favour upon you, and may guide you to a straight path,

verses.text: And [that] Allah may aid you with a mighty victory.
verses.translation: and so that Allah may support you with a mighty support.

verses.text: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allah Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: He (Allah) is such that He sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers, so that they grow more in faith in addition to their (existing) faith- And to Allah belong the forces of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise-

verses.text: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allah , a great attainment -
verses.translation: so that He admits believing men and believing women to the gardens beneath which rivers flow, to live therein for ever, and so that He may write off their evil deeds, which is a great achievement in Allah’s sight,

verses.text: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allah an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allah has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.
verses.translation: and so that He may punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the mushriks (polytheists), men and women, who think evil thoughts about Allah. Bound for them there is a vicious circle, and Allah has become angry with them, and He has prepared Jahannam (Hell) for them, and it is an evil destination.

verses.text: And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.translation: To Allah belong the forces of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

verses.text: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
verses.translation: Indeed, We have sent you (O prophet,) as a witness and as a bearer of good news and as a warner,

verses.text: That you [people] may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect the Prophet and exalt Allah morning and afternoon.
verses.translation: so that you (O people,) believe in Allah and His Messenger, and support him and revere him, and pronounce His (Allah’s) purity morning and evening.

verses.text: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muhammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allah . The hand of Allah is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allah - He will give him a great reward.
verses.translation: Those who pledge allegiance with you (by placing their hands in your hand)- they, in fact, pledge allegiance with Allah. Allah’s hand is over their hands. Then, whoever breaks his pledge breaks it to his own detriment, and whoever fulfils the covenant he has made with Allah, He will give him a great reward.

verses.text: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allah at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allah , with what you do, Acquainted.
verses.translation: Those of the Bedouins who remained behind will say to you, “Our possessions and our families kept us busy, (hence we could not accompany you in your journey to Hudaibiyah). So, pray to Allah for our forgiveness.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts.Say, “Then, who has power to help you in any thing against Allah, if He intends to do you harm, or intends to do you good? Rather, Allah is fully aware of what you do.

verses.text: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."
verses.translation: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never ever return to their families, and it seemed good to your hearts, and you thought an evil thought and became a people who are ruined (by their selfishness).”

verses.text: And whoever has not believed in Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.
verses.translation: If one does not believe in Allah and His Messenger, then We have prepared a blazing fire for the disbelievers.

verses.text: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomsoever He wills, and punishes whomsoever He wills. And Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allah . Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allah say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.
verses.translation: Those who remained behind will say, when you will proceed to the spoils (of war) to receive them, “Let us follow you.”They wish to change the words of Allah. Say, “You shall not follow us. Allah had said like this beforehand.” Then they will say, “No, but you are jealous of us.” On the contrary, they do not understand (the reality) but a little.

verses.text: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
verses.translation: Say to those of the Bedouins who remained behind, “You will be called against a people possessed of strong fighting power; you will have to fight them until they submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward, and if you turn away, as you had turned away earlier, He will punish you with a painful punishment.

verses.text: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
verses.translation: There is no blame on the blind, nor is there any blame on the lame, nor is there any blame on the sick. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, He will admit him to the gardens beneath which rivers flow. But whoever turns away, He will punish him with a painful punishment.

verses.text: Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muhammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
verses.translation: Allah was pleased with the believers when they were pledging allegiance with you (by placing their hands in your hands) under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them, and rewarded them with a victory, near at hand,

verses.text: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.translation: and many spoils that they would receive. And Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.text: Allah has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.
verses.translation: Allah had promised you many spoils that you would receive, so He gave these to you sooner, and stopped the hands of the people from (harming) you. And (He did this) so that it becomes a sign for believers, and so that He guides you to the right path.

verses.text: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allah has already encompassed. And ever is Allah , over all things, competent.
verses.translation: And (there is) another (victory) that has not come within your power as yet, (but) Allah has encompassed it. And Allah is Powerful over every thing.

verses.text: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
verses.translation: Had the disbelievers fought you, they would have certainly turned their backs, then they would have found neither a supporter nor a helper-

verses.text: [This is] the established way of Allah which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allah any change.
verses.translation: - according to the consistent practice of Allah that went on since before, and you will never find a change in Allah’s consistent practice.

verses.text: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allah of what you do, Seeing.
verses.translation: And He is the One who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Makkah after He had let you prevail over them, and Allah is watchful over what you do.

verses.text: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
verses.translation: They are those who disbelieved and prevented you from the Sacred Mosque (Al-Masjid-ul-Harām ), and (prevented) the sacrificial animals that were detained from reaching their due place. And (Allah would have allowed you to fight,) had there not been believing men and believing women whom you did not know that you might have trampled them, and thus a painful situation might have arisen for you because of them unknowingly; (This situation was avoided) so that Allah may admit to His mercy whom He wills.And if they (the believing men and women) had moved (from Makkah), We would surely have punished those of them who disbelieved with a painful punishment.

verses.text: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allah , of all things, Knowing.
verses.translation: When the disbelievers developed in their hearts indignation, the indignation of ignorance; then Allah sent down tranquility from Himself upon His Messenger and upon the believers, and made them stick to the word of piety, and they were very much entitled to it and competent for it. And Allah is All-Knowing about every thing.

verses.text: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah has made true to His Messenger the dream (shown) with truth: You will definitely enter the Sacred Mosque inshā’allāh (if Allah wills,) peacefully, with your heads shaved, and your hairs cut short, having no fear. So He knew what you did not know, and He assigned before that a victory, near at hand.

verses.text: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.
verses.translation: He is the One who has sent His Messenger with Guidance and the religion of truth, so that He makes it prevail over all religions. And enough is Allah for being a witness (to His promise).

verses.text: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.translation: Muhammad(ﷺ) is the messenger of Allah, and those who are with him are hard on the disbelievers, compassionate among themselves; you will see them bowing down in Rukū‘, prostrating themselves in Sajdah, seeking grace from Allah, and (His) good pleasure; their distinguishing feature is on their faces from the effect of Sajdah (prostration). This is their description in Torah; and their description in Injīl is: like a sown crop that brings forth its shoot, then makes it strong, then it grows thick and stands straight on its stem, looking good to the farmers, so that He may enrage the disbelievers through them. Allah has promised forgiveness and a huge reward to those of them who believe and do good deeds.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah . Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.translation: O you who believe, do not proceed ahead of Allah and His Messenger, and fear Allah. Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

verses.text: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
verses.translation: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and be not loud when speaking to him, as you are loud when speaking to one another, lest your good deeds should become void while you are not aware.

verses.text: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
verses.translation: Surely, those who lower their voices before Allah’s Messenger are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for piety; for them there is forgiveness, and a great reward.

verses.text: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
verses.translation: As for those who call you from behind the chambers, most of them have no sense.

verses.text: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: Had they remained patient until you come out to them, it would have been much better for them. And Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
verses.translation: O you who believe, if a sinful person brings you a report, verify its correctness, lest you should harm a people out of ignorance, and then become remorseful on what you did.

verses.text: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah . If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
verses.translation: And know that among you there is the Messenger of Allah. If he obeys you in many a matter, you will certainly fall into hardship. But Allah has endeared to you the Faith, and made it beautiful in your hearts, and made detestable to you the disbelief and sins and disobedience. Such people are rightly guided,

verses.text: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: as a grace from Allah, and as a blessing. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.text: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah . And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.
verses.translation: If two groups of the believers fight each other, seek reconciliation between them. And if one of them commits aggression against the other, fight the one that commits aggression until it comes back to Allah’s command. So if it comes back, seek reconciliation between them with fairness, and maintain justice. Surely Allah loves those who maintain justice.

verses.text: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
verses.translation: All believers are but brothers, therefore seek reconciliation between your two brothers, and fear Allah, so that you may be blessed with mercy.

verses.text: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: O you who believe, no men should ever scoff at other men. May be, the latter are better than the former. Nor should women (ever scoff) at other women. May be, the latter women are better than the former ones. And do not find fault with one another, nor call one another with bad nicknames. Bad is the name of sinfulness after embracing Faith. If anyone does not repent, then such people are the wrongdoers.

verses.text: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah ; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
verses.translation: O you who believe, abstain from many of the suspicions. Some suspicions are sins. And do not be curious (to find out faults of others), and do not backbite one another. Does one of you like that he eats the flesh of his dead brother? You would abhor it. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is Most-Relenting, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.
verses.translation: O mankind, We have created you from a male and a female, and made you into races and tribes, so that you may identify one another. Surely the noblest of you, in Allah’s sight, is the one who is most pious of you. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.

verses.text: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.translation: The Bedouins say, “We have come to believe.” Say, “You have not come to believe; instead, you (should) say, ‘We have surrendered’ and the belief has not entered your hearts so far. If you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not curtail (the reward of) any of your deeds in the least. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.”

verses.text: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah . It is those who are the truthful.
verses.translation: Believers, in fact, are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger, then have no doubt, and struggle, with their riches and their lives, in the way of Allah. Those are the truthful.

verses.text: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"
verses.translation: Say, “Would you apprise Allah of your religion, while Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is All-Knowing about every thing?”

verses.text: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islam. Say, "Do not consider your Islam a favor to me. Rather, Allah has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: They oblige you that they have accepted Islam, (as if it was a favour shown to you). Say, “Do not oblige me for your accepting Islam. Rather, Allah makes you obliged for His having guided you to the Faith, if you are truthful.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
verses.translation: Surely Allah knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah keeps in sight whatever you do.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
verses.translation: Qāf . (I swear) by the glorious Qur’ān, (you are sent as a messenger.)

verses.text: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
verses.translation: But they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves; so the disbelievers said, “This is something strange.

verses.text: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
verses.translation: Is it when we die and become dust (that we will be brought to life again?) That is a return, far (from understanding).”

verses.text: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
verses.translation: We know very well how much of them is diminished by the earth, and We have a Book that Preserves every thing.

verses.text: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
verses.translation: Rather, they rejected the truth when it came to them; so they are in a confused state.

verses.text: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
verses.translation: Did they not, then, look to the sky above them, how We have built it and beautified it, and it has no cracks?

verses.text: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
verses.translation: As for the earth, We have spread it out, and cast on it firm hills, and caused to grow therein every kind of delightful things,

verses.text: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah ].
verses.translation: as a source of vision and as a lesson to every servant (of Allah) who turns (to Him for guidance).

verses.text: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
verses.translation: And We sent down blessed water from the sky, and caused to grow therewith gardens and grain of harvest,

verses.text: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
verses.translation: and towering date palms that have spadices, put one upon another,

verses.text: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
verses.translation: as a provision to the servants (of Allah). And We gave life with it to a dead land. Similar will be the exit (of the dead from their graves).

verses.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
verses.translation: It (resurrection) was rejected before them by the people of NūH, and the people of Rass and Thamūd,

verses.text: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
verses.translation: and ‘Ād, and Fir’aun (Pharaoh), and the brothers of LūT,

verses.text: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
verses.translation: and dwellers of Aaikah, and the people of Tubba’. Each one of them rejected the messengers; so My threat came true.

verses.text: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
verses.translation: Is it, then, that We were worn out by the first creation? No, but they are still in confusion about the new creation.

verses.text: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
verses.translation: Indeed We have created man, and We know whatever thoughts his inner self develops, and We are closer to him than (his) jugular vein,

verses.text: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
verses.translation: when the two receiving angels receive (every human act to record it), seated (one) on the right and (one) on the left.

verses.text: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
verses.translation: Not a single word is uttered by one but there is a watcher near him, ready (to record).

verses.text: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
verses.translation: The daze of death has (to) come with truth. That is what you tried to escape.

verses.text: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
verses.translation: And the Horn will be blown. That will be the day of (which) threat (was given).

verses.text: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
verses.translation: And everybody will come, along with one (angel) to drive (him to the field of reckoning) and one (angel) to testify (about his deeds).

verses.text: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
verses.translation: “You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil from you; so your sight today is sharp.”

verses.text: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
verses.translation: And his companion (i.e. the angel who recorded his deeds) will say, “This is what I have with me, ready (to be presented as his record of deeds).”

verses.text: [ Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
verses.translation: (Then it will be said,) “Cast, (O two angels,) into Jahannam (Hell) every obstinate disbeliever

verses.text: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
verses.translation: who used to prevent (others) from good (behavior), who transgressed all bounds, who cast doubts (in true faith),

verses.text: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
verses.translation: who set up another god along with Allah. So cast him (O angels) in the painful punishment.”

verses.text: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
verses.translation: His (evil) companion (i.e. the Satan) will say, “O our Lord, I did not cause him to rebel, but he was himself (involved) in straying far from the track.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
verses.translation: He (Allah) will say, “Do not quarrel before Me, while I had sent to you My threat well in advance.

verses.text: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
verses.translation: The Word is not changed with Me, and I Am not so unjust to My servants.”

verses.text: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
verses.translation: (Remind them of) the Day when We will say to Jahannam (Hell), “Are you filled up?” and it will say, “Are there some more?”

verses.text: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
verses.translation: And the Jannah (Paradise) will be brought close for the God-fearing, no longer distant.

verses.text: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah ] and keeper [of His covenant]
verses.translation: (And it will be said,) “This is what you were promised for everyone who was oft-returning to Allah, vigilant (against sins),

verses.text: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
verses.translation: the one who feared the RaHmān (The All-Merciful Allah), without seeing Him, and came up with a heart oriented towards Him.

verses.text: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
verses.translation: Enter it in peace. That is the Day of Eternity.”

verses.text: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
verses.translation: They will have in it whatever they wish, and with Us there are things even more than that.

verses.text: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
verses.translation: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger than these in their grip on power, and they searched out the cities. Was there any place (for them) to escape?

verses.text: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
verses.translation: Indeed, there is a lesson in all this for him who has a heart and gives ear (to the truth) attentively.

verses.text: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
verses.translation: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness even touched Us.

verses.text: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
verses.translation: So, (O Prophet,) endure with patience what they say, and proclaim His purity, along with your Lord’s praise, before sunrise and before sunset.

verses.text: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
verses.translation: And in hours of night, proclaim His purity, and at the ends of prostration.

verses.text: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
verses.translation: And listen: The Day when the caller will call out from a near place,

verses.text: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
verses.translation: the Day they will hear the Cry in reality- that will be the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
verses.translation: Surely We alone give life and bring death, and to Us is the final return

verses.text: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
verses.translation: on the Day when the earth will burst apart exposing them, while they will be hurrying up (to come out). That is an assembly, so easy for Us (to muster).

verses.text: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
verses.translation: We know well what they say, and you are not (sent) as one who compels them. So exhort, through the Qur’ān, the one who fears My warning.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
verses.translation: By those (winds) that scatter dust,

verses.text: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
verses.translation: then those that bear load (of clouds),

verses.text: And those [ships] sailing with ease
verses.translation: then those that float with ease,

verses.text: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
verses.translation: then those who distribute things,

verses.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
verses.translation: whatever you are being promised is surely true,

verses.text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
verses.translation: and Recompense (of deeds) is sure to happen.

verses.text: By the heaven containing pathways,
verses.translation: By the sky, having paths,

verses.text: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
verses.translation: you are (involved) in a contradictory discussion.

verses.text: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
verses.translation: Turned away from this (Qur’ān) is the one who is turned away (totally from the truth.)

verses.text: Destroyed are the falsifiers
verses.translation: Death upon those who make conjectures (against the true faith),

verses.text: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
verses.translation: - those who are drowned in ignorance, forgetful!

verses.text: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
verses.translation: They ask, “When shall be the Day of Recompense?”

verses.text: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
verses.translation: (It will be) the Day when they will be heated on the Fire,

verses.text: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
verses.translation: (and it will be said to them,) “Taste (the punishment of) your mischief. This is what you have been asking to be brought sooner.”

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
verses.translation: The God-fearing (on the other hand) will be in gardens and springs,

verses.text: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
verses.translation: receiving what their Lord will have given to them. Indeed, prior to this, they were good in their deeds.

verses.text: They used to sleep but little of the night,
verses.translation: They used to sleep little in the night;

verses.text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
verses.translation: and in the hours before dawn they used to pray for forgiveness,

verses.text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
verses.translation: and in their wealth, there was a right for one who asks and for one who is deprived.

verses.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
verses.translation: In the earth, there are signs for those who (seek truth to) believe,

verses.text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
verses.translation: and in your own selves! So, do you not perceive?

verses.text: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
verses.translation: And in the heavens, there is your sustenance and all that you have been promised.

verses.text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
verses.translation: So, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it (the Day of Recompense) is a reality, as sure as the fact that you (can) speak.

verses.text: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of the honoured guests of Ibrāhīm?

verses.text: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
verses.translation: When they (the angels in human form) entered unto him and said, “We greet you with Salām .” He said, “Salām on you.” (And he said to himself,) “(They are) unknown people.”

verses.text: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
verses.translation: Then he slipped off to his home and fetched a fattened calf.

verses.text: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
verses.translation: So he presented it before them (to eat, but being angels, they refrained.) He said, “Would you not eat?”

verses.text: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
verses.translation: So he felt some fear in his heart. They said, “Be not scared.” And they gave him the good news of (the birth of) a knowledgeable boy.

verses.text: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
verses.translation: So his wife came forward with a clamor, and slapped her own face and said, “(How can I have a child when I am) a barren old woman?”

verses.text: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
verses.translation: They said, “This is how your Lord has said. Surely, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
