verses.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
verses.translation: He (Ibrāhīm) said (to the angels), “Then, what is your mission O messengers?”

verses.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
verses.translation: They said, “We are sent to a guilty people, (i.e. the people of Sodom)

verses.text: To send down upon them stones of clay,
verses.translation: so that we may send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.text: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
verses.translation: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

verses.text: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
verses.translation: So, We let the believers who were there to come out (from danger),

verses.text: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
verses.translation: but We did not find in it any Muslims, except one house.

verses.text: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
verses.translation: And We left in this (event) a sign (of deterrence) for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.text: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
verses.translation: And (We left a similar sign) in (the story of) Mūsā, when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a clear proof.

verses.text: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
verses.translation: So he turned away along with his chiefs and said, “ (Mūsā is) a magician or a madman!”

verses.text: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
verses.translation: So We seized him and his army, and cast them into the sea, as he was of culpable behaviour.

verses.text: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
verses.translation: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) ‘Ād, when We sent upon them the wind that was barren (from any benefit);

verses.text: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
verses.translation: it spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like a stuff smashed by decay.

verses.text: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
verses.translation: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) Thamūd, when it was said to them, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”

verses.text: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
verses.translation: Then they rebelled against the command of your Lord; so the thunderbolt (of divine punishment) seized them, while they were looking on.

verses.text: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
verses.translation: Then they were neither able to stand (before the punishment), nor could they defend themselves.

verses.text: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: And (We have destroyed) the people of NūH even before; indeed they were a sinful people.

verses.text: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
verses.translation: And the sky was built by Us with might; and indeed We are the expanders.

verses.text: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
verses.translation: And the earth was spread out by Us as a floor; so how well have We spread it out!

verses.text: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
verses.translation: And from every thing We have created pairs of twos, so that you may heed.

verses.text: So flee to Allah . Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.translation: So, flee to Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.

verses.text: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.translation: And do not make up any other god along with Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.

verses.text: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
verses.translation: In similar way, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “(He is) a magician or a madman.”

verses.text: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
verses.translation: Have they handed down (this saying) to each other as a legacy? Rather they are a rebellious people.

verses.text: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
verses.translation: So, turn away from them, for you are not blamed.

verses.text: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
verses.translation: And keep reminding, because reminding benefits the believers.

verses.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
verses.translation: I did not create the Jinns and the human beings except for the purpose that they should worship Me.

verses.text: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
verses.translation: I do not want any sustenance from them, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.text: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
verses.translation: In fact, Allah is the All-Sustainer, Possessor of power, the Strong.

verses.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
verses.translation: So, those who did wrong will have their turn like the turn of their counterparts. So, they should not ask Me to hasten on.

verses.text: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
verses.translation: Woe, then, to those who disbelieve because of the Day of theirs that they are promised (for punishment).

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the mount
verses.translation: By the mount of Tūr,

verses.text: And [by] a Book inscribed
verses.translation: and by a book, written

verses.text: In parchment spread open
verses.translation: on an unrolled scroll,

verses.text: And [by] the frequented House
verses.translation: and by the Populated House (Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mūr) ,

verses.text: And [by] the heaven raised high
verses.translation: and by the roof, raised high,

verses.text: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
verses.translation: and by the sea, flared up (with fire),

verses.text: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
verses.translation: the punishment of your Lord is sure to fall.

verses.text: Of it there is no preventer.
verses.translation: There is nothing to push it back,

verses.text: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
verses.translation: the Day when the sky will tremble, a horrible trembling,

verses.text: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
verses.translation: and the mountains will move about, a terrible movement.

verses.text: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.translation: So, woe to those who reject (the true faith),

verses.text: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
verses.translation: who are indulged in vain talk, playing (with truth),

verses.text: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
verses.translation: the Day they will be pushed to the Fire forcefully,

verses.text: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
verses.translation: (and it will be said to them,) “This is the Fire you used to deny.

verses.text: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
verses.translation: Is it then magic, or do you not see?

verses.text: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
verses.translation: Enter it. Now, whether you endure (it) patiently or impatiently, it is all the same for you; you are merely rewarded for what you used to do.”

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
verses.translation: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and bliss,

verses.text: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
verses.translation: enjoying what their Lord will have given to them, and their Lord will have saved them from the punishment of Hell.

verses.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.translation: (It will be said to them,) “Eat and drink pleasantly because of what you used to do,

verses.text: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.translation: relaxing on lined up couches”. And We will marry them with big-eyed houris.

verses.text: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
verses.translation: And those who believed and their children followed them in belief, We will join their children with them, and will not curtail (the reward of) any of their deeds at all. Every person will be pledged for what he earned.

verses.text: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
verses.translation: And We will go on giving them whatever they desire of fruits and meat.

verses.text: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
verses.translation: They will snatch from one another (in a friendly manner) a glass (of wine) carrying neither absurd talk, nor something leading to sin.

verses.text: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
verses.translation: And their own serving boys will rotate around them, (who will be as neat and clean) as if they were hidden pearls.

verses.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.translation: And they will advance to one another, asking (about each other’s welfare).

verses.text: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah ].
verses.translation: They will say, “Indeed we were afraid (of Allah’s punishment) when we were amidst our family,

verses.text: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
verses.translation: but Allah did favour to us and saved us from the torment of Fire’s scorching breath.

verses.text: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
verses.translation: We used to pray to Him before. He is surely the Most-Kind, the Very-Merciful.

verses.text: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
verses.translation: So keep reminding (them), because by the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a mad man.

verses.text: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
verses.translation: Do they rather say, “He is a poet for whom we are awaiting the accident of death?”

verses.text: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
verses.translation: Say, “Wait! I am waiting with you, too.”

verses.text: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
verses.translation: Is it their intellects that direct them to (say) this, or are they a rebellious people?

verses.text: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
verses.translation: Do they rather say, “He has forged it (the Qur’ān.)”? No, but they do not believe.

verses.text: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
verses.translation: So, let them bring a discourse like this, if they are truthful.

verses.text: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
verses.translation: Is it that they are created by none, or are they themselves the creators?

verses.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
verses.translation: Or have they created the heavens and the earth? No, but they are sure of nothing.

verses.text: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
verses.translation: Or do they have the treasures of your Lord, or have they acquired control (over them)?

verses.text: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
verses.translation: Or have they a stairway (to the heavens) by means of which they listen (to the divine decrees)? If so, their listener must bring a clear proof.

verses.text: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
verses.translation: Is it that He has daughters and you have sons?

verses.text: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
verses.translation: Or is it that you (O prophet) ask them for a fee, and therefore they are burdened with a liability?

verses.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
verses.translation: Or have they the knowledge of the Unseen, and they are recording it?

verses.text: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
verses.translation: Or do they intend to plan to do harm (to the prophet)? Then the disbelievers themselves shall be harmed by the plan.

verses.text: Or have they a deity other than Allah ? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
verses.translation: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Pure is Allah from what they associate with Him.

verses.text: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
verses.translation: Even if they see a piece falling down from the sky, they would say, “It is a cumulated cloud.”

verses.text: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
verses.translation: So, leave them alone until they face their Day, in which they will be turned unconscious,

verses.text: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
verses.translation: the Day their planning will not benefit them in the least, nor will they be helped.

verses.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: And for those who did wrong there is another punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

verses.text: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
verses.translation: And (O Prophet) be patient about the decision of your Lord, because you are in front of Our Eyes. And proclaim the purity of your Lord along with His praise when you stand (in Prayer),

verses.text: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
verses.translation: And, in parts of night too, proclaim His purity, and at the time of setting of the stars.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the star when it descends,
verses.translation: By the star when it goes down to set,

verses.text: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
verses.translation: your fellow (the Holy Prophet) has neither missed the way, nor did he deviate.

verses.text: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
verses.translation: He does not speak out of (his own) desire.

verses.text: It is not but a revelation revealed,
verses.translation: It is but revelation revealed (to him).

verses.text: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
verses.translation: It is taught to him by one (angel) of strong faculties,

verses.text: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
verses.translation: the one of vigour. So he stood poised,

verses.text: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
verses.translation: while he was on the upper horizon.

verses.text: Then he approached and descended
verses.translation: Then he drew near, and came down,

verses.text: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
verses.translation: so as he was at a distance like that of two bows (joined together), rather even nearer.

verses.text: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
verses.translation: Thus He (Allah) revealed to His slave what He revealed.

verses.text: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
verses.translation: The heart did not err in what he saw.

verses.text: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
verses.translation: Do you quarrel with him in what he sees?

verses.text: And he certainly saw him in another descent
verses.translation: Indeed he saw him another time

verses.text: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
verses.translation: by Sidrat-ul-Muntahā (the lote-tree in the upper realm),

verses.text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
verses.translation: near which there is Jannat-ul-Ma’wā (the Paradise of Abode),

verses.text: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
verses.translation: when the lote-tree was covered by that which covered it.

verses.text: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
verses.translation: The eye neither went wrong, nor did exceed the limit.

verses.text: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
verses.translation: He has indeed seen a part of the biggest signs of your Lord.

verses.text: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
verses.translation: Have you ever considered about the (idols of) Lāt and ‘Uzzā,

verses.text: And Manat, the third - the other one?
verses.translation: and about the other, the third (idol), namely, Manāt,?

verses.text: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
verses.translation: Is it that you have males and He (Allah) has females?

verses.text: That, then, is an unjust division.
verses.translation: If so, it is a bizarre division.

verses.text: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
verses.translation: These are nothing but names you and your fathers have invented; Allah has sent down no authority attached to them. They are following nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire, while guidance from their Lord has surely reached them.

verses.text: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
verses.translation: Is it that man can get whatever he wishes?

verses.text: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.translation: (No,) because to Allah alone belongs the (good of) the Hereafter and the former life (of this world).

verses.text: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
verses.translation: How many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession cannot benefit (any one) at all, but after Allah allows (it) for whomsoever He wills and pleases.

verses.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
verses.translation: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter call the angels by names of females.

verses.text: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
verses.translation: They do not have knowledge about it. They follow nothing but conjecture, and conjecture is of no avail in (the matter of) Truth.

verses.text: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
verses.translation: So, turn away from him who turns away from Our advice, and seeks nothing but (pleasure of) the worldly life.

verses.text: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
verses.translation: That is the limit of their access to knowledge. Indeed only your Lord knows well about the one who has gone astray from his way, and He knows well about the one who has adopted the right path.

verses.text: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
verses.translation: To Allah belongs whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, so that He gives punishment to evildoers for what they did, and gives good reward to those who did good

verses.text: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
verses.translation: -those who abstain from the major sins and from shameful acts, except minor involvements. Indeed your Lord is extensive in forgiveness. He knows you more than anyone else (from a time) when He created you from the earth and when you were embryos in the wombs of your mothers. So, do not claim purity (from faults) for your selves. He knows best who is God-fearing.

verses.text: Have you seen the one who turned away
verses.translation: Did you see the one who turned away,

verses.text: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
verses.translation: and gave a little, and stopped?

verses.text: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
verses.translation: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen whereby he sees (what he believes)?

verses.text: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
verses.translation: Has he not been told of what was (revealed) in the scriptures of Mūsā

verses.text: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
verses.translation: and of Ibrāhīm who fulfilled (his duties)?

verses.text: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
verses.translation: (It was) that no bearer of burden shall bear the burden of the other,

verses.text: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
verses.translation: and that a man shall not deserve but (the reward of) his own effort,

verses.text: And that his effort is going to be seen -
verses.translation: and that his effort will soon be seen,

verses.text: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
verses.translation: then he will be recompensed for it in full,

verses.text: And that to your Lord is the finality
verses.translation: and that to your Lord is the end (of every one),

verses.text: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
verses.translation: and that He is the One who makes (one) laugh and makes (him) weep,

verses.text: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
verses.translation: and that He is the One who gives death and gives life,

verses.text: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
verses.translation: and that He creates the pairs, male and female,

verses.text: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
verses.translation: from a sperm-drop when it is poured (into a womb),

verses.text: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
verses.translation: and that the second creation is undertaken by Him,

verses.text: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
verses.translation: and that He is the One who gives wealth and preserves (it),

verses.text: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
verses.translation: and that He is the One who is the Lord of Sirius (the star worshipped by pagans),

verses.text: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
verses.translation: and that He has destroyed the earlier ‘Ād,

verses.text: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
verses.translation: and Thamūd, so spared none,

verses.text: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
verses.translation: and (destroyed) the people of NūH even earlier. Surely they were more unjust and more rebellious.

verses.text: And the overturned towns He hurled down
verses.translation: And He destroyed the overturned towns (of the people of LūT) also,

verses.text: And covered them by that which He covered.
verses.translation: so enveloped they were by that which enveloped.

verses.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
verses.translation: Then concerning which of your Lord’s bounties would you remain in doubt?

verses.text: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
verses.translation: This (Prophet) is a warner from the (genus of the) previous warners.

verses.text: The Approaching Day has approached.
verses.translation: The Imminent (Hour of Judgment) has approached.

verses.text: Of it, [from those] besides Allah , there is no remover.
verses.translation: There is no one, beside Allah, to remove it.

verses.text: Then at this statement do you wonder?
verses.translation: Do you then wonder at this discourse,

verses.text: And you laugh and do not weep
verses.translation: and laugh (at it), and not weep,

verses.text: While you are proudly sporting?
verses.translation: while you are engaged in vain play?

verses.text: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
verses.translation: Now, fall down in prostration and worship (Allah).

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
verses.translation: The Hour (of doom) has drawn near, and the moon has split asunder.

verses.text: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
verses.translation: When these people see a sign, they turn away and say, “(This is) a transient magic.”

verses.text: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
verses.translation: They have rejected (the Truth) and followed their desires, while every matter has to settle (at some time).

verses.text: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
verses.translation: And there has come to them as much news (of the earlier communities) as it is enough to deter,

verses.text: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
verses.translation: (containing) a perfect wisdom. But the warnings are of no avail (to them).

verses.text: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
verses.translation: Therefore, turn aside (O Prophet,) from them. (They will see the reality) on the day in which the caller will call (them) to a gruesome object.

verses.text: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
verses.translation: With their eyes humbled, they will come out of the graves like locusts spread all over,

verses.text: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
verses.translation: rushing quickly towards the caller. (On that Day) the disbelievers will say, “This is a hard day.”

verses.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
verses.translation: The people of NūH denied (the truth) before them. So they rejected Our servant, and said, “(He is) a madman”, and he was (also) threatened (by them).

verses.text: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
verses.translation: So he prayed to his Lord saying, “I am overpowered, so defend (me).”

verses.text: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
verses.translation: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring forth profusely,

verses.text: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
verses.translation: and We caused the earth to gush forth as springs; so the water (of both kinds) met together for a destined event.

verses.text: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
verses.translation: And We caused him (NūH) to board that (ship) which had planks and nails,

verses.text: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
verses.translation: which sailed under Our Eyes, as a reward for the one who was rejected (by the infidels).

verses.text: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: And We left it (the ship) as a sign. So, is there one to take lesson?

verses.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: Then how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.text: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: (The people of) ‘Ād rejected (their prophet). So how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
verses.translation: We did send to them a furious wind in a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.text: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
verses.translation: plucking people away, as if they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

verses.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: So how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.text: Thamud denied the warning
verses.translation: (The people of) Thamūd rejected the warners.

verses.text: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
verses.translation: So they said, “Shall we follow a single human being from among us? Then we will be in error and insanity.

verses.text: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
verses.translation: Is it that the advice has been cast upon him alone out of all of us? No, but he is a bragging liar.”

verses.text: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
verses.translation: Tomorrow they will know who the bragging liar is!

verses.text: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
verses.translation: We are going to send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch them (O SāliH,) and keep patience,

verses.text: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.translation: and tell them that water (of the well) is to be shared between them (and the she-camel), so as the right of having water shall be attended by each (alternatively).

verses.text: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
verses.translation: Then they called their man (to kill the she-camel,) so he undertook (the task) and killed (the she-camel).

verses.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: So how was My torment and My warnings?

verses.text: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
verses.translation: We sent upon them a single Cry, and they were like crushed leafs of a hedge-builder.

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.text: The people of Lot denied the warning.
verses.translation: The people of LūT rejected the warners.

verses.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
verses.translation: We sent upon them a rain of stones, except the family of LūT whom We saved in the last hours of night,

verses.text: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
verses.translation: as a grace from Us. This is how We reward the one who offers gratitude.

verses.text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
verses.translation: And he (LūT) had certainly warned them of Our grasp, but they disputed the warnings.

verses.text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
verses.translation: And they had even tried to tempt him against his guests (so that they may snatch them away for bad purpose,) but We blinded their eyes: “Now taste My torment and My warnings!”

verses.text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
verses.translation: And on the next morning, a lasting torment overtook them:

verses.text: So taste My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: “Now taste My torment and My warnings.”

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

verses.text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
verses.translation: And the warners came to the family of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).

verses.text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: (But) they rejected all Our signs; so We seized them- a seizure by One Mighty, Powerful.

verses.text: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
verses.translation: Are the disbelievers among you in a better position than all of the aforesaid (punished people), or do you have immunity (recorded) in the sacred books?

verses.text: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
verses.translation: Or do they say, “We are a large group, well-defended.”?

verses.text: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
verses.translation: Soon this ‘large group’ shall be defeated, and all of them will turn their backs.

verses.text: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
verses.translation: Rather the Hour (of judgment) is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour is more calamitous and much more bitter.

verses.text: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
verses.translation: Surely the guilty ones are in error and madness.

verses.text: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
verses.translation: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, (it will be said to them,) “Taste the touch of Hell.”

verses.text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
verses.translation: Verily, We have created every thing according to (Our) predestination.

verses.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
verses.translation: And (implementation of) Our command is no more than a single act like the twinkling of an eye.

verses.text: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: We have destroyed people like you; so, is there one to take lesson?

verses.text: And everything they did is in written records.
verses.translation: And every thing they have done is recorded in the books (of deeds).

verses.text: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
verses.translation: And every thing, small and big, is written down.

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
verses.translation: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and rivers,

verses.text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: in a seat of Truth, near to the Omnipotent Sovereign.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Most Merciful
verses.translation: The RaHmān (The All-Merciful Allah)

verses.text: Taught the Qur'an,
verses.translation: has taught the Qur’ān.

verses.text: Created man,
verses.translation: He has created man.

verses.text: [And] taught him eloquence.
verses.translation: He has taught him (how) to express himself.

verses.text: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
verses.translation: The sun and the moon are (bound) by a (fixed) calculation.

verses.text: And the stars and trees prostrate.
verses.translation: And the vine and the tree both prostrate (to Allah).

verses.text: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
verses.translation: He raised the sky high, and has placed the scale,

verses.text: That you not transgress within the balance.
verses.translation: so that you should not be wrongful in weighing.

verses.text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
verses.translation: Observe the correct weight with fairness, and do not make weighing deficient.

verses.text: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
verses.translation: As for the earth, He has placed it for creatures,

verses.text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
verses.translation: in which there are fruits and date palms having sheaths,

verses.text: And grain having husks and scented plants.
verses.translation: and the grain having chaff, and fragrant flowers.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
verses.translation: He has created man from dry clay, ringing like pottery,

verses.text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
verses.translation: and created Jann (father of the Jinn) from a smokeless flame of fire.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
verses.translation: He is the Lord of both points of sunrise and both points of sunset.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
verses.translation: He let forth the two seas to meet together,

verses.text: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
verses.translation: while there is a barrier between them; they do not encroach (upon one another).

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
verses.translation: From both of them come forth the pearl and the coral.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
verses.translation: And His are the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
verses.translation: Every one who is on it (the earth) has to perish.

verses.text: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.translation: And your Lord’s Countenance will remain, full of majesty, full of honour.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
verses.translation: All those in the heavens and the earth beseech Him (for their needs.) Every day He is in a state of action.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
verses.translation: Soon We are going to spare Ourselves for you (to reckon your deeds), O two heavy species (of Jinn and mankind)!

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah ].
verses.translation: O genera of Jinn and mankind, If you are able to penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate. You cannot penetrate without power.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
verses.translation: A flame of fire and a smoke will be loosed against you, and you will not (be able) to defend.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
verses.translation: So, (it will be a terrible event) when the sky will be split apart and will become rosy, like (red) hides.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
verses.translation: On that day, neither a man will be questioned about his sin, nor a Jinn.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
verses.translation: The guilty ones will be recognized (by angels) through their marks and will be seized by foreheads and feet.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
verses.translation: This is Jahannam (Hell) that the guilty people deny.

verses.text: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
verses.translation: They will circle around between it and between hot, boiling water.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
verses.translation: And for the one who is fearful of having to stand before his Lord, there are two gardens, -

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Having [spreading] branches.
verses.translation: - both having branches.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
verses.translation: In both there are two flowing springs.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
verses.translation: In both there are two kinds of every fruit.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
verses.translation: (The people of these gardens will be) reclining on floorings whose (even) linings will be of thick silk, and the fruits plucked from the two gardens will be at hand.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
verses.translation: In them there will be maidens restraining (their) glances, whom neither a man might have touched before them, nor a Jinn.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: As if they were rubies and coral.
verses.translation: They will look like rubies and corals.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
verses.translation: Is there any reward for goodness other than goodness?

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
verses.translation: And besides these two, there are two other gardens (for the second category of the God-fearing),-

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Dark green [in color].
verses.translation: - both (gardens are) dark green!

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
verses.translation: In both there are two springs gushing forth profusely.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
verses.translation: In both there are fruits and date-palms and pomegranates.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: In them are good and beautiful women -
verses.translation: In them there will be women, good and gorgeous,-

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
verses.translation: - the houris, kept guarded in pavilions-

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
verses.translation: - whom neither a man might have touched before them, nor a Jinn.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
verses.translation: (The people of these gardens will be) reclining on green cushions and marvelously beautiful mattresses.

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

verses.text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.translation: Glorious is the name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty, the Lord of Honour.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the Occurrence occurs,
verses.translation: When the Imminent Event (of Doom) will occur,

verses.text: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
verses.translation: there will be no one to deny its occurrence.

verses.text: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
verses.translation: It will be abasing (some), exalting (others)

verses.text: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
verses.translation: when the earth will be jolted with a terrible jolt,

verses.text: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
verses.translation: and the mountains will be crumbled a thorough crumbling,

verses.text: And become dust dispersing.
verses.translation: until they will become dust, scattered in the air,

verses.text: And you become [of] three kinds:
verses.translation: and you will be (divided into) three categories.

verses.text: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
verses.translation: As for the People of the Right, how (lucky) are the People of the Right!

verses.text: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
verses.translation: And the People of the Left ? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!

verses.text: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
verses.translation: And the Foremost are the foremost.

verses.text: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah ]
verses.translation: Those are the ones blessed with nearness (to Allah)

verses.text: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
verses.translation: in gardens of bliss,

verses.text: A [large] company of the former peoples
verses.translation: many from the first generations,

verses.text: And a few of the later peoples,
verses.translation: and a few from the later ones.

verses.text: On thrones woven [with ornament],
verses.translation: (They will be sitting) on thrones woven with gold,

verses.text: Reclining on them, facing each other.
verses.translation: reclining on them, facing each other.

verses.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
verses.translation: Immortal boys will rotate around them

verses.text: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
verses.translation: with bowls and jugs and a goblet of pure wine,

verses.text: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
verses.translation: from which they will neither suffer headache, nor will they be intoxicated,

verses.text: And fruit of what they select
verses.translation: -and with fruits that they choose,

verses.text: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
verses.translation: and the flesh of birds that they desire.

verses.text: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
verses.translation: And (for them there will be) houris, having lovely big eyes,

verses.text: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
verses.translation: all (neat and clean) like a hidden pearl,

verses.text: As reward for what they used to do.
verses.translation: as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.text: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
verses.translation: They will hear neither an absurd talk in it, nor something leading to sin,

verses.text: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."
verses.translation: but (they will hear) the words of Salām , Salām (as greetings).

verses.text: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
verses.translation: And the People of the right? How (lucky) are the People of the Right!

verses.text: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
verses.translation: (They will be) amid lote-trees with no thorns,

verses.text: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
verses.translation: and the trees of TalH , (banana, or a fragrant tree) having layers one upon the other,

verses.text: And shade extended
verses.translation: and a shade, spread all over,

verses.text: And water poured out
verses.translation: and water, poured forth,

verses.text: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
verses.translation: and a lot of fruits,

verses.text: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
verses.translation: neither interrupted (in any season), nor prohibited,

verses.text: And [upon] beds raised high.
verses.translation: and mattresses of high quality.

verses.text: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
verses.translation: Surely We have made up those females in a special creation,

verses.text: And made them virgins,
verses.translation: and have made them virgins,

verses.text: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
verses.translation: amorous to their husbands, matching them in age,

verses.text: For the companions of the right [who are]
verses.translation: for the People of the Right,

verses.text: A company of the former peoples
verses.translation: (comprising) many from the first generations,

verses.text: And a company of the later peoples.
verses.translation: and many from the later ones.

verses.text: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
verses.translation: And the People of the Left? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!

verses.text: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
verses.translation: (They will be) in scorching wind and boiling water,

verses.text: And a shade of black smoke,
verses.translation: and in a shade of black smoke,

verses.text: Neither cool nor beneficial.
verses.translation: neither cool nor graceful.

verses.text: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
verses.translation: They were earlier in luxuries,

verses.text: And they used to persist in the great violation,
verses.translation: and used to persist in major sins,

verses.text: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.translation: and used to say, “Is it that when we die and become dust-is it that we will be raised again,

verses.text: And our forefathers [as well]?"
verses.translation: and our ancient fathers as well?”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
verses.translation: Say, “All the earlier and the later ones

verses.text: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
verses.translation: will be gathered together for a fixed time of a specified Day.

verses.text: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
verses.translation: Then O you, the erring, the denying people,

verses.text: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
verses.translation: you will have to eat from the tree of zaqqūm,

verses.text: And filling with it your bellies
verses.translation: and to fill with it the bellies,

verses.text: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
verses.translation: then on top of it you will have to drink boiling water,

verses.text: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
verses.translation: and to drink like camels suffering from the disease of over-thirst.

verses.text: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
verses.translation: This will be their welcome entertainment on the Day of Requital.

verses.text: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
verses.translation: We have created you; then why do you not believe in it?

verses.text: Have you seen that which you emit?
verses.translation: So, tell Me about the semen you drop (in the wombs):

verses.text: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
verses.translation: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator?

verses.text: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
verses.translation: We have appointed (the times of) death among you, and We cannot be frustrated

verses.text: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
verses.translation: from replacing you with others like you, and creating you (afresh) in that (form) which you do not know.

verses.text: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
verses.translation: And you certainly know the first creation; then why do you not take lesson?

verses.text: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
verses.translation: Well, tell Me about that (seed) which you sow:

verses.text: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
verses.translation: Is it you who grow it, or are We the One who grows?

verses.text: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
verses.translation: If We so will, We can certainly make it crumbled, and you will remain wondering,

verses.text: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
verses.translation: (and saying,) “We are laden with debt,

verses.text: Rather, we have been deprived."
verses.translation: rather we are totally deprived.”

verses.text: And have you seen the water that you drink?
verses.translation: Again, tell Me about the water you drink:

verses.text: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
verses.translation: Is it you who have brought it down from the clouds, or are We the One who sends (it) down?

verses.text: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
verses.translation: If We so will, We can make it bitter in taste. So why do you not offer gratitude?

verses.text: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
verses.translation: Now tell Me about the fire you kindle:

verses.text: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
verses.translation: Is it you who have originated its tree, or are We the Originator?

verses.text: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
verses.translation: We have made it a reminder (of Our infinite power, and of the fire of Hell) and a benefit for travelers in deserts.

verses.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.translation: So, proclaim purity of the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.

verses.text: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
verses.translation: So, I swear by the setting places of the stars,

verses.text: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
verses.translation: -and indeed it is a great oath, if you are to appreciate-

verses.text: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
verses.translation: it is surely the Noble Qur’ān,

verses.text: In a Register well-protected;
verses.translation: (recorded already) in a protected book (i.e. the Preserved Tablet)

verses.text: None touch it except the purified.
verses.translation: that is not touched except by the purified ones (the angels).

verses.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: - a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
verses.translation: Is it this discourse that you take lightly,

verses.text: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
verses.translation: and take your denial as your livelihood?

verses.text: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
verses.translation: So why (do you) not (intervene) when the soul (of a dying person) reaches the throat,

verses.text: And you are at that time looking on -
verses.translation: and you are watching?

verses.text: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
verses.translation: And We are closer to him than you, but you do not perceive.

verses.text: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
verses.translation: So, if you are not going to be recompensed (in the Hereafter for your deeds), then why do you not

verses.text: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
verses.translation: bring the soul back, if you are truthful?

verses.text: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah ,
verses.translation: So, in case he (the dying person) is from among those blessed with nearness,

verses.text: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
verses.translation: then (for him) there is comfort and fragrance and garden of bliss.

verses.text: And if he was of the companions of the right,
verses.translation: And in case he is from among the People of the Right,

verses.text: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
verses.translation: then, (it will be said to him,) “Peace is for you, as you are one of the People of the Right.”

verses.text: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
verses.translation: But if he is one of the deniers, the astray,

verses.text: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
verses.translation: then (for him) there is entertainment from boiling water,

verses.text: And burning in Hellfire
verses.translation: and burning in the Hell.

verses.text: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
verses.translation: Indeed this is certainty in its true sense.

verses.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.translation: So, proclaim purity of the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah , and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth proclaims Allah’s purity, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
verses.translation: To Him belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and brings death, and He is Powerful to do any thing.

verses.text: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
verses.translation: He is the First and the Last, and the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is All-Knowing about every thing.

verses.text: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah , of what you do, is Seeing.
verses.translation: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then He positioned Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out from it, and whatever descends from the sky, and whatever ascends thereto. He is with you wherever you are, and Allah is watchful of whatever you do.

verses.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters.
verses.translation: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned.

verses.text: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.translation: He makes the night enter into the day, and makes the day enter into the night, and He is All-Knowing about whatever lies in the hearts.

verses.text: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
verses.translation: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend out of that (wealth) in which He has appointed you as deputies. So, for those of you who have believed and spent (in Allah’s way), there is a big reward.

verses.text: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
verses.translation: What is wrong with you that you do not believe in Allah, while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord, and He has taken your covenant, if you are to believe?

verses.text: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful.
verses.translation: He is the One who reveals clear verses to His servant, so that He brings you out from layers of darkness into the light. And to you, Allah is Very-Kind indeed, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best [reward]. And Allah , with what you do, is Acquainted.
verses.translation: And what is wrong with you that you should not spend in the way of Allah, while to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent before the Conquest (of Makkah) and fought are not at par (with others). Those are much greater in rank than those who spent later and fought, though Allah has promised the good (reward) for each. Allah is well aware of what you do.

verses.text: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
verses.translation: Who is there to advance a loan, a good loan, to Allah so that He multiplies it for him, and he may have a noble reward?

verses.text: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
verses.translation: On the Day when you will see the believing men and the believing women, their light proceeding in front of them and to their right hands, (it will be said to them,) “Good news for you today! Gardens beneath which rivers flow, to live therein forever! That is the great achievement,

verses.text: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
verses.translation: - the Day when the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believe, “Wait for us, so that we may have a share from your light.”It will be said (to them), “Go back to your rear, and search for light.” Then a wall will be placed between them, which will have a gate. In its inner side, there will be the divine mercy, while towards its outer side, there will be the divine punishment.

verses.text: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah . And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah .
verses.translation: They (the hypocrites) will call out to them (the believers), “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, (you were,) but you led your souls to a wrong way, and kept waiting (for an evil end to the Muslims), and remained in doubt, and were deluded by fancies, until Allah’s command came to pass, and you were deceived about Allah by the Big Deceiver (Iblīs).

verses.text: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.
verses.translation: So, no ransom will be accepted from you today, nor from those who disbelieved (openly). Your abode is the Fire, and it is an evil end.”

verses.text: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: Has the time not yet come for those who believe that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah and for the truth that has descended (through revelation)? They must not be like those to whom the Book was given before, but a long period passed on them (in which they did not repent), therefore their hearts became hard, and (thus) many of them are sinners.

verses.text: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
verses.translation: Know well that Allah revives the land after its death. We have made the signs clear for you, so that you may understand.

verses.text: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
verses.translation: Surely those men who give Sadaqah (alms) and those women who give Sadaqah and have advanced a good loan to Allah, for them it will be multiplied, and for them there is a noble reward.

verses.text: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
verses.translation: And those who believed in Allah and His messengers, - those are the Siddīqs (the most righteous after prophets) and the Shuhadā’ (martyrs) in the sight of your Lord. For them shall be their reward and their light. As for those who disbelieved and rejected Our verses, they are the inmates of Hell.

verses.text: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
verses.translation: Know well that the worldly life is but a play and an amusement, and a show of beauty, and exchange of boastful claims between you, and a competition of increase in riches and children. (All this is) like a rain, the growth of which attracts the farmers, then it withers, and you see it turning yellow, then it becomes straw. And in the Hereafter there is a severe punishment (for the disbelievers), and forgiveness from Allah and (Allah’s) pleasure (for the believers and the righteous). The worldly life is nothing but a material of delusion.

verses.text: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
verses.translation: Compete each other in proceeding towards forgiveness from your Lord and to Paradise the width of which is like the width of the sky and the earth. It has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whomsoever He Wills and Allah is the Lord of the great bounty.

verses.text: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah , is easy -
verses.translation: No calamity befalls the earth or your own selves, but it is (pre-destined) in a Book before We bring it into being, -Indeed it is easy for Allah.

verses.text: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
verses.translation: - so that you may neither grieve on what has escaped you, nor over-exult on what He has given to you. And Allah does not love any self-admirer, over-proud,

verses.text: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: -those who are miserly and bid others to be miserly. And whoever turns away, then Allah is the All-Independent, the Ever-Praised.

verses.text: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
verses.translation: We have indeed sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and sent down with them the Book and the Balance, so that people may uphold equity. And We sent down iron in which there is strong power, and benefits for the people; and (We did it) so that Allah knows the one who helps Him and His messengers without seeing (Him). Surely Allah is Strong, Mighty.

verses.text: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: Indeed We sent NūH and Ibrāhīm, and kept the Book and prophet-hood (continuing) in their progeny. So, some of those (to whom they were sent) were on the right path, and many of them were sinners.

verses.text: Then We sent following their footsteps Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allah . But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: Then We made Our messengers follow them one after the other, then We sent after them ‘Īsā, the son of Maryam (Jesus, son of Mary), and gave him the Injīl, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of his followers. As for monasticism, it was invented by them; We did not ordain it for them, but (they adopted it) to seek Allah’s pleasure, then could not observe it as was due. So We gave the believers from among them their reward. And many of them are sinners.

verses.text: O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: O you who believe, fear Allah, and believe in His Messenger, and He will give you two shares (of reward) out of His mercy, and will make for you a light whereby you will walk, and will forgive you- And Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allah and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah ; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
verses.translation: - so that the People of the Book may know that they have no control over any thing from Allah’s bounty, and that bounty is in Allah’s hand; He gives it to whom He wills, and Allah is the Lord of the great bounty.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah . And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
verses.translation: Allah has heard the talk of the woman who was debating with you about her husband, and was complaining to Allah. Allah was hearing the conversation between both of you. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

verses.text: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.
verses.translation: Those of you who declare Zihār against their wives, they are not their mothers. Their mothers are none else but those who gave birth to them. Undoubtedly they utter an evil word and a lie; and Allah is surely Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: And those who pronounce thihar from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
verses.translation: Those who declare Zihār against their wives, then retract what they said, obligated on them is to free the neck (of a slave) before the two (spouses) touch one another. This is what you are advised, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

verses.text: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allah . And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
verses.translation: But whoever does not find (a slave) has to fast for two consecutive months before the two (spouses) touch one another. Then the one who is not able to do so has to feed sixty indigent persons. This is (laid down) so that you believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the limits set by Allah; and for the disbelievers there is a painful punishment.

verses.text: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.
verses.translation: Surely those who oppose Allah and His Messenger shall be disgraced, just as those before them were disgraced. We have sent down clear verses, and for the disbelievers there is a humiliating punishment

verses.text: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness.
verses.translation: on the Day when Allah will resurrect them all together, and will tell them what they did; Allah has its full account, while they have forgotten it. Allah is witness to every thing.

verses.text: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing.
