verses.translation: And it is nothing else but a Reminder for all the worlds.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Inevitable Reality -
verses.translation: The Imminent Happening!

verses.text: What is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.translation: What is the Imminent Happening?

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.translation: And what can let you know what the Imminent happening is?

verses.text: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
verses.translation: Thamūd and ‘Ād had denied (the happening of) the Shocking Event (the Day of Judgment).

verses.text: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
verses.translation: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by that (dreadful cry), which exceeded all limits.

verses.text: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
verses.translation: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a violent windstorm

verses.text: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
verses.translation: that He imposed on them for seven nights and eight consecutive days; so you could see them thrown on the ground, as if they were trunks of hollow palm-trees.

verses.text: Then do you see of them any remains?
verses.translation: Now, do you see any remnant of them?

verses.text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
verses.translation: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and those before him and the overthrown towns came up with evil,

verses.text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
verses.translation: and they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an extremely severe seizure.

verses.text: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
verses.translation: When the water overflowed (in the Deluge of NūH), We let you (O mankind,) board the floating ship,

verses.text: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
verses.translation: so that We make it a reminder for you, and so that a preserving ear (that hears their story) may preserve it.

verses.text: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
verses.translation: Then, once the Trumpet will be blown for the first time,

verses.text: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
verses.translation: and the earth and the mountains will be lifted and crushed into pieces with a single blow,

verses.text: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
verses.translation: then on that Day the Happening will happen,

verses.text: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
verses.translation: and the sky will burst apart, while it will have become frail on that day.

verses.text: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
verses.translation: And the angels will be on its borders. And on that Day, the Throne of your Lord will be carried above them by eight (angels).

verses.text: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
verses.translation: On that day, you will be brought forward in a way that no secret of yours will remain secret.

verses.text: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
verses.translation: Now, as for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say (to his colleagues), “Come here, read my book.

verses.text: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
verses.translation: I was sure that I would encounter my reckoning.”

verses.text: So he will be in a pleasant life -
verses.translation: So he will be in a well-pleasing life

verses.text: In an elevated garden,
verses.translation: in a lofty garden,

verses.text: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
verses.translation: the fruits of which will be close at hand.

verses.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
verses.translation: (It will be said to such people,) “Eat and drink with pleasure, as a reward for what you did in advance during past days.”

verses.text: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
verses.translation: As for him who will be given his book in his left hand, he will say, “ Oh, would that I had not been given my book,

verses.text: And had not known what is my account.
verses.translation: and I had never known what my account is!

verses.text: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
verses.translation: Oh, would that it (death) had been the end of the matter!

verses.text: My wealth has not availed me.
verses.translation: My wealth has not been of any use to me.

verses.text: Gone from me is my authority."
verses.translation: My power has gone from me for good.”

verses.text: [ Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
verses.translation: (Then it will be said to angels,) “Seize him, then put a collar around his neck,

verses.text: Then into Hellfire drive him.
verses.translation: and then, let him burn in the blazing fire.

verses.text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
verses.translation: Thereafter, fasten him with a chain the measure of which is seventy hands.”

verses.text: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah , the Most Great,
verses.translation: Indeed, he did not believe in Allah, the Almighty,

verses.text: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.translation: and did not persuade (others) to feed the needy.

verses.text: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
verses.translation: So, he has no friend here today,

verses.text: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
verses.translation: nor any food except that which comes out from wounds when washing,

verses.text: None will eat it except the sinners.
verses.translation: which is eaten by none but the sinners.

verses.text: So I swear by what you see
verses.translation: I swear by what you see,

verses.text: And what you do not see
verses.translation: and what you do not see,

verses.text: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
verses.translation: it is surely the speech of a noble Messenger, (that he conveys from Allah).

verses.text: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
verses.translation: and it is not the speech of a poet, (but) little you believe,

verses.text: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
verses.translation: nor is it the speech of a soothsayer, (but) little you heed to the advice.

verses.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
verses.translation: Had he (the prophet) forged some statements in Our name,

verses.text: We would have seized him by the right hand;
verses.translation: We would have certainly seized him by the right hand,

verses.text: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
verses.translation: and then severed his life-artery,

verses.text: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
verses.translation: and none of you could have saved him from it.

verses.text: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
verses.translation: It is infact a Reminder for the God-fearing.

verses.text: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
verses.translation: And, of course, We know that among you there are deniers.

verses.text: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
verses.translation: And surely, it is a cause of remorse for the disbelievers.

verses.text: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
verses.translation: And it is surely an absolute truth.

verses.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.translation: So, pronounce the purity of the name of your magnificent Lord.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
verses.translation: A demanding person has asked for the punishment that is going to befall

verses.text: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
verses.translation: the disbelievers; there is no one to avert it,

verses.text: [It is] from Allah , owner of the ways of ascent.
verses.translation: (and it will come) from Allah, the Lord of the stairways,

verses.text: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
verses.translation: to whom ascend the angels and the Spirit in a day the length of which is fifty thousand years.

verses.text: So be patient with gracious patience.
verses.translation: So, observe patience, a good patience.

verses.text: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
verses.translation: They see it far off,

verses.text: But We see it [as] near.
verses.translation: and We see it near.

verses.text: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
verses.translation: (This punishment will befall) on the Day when the sky will be like dregs of oil,

verses.text: And the mountains will be like wool,
verses.translation: and the mountains will be like dyed wool,

verses.text: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
verses.translation: and no friend will ask about any friend,

verses.text: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
verses.translation: (though) they will be made to see each other. A guilty person will desire that he may be able to ransom himself from the torment of that day even by his sons,

verses.text: And his wife and his brother
verses.translation: and his wife and his brother,

verses.text: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
verses.translation: and his kindred that sheltered him,

verses.text: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
verses.translation: and all those on earth, then he may redeem himself.

verses.text: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
verses.translation: By no means! It is the flaming fire

verses.text: A remover of exteriors.
verses.translation: that will pull out the skin of the scalp.

verses.text: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
verses.translation: It will call him who had turned his back and fled away (from the truth)

verses.text: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
verses.translation: and accumulated (wealth) and hoarded (it).

verses.text: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
verses.translation: Indeed man is created weak in courage,

verses.text: When evil touches him, impatient,
verses.translation: very upset when touched by evil,

verses.text: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
verses.translation: and very niggard when visited by good (fortune),

verses.text: Except the observers of prayer -
verses.translation: except the performers of Salāh,

verses.text: Those who are constant in their prayer
verses.translation: who are regular in their Salāh,

verses.text: And those within whose wealth is a known right
verses.translation: and those in whose riches there is a specified right

verses.text: For the petitioner and the deprived -
verses.translation: for the one who asks and the one who is deprived,

verses.text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
verses.translation: and those who believe in the Day of Judgment as true,

verses.text: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
verses.translation: and those who are fearful of the torment of their Lord-

verses.text: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
verses.translation: -Indeed the torment of their Lord is not something to be fearless from.-

verses.text: And those who guard their private parts
verses.translation: and those who guard their private parts,

verses.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
verses.translation: except from their wives and those (slave-girls) owned by their hands,- because they are not to be blamed,

verses.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
verses.translation: but the one who seeks (sexual gratification) beyond that, then such people are the transgressors,-

verses.text: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
verses.translation: and those who are careful about their trusts and covenants,

verses.text: And those who are in their testimonies upright
verses.translation: and those who are upright in their testimonies,

verses.text: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
verses.translation: and those who take due care of their Salāh .

verses.text: They will be in gardens, honored.
verses.translation: Those will be honoured in gardens (of Jannah ).

verses.text: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
verses.translation: So what has happened to those who disbelieve that they are rushing towards you

verses.text: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
verses.translation: from the right and from the left, in groups?

verses.text: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
verses.translation: Does every one of them aspire to be admitted to the garden of bliss?

verses.text: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
verses.translation: By no means! We have created them from what they know.

verses.text: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
verses.translation: So, I swear by the Lord of the points of sunrise and those of sunset, We are powerful

verses.text: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
verses.translation: to bring those better than them in their place, and We are not to be frustrated.

verses.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
verses.translation: So, leave them involved in pastime and play until they encounter their Day, which they are promised,

verses.text: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
verses.translation: the Day they will come out of the graves quickly, as if they were rushing toward idols,

verses.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
verses.translation: with their eyes downcast, enveloped by ignominy. That is the Day, which they were being promised.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
verses.translation: We sent NūH to his people (and said to him): “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

verses.text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
verses.translation: He said, “O my people, I openly warn you

verses.text: [Saying], 'Worship Allah , fear Him and obey me.
verses.translation: that you must worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me,

verses.text: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah , when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
verses.translation: and Allah will forgive you your sins, and will respite you to an appointed term. Indeed when Allah’s term comes, it is not deferred, if you only know!”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day,

verses.text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
verses.translation: but my call added only to their flight (from the truth).

verses.text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
verses.translation: Whenever I called them, so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped their clothes around themselves, and grew obstinate, and waxed proud in extreme arrogance.

verses.text: Then I invited them publicly.
verses.translation: Then I called them loudly,

verses.text: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
verses.translation: and then I spoke to them in public and spoke to them in private.

verses.text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.translation: So I said, ‘Pray to your Lord for your forgiveness,- Indeed He is Very-Forgiving, -

verses.text: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
verses.translation: and He will cause the heavens to rain upon you in abundance,

verses.text: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
verses.translation: and will help you with riches and sons, and will cause gardens to grow for you, and cause rivers to flow for you.

verses.text: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
verses.translation: What has happened to you that you do not appreciate the Majesty of Allah,

verses.text: While He has created you in stages?
verses.translation: while He has created you in different phases?

verses.text: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
verses.translation: Did you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon another,

verses.text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
verses.translation: and has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

verses.text: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
verses.translation: And Allah has caused you to grow well out of the earth,

verses.text: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
verses.translation: then He will send you back into it, and will bring you forth once again.

verses.text: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
verses.translation: And Allah has made the earth a spread for you,

verses.text: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
verses.translation: so that you may go about its broad ways.’”

verses.text: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
verses.translation: And said NūH, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed him whose wealth and children added nothing to him but loss,

verses.text: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
verses.translation: and they devised a mighty plot,

verses.text: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
verses.translation: and said (to their people), “Never forsake your gods, and never forsake Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr.

verses.text: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
verses.translation: And they have led many astray. And (O my Lord,) let not the wrongdoers progress in anything but deviation from the right path.”

verses.text: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
verses.translation: Because of their sins they were drowned, and then admitted into the Fire. So they found no helpers for them besides Allah.

verses.text: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
verses.translation: And said NūH, “My Lord, do not leave on earth even a single inhabitant (surviving) out of the disbelievers.

verses.text: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
verses.translation: If You leave them (surviving), they will lead Your servants astray, and will beget none but a sinful disbeliever.

verses.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
verses.translation: My Lord, grant pardon to me, and to my parents, and to everyone who enters my home as a believer, and to all the believing men and believing women, and do not increase the wrongdoers but in ruin.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
verses.translation: Say, “It has been revealed to me that a group from Jinn has listened (to the Qur’ān), and said (to their people), ‘Indeed we have heard an amazing Recital (Qur’ān)

verses.text: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
verses.translation: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate a partner with our Lord.’

verses.text: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
verses.translation: and (then the Jinns started talking to each other) that exalted is the Glory of our Lord; He has taken neither a wife, nor a son,

verses.text: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
verses.translation: and that the fools among us used to attribute to Allah extremely absurd things,

verses.text: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
verses.translation: and that we thought that the humans and the Jinn would never tell a lie about Allah, (therefore, we had followed them in shirk under this impression),

verses.text: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
verses.translation: and that some guys from human beings used to seek refuge with some guys of the Jinn, and thus they increased them (the Jinns) in arrogance,

verses.text: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
verses.translation: and that they (humans) thought as you (O Jinns) thought that Allah will never resurrect anyone,

verses.text: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
verses.translation: and that we sought (to reach) the sky, but we found it filled with stern guards and flames,

verses.text: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
verses.translation: and that we used to sit at places therein to listen; but if one will (try to) listen now, he will find a flame in ambush for him,

verses.text: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
verses.translation: and that we do not know whether it is a bad end that is intended for those on earth, or their Lord has intended for them a right thing,

verses.text: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
verses.translation: and that some of us are (already) righteous, and some of us are otherwise, and we were on different ways;

verses.text: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
verses.translation: and that we have now believed that we can never frustrate Allah on the earth, nor can we baffle Him by escape,

verses.text: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
verses.translation: and that when we heard the Guiding Discourse, we believed in it; so if one believes in his Lord, he will have no fear of either any curtailment (in his reward) or any excess (in his punishment),

verses.text: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah ], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
verses.translation: and that some of us are Muslims, and some of us are unjust. Now, those who submitted to Islam have found out the right path,

verses.text: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
verses.translation: As for the unjust, they have become firewood for Hell.”

verses.text: And [ Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
verses.translation: “(And it is also revealed to me) that if they (the people of Makkah) had stood firm on the (right) way, We would have supplied water to them in abundance,

verses.text: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
verses.translation: so that We test them thereby; and if one turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into a severe torment,

verses.text: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah , so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
verses.translation: and that masājid (mosques) belong to Allah; so, do not invoke anyone along with Allah,

verses.text: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
verses.translation: and that when Allah’s servant stood invoking Him, they almost rushed on him in crowds.”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
verses.translation: Say, “I invoke my Lord, and do not associate anyone with Him.”

verses.text: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
verses.translation: Say, “I possess no power to cause you any harm or bring you to a right way.”

verses.text: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
verses.translation: Say, “No one can ever save me from Allah, and I can never find a refuge save with Him.

verses.text: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah , and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
verses.translation: However, (I have been given power) of conveying (commands) from Allah, and His messages. The one who disobeys Allah and His Messenger, for him there is the fire of Hell, wherein such people will live forever.

verses.text: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
verses.translation: (The disbelievers will continue denying the truth and mock at it) until when they will see what they are promised, they will know whose supporters are weaker, and whose numbers are less.

verses.text: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
verses.translation: Say, “I do not know whether that which you are promised is near, or my Lord has appointed for it a distant term.

verses.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
verses.translation: (He is the) Knower of the Unseen. So He does not let anyone know the Unseen created by Him,

verses.text: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
verses.translation: except a messenger whom He chooses (to inform through revelation), and then He appoints (angels as) watching guards before him and behind him, (so that devils may not tamper with the divine revelation,)

verses.text: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
verses.translation: so that He knows that they (angels) have conveyed the messages of their Lord. And He has encompassed all that is with them, and has comprehensive knowledge of every thing by numbers.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
verses.translation: O you, wrapped up in clothes,

verses.text: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
verses.translation: stand at night (for prayer) except a little-

verses.text: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
verses.translation: -half of it, or make it a little less,

verses.text: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
verses.translation: or make it a little more; and recite the Qur’ān clearly with tartīl (in a distinct and measured tone).

verses.text: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
verses.translation: We are going to send down to you a weighty discourse.

verses.text: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
verses.translation: Truly, rising by night (for prayer of tahajjud) is the most effective way to subdue (one’s base self) and to make speech more upright.

verses.text: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
verses.translation: Surely, in daytime, you have a lengthy work to do.

verses.text: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
verses.translation: And remember the name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.

verses.text: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
verses.translation: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for (your) Guardian.

verses.text: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
verses.translation: And bear patiently what they (the opponents) say, and part with them in a beautiful manner.

verses.text: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
verses.translation: And leave Me alone (to deal) with the deniers, the people of luxury, and give them respite for a while.

verses.text: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
verses.translation: Surely with Us are fetters and flaming fire,

verses.text: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
verses.translation: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment

verses.text: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
verses.translation: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will turn into a slipping heap of sand.

verses.text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
verses.translation: (O people,) We have sent to you a messenger, as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).

verses.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
verses.translation: Then, Fir‘aun disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a severe seizure.

verses.text: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
verses.translation: So, if you disbelieve, how will you save yourself from a day that will turn the small boys into grey-headed old men,

verses.text: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
verses.translation: whereby the sky will burst apart. His promise has to be fulfilled.

verses.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
verses.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah . So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah . It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah . Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: Your Lord knows that you stand (in prayer) for nearly two thirds of the night, and (at times) for half of it, and (at times) for one third of it, and (so do) a group of those who are with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you (O Muslims,) cannot do it in regular way; therefore He turned to you in mercy.Now, recite as much of the Qur’ān as is easy (for you). He knows that some of you may be sick, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and yet others fighting in Allah’s way. Therefore, recite as much of it as is easy. And establish Salāh, and pay Zakāh, and advance to Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you will send ahead for your own-selves, you will find it with Allah much better in condition, and much greater in reward. And seek forgiveness from Allah. Indeed Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
verses.translation: O you, enveloped in a mantle,

verses.text: Arise and warn
verses.translation: stand up and warn,

verses.text: And your Lord glorify
verses.translation: and pronounce the greatness of your Lord,

verses.text: And your clothing purify
verses.translation: and purify your clothes,

verses.text: And uncleanliness avoid
verses.translation: and keep away from filth,

verses.text: And do not confer favor to acquire more
verses.translation: and do not do a favour (to anyone merely) to seek more (in return).

verses.text: But for your Lord be patient.
verses.translation: And for the sake of your Lord, observe patience.

verses.text: And when the trumpet is blown,
verses.translation: For when the trumpet will be blown,

verses.text: That Day will be a difficult day
verses.translation: that day will be a difficult day,

verses.text: For the disbelievers - not easy.
verses.translation: not easy for the disbelievers.

verses.text: Leave Me with the one I created alone
verses.translation: Leave me alone (to deal) with the one whom I created lonely,

verses.text: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
verses.translation: and gave him extensive wealth,

verses.text: And children present [with him]
verses.translation: and sons present before (his) eyes,

verses.text: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
verses.translation: and extended (power and honour) to him pretty well.

verses.text: Then he desires that I should add more.
verses.translation: Still, he aspires that I should give him more.

verses.text: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
verses.translation: Never! He is inimical towards Our verses.

verses.text: I will cover him with arduous torment.
verses.translation: I will force him to climb the mountain Sa‘ūd.

verses.text: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
verses.translation: He pondered and surmised.

verses.text: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
verses.translation: Death onto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!

verses.text: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
verses.translation: Again, death unto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!

verses.text: Then he considered [again];
verses.translation: Then he looked (to those around him,)

verses.text: Then he frowned and scowled;
verses.translation: then he frowned and scowled,

verses.text: Then he turned back and was arrogant
verses.translation: then turned his back, and waxed proud,

verses.text: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
verses.translation: then said, “This is nothing but traditional magic;

verses.text: This is not but the word of a human being."
verses.translation: this is nothing but saying of a mortal.”

verses.text: I will drive him into Saqar.
verses.translation: I will put him into Saqar (Hell).

verses.text: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
verses.translation: And what can let you know what Saqar is?

verses.text: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
verses.translation: It neither spares (anything inside it from burning) nor leaves (any disbeliever outside).

verses.text: Blackening the skins.
verses.translation: It will disfigure the skins.

verses.text: Over it are nineteen [angels].
verses.translation: Appointed on it are nineteen (wardens).

verses.text: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
verses.translation: And We did not make wardens of the Fire but (from) angels, and did not fix their number but as a test for those who disbelieve, so that those who are given the Book may come to believe, and those who believe may improve in belief, and so that those who are given the Book and those who believe may not doubt (its correctness), and so that those having malady in their hearts and the disbelievers say, “What has Allah meant by this strange statement?” Thus Allah lets go astray whomever He wills, and leads to the right path whomever He wills. And no one knows the hosts of your Lord but He. And this is nothing else but a reminder for mankind.

verses.text: No! By the moon
verses.translation: Truly, I swear by the moon,

verses.text: And [by] the night when it departs
verses.translation: and by the night when it goes back,

verses.text: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
verses.translation: and by the morning when it becomes bright,

verses.text: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
verses.translation: it (Saqar : Hell) is one of the greatest things

verses.text: As a warning to humanity -
verses.translation: as a warning to the mankind,

verses.text: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
verses.translation: to the one from among you who wishes to come forward (towards good deeds) or to go back (from them).

verses.text: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
verses.translation: Everyone will be detained (in the Hell) because of what he did,

verses.text: Except the companions of the right,
verses.translation: except the People of the Right, (i.e. those who will be given their Book of Deeds in their right hands)

verses.text: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
verses.translation: who will be in gardens, asking

verses.text: About the criminals,
verses.translation: about the guilty persons,

verses.text: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
verses.translation: “What has brought you to Saqar? (Hell)”

verses.text: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
verses.translation: They will say, “We were not among those who offered Salāh , (obligatory prayer)

verses.text: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
verses.translation: and we did not give food to the needy,

verses.text: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
verses.translation: and we indulged (in mocking at the truth) along with those who indulged,

verses.text: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
verses.translation: and we used to deny the Day of Requital,

verses.text: Until there came to us the certainty."
verses.translation: until when we were overtaken by that which is certain.”

verses.text: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
verses.translation: Then intercession of intercessors will not benefit them.

verses.text: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
verses.translation: So what has happened to them that they are turning away from the Reminder,

verses.text: As if they were alarmed donkeys
verses.translation: as if they were wild donkeys,

verses.text: Fleeing from a lion?
verses.translation: fleeing from a lion?

verses.text: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
verses.translation: Rather, every one of them wishes that he should be given unrolled (divine) scriptures.

verses.text: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
verses.translation: Never! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

verses.text: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
verses.translation: Never! Indeed, this is a Reminder.

verses.text: Then whoever wills will remember it.
verses.translation: So, whoever so wishes may take advice from it.

verses.text: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
verses.translation: And they will not take advice unless Allah so wills. He is worthy to be feared, and worthy to forgive.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
verses.translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,

verses.text: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
verses.translation: and I swear by the self-reproaching conscience, (that Resurrection is a reality.)

verses.text: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
verses.translation: Does man think that We will never reassemble his bones?

verses.text: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
verses.translation: Why (can We) not (do so), while We are able to reset (even) his fingertips perfectly?

verses.text: But man desires to continue in sin.
verses.translation: But man wishes to go on violating Allah’s injunctions (even in future) ahead of him.

verses.text: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
verses.translation: He asks, “When will be this Day of Resurrection?”

verses.text: So when vision is dazzled
verses.translation: So, when the eyes will be dazzled,

verses.text: And the moon darkens
verses.translation: and the moon will lose its light,

verses.text: And the sun and the moon are joined,
verses.translation: and the sun and the moon will be joined together,

verses.text: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
verses.translation: on that day man will say, “Where to escape?”

verses.text: No! There is no refuge.
verses.translation: Never! There will be no refuge at all.

verses.text: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
verses.translation: On that day, towards your Lord will be the destination (of everyone.)

verses.text: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
verses.translation: Man will be informed of what he sent ahead and what he left behind.

verses.text: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
verses.translation: Rather, man will be a witness against himself,

verses.text: Even if he presents his excuses.
verses.translation: even though he may offer his excuses.

verses.text: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
verses.translation: (O Prophet,) do not move your tongue (during revelation) for (reciting) it (the Qur’ān) to receive it in hurry.

verses.text: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
verses.translation: It is surely undertaken by Us to store it (in your heart), and to let it be recited (by you after revelation is completed).

verses.text: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
verses.translation: Therefore, when it is recited by Us (through the angel), follow its recitation (by concentration of your heart).

verses.text: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
verses.translation: Then, it is undertaken by Us to explain it.

verses.text: No! But you love the immediate
verses.translation: Never, (your denial of Resurrection is never based on any sound reason!) Instead, you love that which is immediate,

verses.text: And leave the Hereafter.
verses.translation: and neglect the Hereafter.

verses.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
verses.translation: Many faces, that day, will be glowing,

verses.text: Looking at their Lord.
verses.translation: looking towards their Lord,

verses.text: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
verses.translation: and many faces, that day, will be gloomy,

verses.text: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
verses.translation: realizing that a back-breaking calamity is going to be afflicted on them.

verses.text: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
verses.translation: Never, (you will never remain in this world forever!) When the soul (of a patient) reaches the clavicles,

verses.text: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
verses.translation: and it is said, “Who is an enchanter (that can save him?)”

verses.text: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
verses.translation: and he realizes that it is (the time of) departure (from the world,)

verses.text: And the leg is wound about the leg,
verses.translation: and one shank is intertwined with the other shank,

verses.text: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
verses.translation: then on that day, it is to your Lord that one has to be driven.

verses.text: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
verses.translation: So (the denier of the Hereafter) neither believed, nor prayed,

verses.text: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
verses.translation: but rejected the truth and turned away (from it),

verses.text: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
verses.translation: then he went to his home, puffed up with pride.

verses.text: Woe to you, and woe!
verses.translation: (It will be said to such a man,) Woe to you, then woe to you!

verses.text: Then woe to you, and woe!
verses.translation: Again, woe to you, then woe to you!

verses.text: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
verses.translation: Does man presume that he will be left unchecked?

verses.text: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
verses.translation: Was he not an ejaculated drop of semen?

verses.text: Then he was a clinging clot, and [ Allah ] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
verses.translation: Then he became a clot of blood, then He created (him) and made (him) perfect,

verses.text: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
verses.translation: and made from him two kinds, male and female.

verses.text: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
verses.translation: Has He no power to give life to the dead?

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
verses.translation: There has come upon man a period of time in which he was nothing worth mentioning.

verses.text: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
verses.translation: We have created man from a mixed sperm-drop to put him to a test; then We made him able to hear, able to see.

verses.text: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
verses.translation: We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.

verses.text: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
verses.translation: We have prepared, for the disbelievers, shackles and iron-collars and a blazing Fire.

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will have a drink from a goblet, blended with (a drink from) Camphor

verses.text: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
verses.translation: that will be a spring from which Allah’s servants will drink, making it flow (wherever they wish) profusely.

verses.text: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
verses.translation: They (are the ones who) fulfill their vows, and fear a day whose evil (events) will spread far and wide,

verses.text: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
verses.translation: and they give food, out of their love for Him (Allah), to the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,

verses.text: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah . We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
verses.translation: (saying to them,) “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we have no intention of (receiving) either a return from you or thanks.

verses.text: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
verses.translation: In fact, we are fearful of a day, from the side of our Lord, that will be frowning, extremely malignant.”

verses.text: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
verses.translation: So Allah will save them from the evil of that day, and will grant them bloom and delight,

verses.text: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
verses.translation: and will give them, in return for their patience, Paradise and (garments of) silk,

verses.text: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
verses.translation: wherein they will be reclining on couches, feeling neither heat of the sun nor intense cold.

verses.text: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
verses.translation: And shades of gardens will be hanging low on them, and their fruits will be placed totally under their command.

verses.text: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
verses.translation: Circulated among them will be vessels of silver, and cups that will be (as transparent as) crystals,

verses.text: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
verses.translation: -crystals (as shining as if made) of silver, measured by those (who filled them) with due measure.

verses.text: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
verses.translation: And they will be served with goblet of a drink blended with ginger,

verses.text: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
verses.translation: (acquired from) a spring therein called Salsabīl.

verses.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
verses.translation: And circling around them will be serving boys, blessed with eternal youth; when you would see them, you would take them as scattered pearls.

verses.text: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
verses.translation: When you will look around there, you will see the Bliss and a magnificent realm.

verses.text: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
verses.translation: Upon them will be garments of green sundus (a kind of fine silk), and of istabraq (a kind of thick silk), and they will be adorned by bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure beverage to drink:

verses.text: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
verses.translation: “This is a reward for you, and your effort has been appreciated.”

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
verses.translation: Indeed we have revealed to you the Qur’ān through a gradual process.

verses.text: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
verses.translation: So, be steadfast patiently in (obeying) your Lord’s command, and do not obey any one of them who is sinner or ungrateful.

verses.text: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
verses.translation: And pronounce the name of Allah morning and evening.

verses.text: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
verses.translation: And in some parts of night prostrate yourself before Him, and pronounce His purity for long times at night.

verses.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
verses.translation: In fact these people love that which is immediate, and neglect a Heavy Day ahead of them.

verses.text: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
verses.translation: We have created them and have made their joints strong. And whenever We will, We would replace them with others like them, a total replacement.

verses.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
verses.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.

verses.text: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: And you will not so wish unless Allah so wills. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.text: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
verses.translation: He admits whomsoever He wills to His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
verses.translation: (I swear) by those (winds) that are sent one after the other,

verses.text: And the winds that blow violently
verses.translation: and by those that blow violently,

verses.text: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
verses.translation: and by those that spread (clouds) all over,

verses.text: And those [angels] who bring criterion
verses.translation: and by those (angels) who differentiate (between right and wrong) distinctly,

verses.text: And those [angels] who deliver a message
verses.translation: then bring down the advice,

verses.text: As justification or warning,
verses.translation: leaving no excuse (for the disbelievers) or giving warnings,

verses.text: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
verses.translation: that which you are promised is sure to happen.

verses.text: So when the stars are obliterated
verses.translation: So, when the stars will be extinguished,

verses.text: And when the heaven is opened
verses.translation: and when the sky will be split,

verses.text: And when the mountains are blown away
verses.translation: and when the mountains will be blown away as dust,

verses.text: And when the messengers' time has come...
verses.translation: and when the messengers will be assembled at the appointed time, (then all matters will be decided.)

verses.text: For what Day was it postponed?
verses.translation: (Do you know) for which day has all this been delayed?

verses.text: For the Day of Judgement.
verses.translation: For the Day of Decision!

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what the Day of Decision is?

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
verses.translation: Did We not destroy the earlier people?

verses.text: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
verses.translation: Then We will cause the later ones to follow them.

verses.text: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
verses.translation: Thus We deal with the guilty people.

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
verses.translation: Did We not create you from a worthless fluid?

verses.text: And We placed it in a firm lodging
verses.translation: Then We put it in a firm place of rest

verses.text: For a known extent.
verses.translation: for a known period.

verses.text: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
verses.translation: Thus We did (all this with perfect) measure; so We are the best to measure.

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: Have We not made the earth a container
verses.translation: Did We not make the earth a container that collects

verses.text: Of the living and the dead?
verses.translation: the living and the dead?

verses.text: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
verses.translation: And We placed towering mountains therein, and provided you with sweet water to drink.

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
verses.translation: (It will be said to them on that day,) “Push on to what you used to deny.

verses.text: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
verses.translation: Push on to a canopy (of Hell’s smoke) having three branches,

verses.text: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
verses.translation: that neither has a comfortable shade, nor is it of any use against the scorching heat.

verses.text: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
verses.translation: It emits sparks (as huge) as castles,

verses.text: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
verses.translation: as if they were yellowish camels.”

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: This is a Day they will not speak,
verses.translation: This is the day when they will not speak,

verses.text: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
verses.translation: nor will they be allowed to offer excuses.

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
verses.translation: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Decision. We have assembled you and the earlier ones together.

verses.text: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
verses.translation: Now, if you have a trick, use the trick against Me.”

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
verses.translation: Of course, the God-fearing will be amid shades and streams,

verses.text: And fruits from whatever they desire,
verses.translation: and fruits of their desire.

verses.text: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.translation: It will be said to them, “Eat and drink with pleasure because of what you used to do.”

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: This is how We reward those who do good deeds.

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
verses.translation: “(O disbelievers,) eat and drink for a while! You are guilty ones.”

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, “Bow down (i.e. submit to Allah’s commands)”, they do not bow down.

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe that Day to the deniers!

verses.text: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
verses.translation: Now, in which discourse, after this, will they believe?

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: About what are they asking one another?
verses.translation: About what are they asking each other?

verses.text: About the great news -
verses.translation: About the Great Event

verses.text: That over which they are in disagreement.
verses.translation: in which they dispute!

verses.text: No! They are going to know.
verses.translation: Indeed they will soon know.

verses.text: Then, no! They are going to know.
verses.translation: Again, indeed they will soon know.

verses.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
verses.translation: Did We not make the earth a floor,

verses.text: And the mountains as stakes?
verses.translation: and the mountains bulwarks?

verses.text: And We created you in pairs
verses.translation: And We have created you in pairs,

verses.text: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
verses.translation: and made your sleep a source of rest,

verses.text: And made the night as clothing
verses.translation: and made the night a covering,

verses.text: And made the day for livelihood
verses.translation: and made the day a source of livelihood.

verses.text: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
verses.translation: And We have built seven strong (skies),

verses.text: And made [therein] a burning lamp
verses.translation: and created a luminous lamp (the sun).

verses.text: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
verses.translation: And We have sent down abundant water from the rain-laden clouds,

verses.text: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
verses.translation: so that We bring out therewith grain and vegetation,

verses.text: And gardens of entwined growth.
verses.translation: and thick gardens.

verses.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
verses.translation: Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,

verses.text: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
verses.translation: a day when the trumpet will be blown, so you will come in multitudes,

verses.text: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
verses.translation: and the sky will be opened, so it will become as gates,

verses.text: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
verses.translation: and the mountains will be set in motion, so they will be as mirage.

verses.text: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
verses.translation: Surely Jahannam (the Hell) lurks in ambush.

verses.text: For the transgressors, a place of return,
verses.translation: (It is) abode for the rebellious people

verses.text: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
verses.translation: who will be abiding in it for ages.

verses.text: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
verses.translation: They will taste nothing cool in it, nor a drink,

verses.text: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
verses.translation: except boiling water and pus,

verses.text: An appropriate recompense.
verses.translation: this being a punishment, fully commensurate (with their deeds).

verses.text: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
verses.translation: They did not expect (to face) accounting (of their deeds),

verses.text: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
verses.translation: and they rejected Our signs totally.

verses.text: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
verses.translation: And everything (from their deeds) is thoroughly recorded by Us in writing.

verses.text: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
verses.translation: “So now taste! We will add nothing to you but torment.”

verses.text: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
verses.translation: Of course, the God-fearing will have great achievement,

verses.text: Gardens and grapevines
verses.translation: -gardens and grapes,

verses.text: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
verses.translation: and buxom maidens of matching age,

verses.text: And a full cup.
verses.translation: and goblets filled up to the brim.

verses.text: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
verses.translation: They will not hear any vain talk therein, nor lies,

verses.text: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
verses.translation: this being a reward from their Lord, a well calculated grant,

verses.text: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
verses.translation: (from) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the All-Merciful. No one will have power to address Him,

verses.text: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
verses.translation: on the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows. They will not speak, except the one who is permitted by the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) and speaks aright.

verses.text: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
verses.translation: That is the Day that is sure to come. So whoever so wishes may take refuge with his Lord.

verses.text: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
verses.translation: We have warned you of an approaching torment (that will be inflicted) on a day when one will see what his hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will say, “O would that I had turned into dust.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [angels] who extract with violence
verses.translation: I swear by those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the infidels) with extreme force,

verses.text: And [by] those who remove with ease
verses.translation: and by those (angels) who untie the knot (of the souls of the believers) smoothly,

verses.text: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
verses.translation: and by those who float (in the atmosphere) swiftly,

verses.text: And those who race each other in a race
verses.translation: then proceed forward quickly,

verses.text: And those who arrange [each] matter,
verses.translation: then manage (to do) everything (they are ordered to do,)

verses.text: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
verses.translation: (you will be resurrected) on the Day when the shocking event (i.e. the first blowing of the trumpet) will shock (everything),

verses.text: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
verses.translation: followed by the next one (i.e. the second blowing of the trumpet.)

verses.text: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
verses.translation: On that day, hearts (of people) will be throbbing,

verses.text: Their eyes humbled.
verses.translation: with their eyes downcast.

verses.text: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
verses.translation: They (the infidels) say, “Are we going to be brought back to our former state (of Life)?

verses.text: Even if we should be decayed bones?
verses.translation: Is it when we are turned into decayed bones?”

verses.text: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
verses.translation: They say, “If so, that will be a harmful homecoming.”

verses.text: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
verses.translation: In fact, it will be only a single harsh voice,

verses.text: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
verses.translation: and in no time they will be (brought) into the plain (of Hashr).

verses.text: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
verses.translation: Has there come to you the narrative about Mūsā?

verses.text: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
verses.translation: (Recall) when his Lord called to him in the blessed valley of Tuwā:

verses.text: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
verses.translation: “Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh). Indeed, he has crossed all bounds.

verses.text: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
verses.translation: And say (to him,) ‘Would you like to purify yourself,

verses.text: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
verses.translation: and that I should guide you to your Lord, so that you fear (Him)?’”

verses.text: And he showed him the greatest sign,
verses.translation: So, he (Mūsā) showed him the biggest sign.

verses.text: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
verses.translation: But he rejected and disobeyed,

verses.text: Then he turned his back, striving.
verses.translation: then he turned back, and tried hard (to refute the Messenger),

verses.text: And he gathered [his people] and called out
verses.translation: then he gathered (his people) and shouted

verses.text: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
verses.translation: and said, “I am your supreme lord.”

verses.text: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
verses.translation: So, Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in the Hereafter and the present world.

verses.text: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [ Allah ].
verses.translation: Indeed, there is a lesson for him who fears (Allah).

verses.text: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
verses.translation: Is your creation more difficult or that of the sky? He has built it,

verses.text: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
verses.translation: He has raised its height, then made it proper,

verses.text: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
verses.translation: and darkened its night, and brought forth its daylight,

verses.text: And after that He spread the earth.
verses.translation: and, after that, He spread out the earth.

verses.text: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
verses.translation: From it, He brought out its water and its meadows,

verses.text: And the mountains He set firmly
verses.translation: and firmly fixed the mountains,

verses.text: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
verses.translation: (all this) as a benefit to you and your cattle.

verses.text: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
verses.translation: So when the Greatest Havoc will take place

verses.text: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
verses.translation: on the day when man will recall what he did,

verses.text: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
verses.translation: and the Hell will be exposed for all who see,

verses.text: So as for he who transgressed
verses.translation: then for the one who had rebelled,

verses.text: And preferred the life of the world,
verses.translation: and preferred the worldly life (to the Hereafter),

verses.text: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
verses.translation: the Hell will be the abode,

verses.text: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
verses.translation: whereas for the one who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained his self from the (evil) desire,

verses.text: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
verses.translation: the Paradise will be the abode.

verses.text: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
verses.translation: They ask you (O Prophet,) about the Hour (the Day of Judgment) as to when it will take place.

verses.text: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
verses.translation: In which capacity are you to tell this?

verses.text: To your Lord is its finality.
verses.translation: With your Lord is the final word about it.

verses.text: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
verses.translation: You are only a warner for anyone who fears it.

verses.text: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
verses.translation: The day they will see it, it will seem to them as if they did not live (in the world) but only for one afternoon or for the morning thereof.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Prophet frowned and turned away
verses.translation: He (the Prophet) frowned and turned his face,

verses.text: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
verses.translation: because the blind man came to him!

verses.text: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
verses.translation: What could tell you (O prophet about the prospects of the blind man?) May be, (if you had attended him properly,) he would have attained purity,

verses.text: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
verses.translation: or have received the advice, and the advice would have benefited him.

verses.text: As for he who thinks himself without need,
verses.translation: As for the one who does not care (about faith),

verses.text: To him you give attention.
verses.translation: you are anxious to pursue him,

verses.text: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
verses.translation: while there is no blame on you, if he does not attain purity.

verses.text: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
verses.translation: As regards the one who has come to you rushing eagerly,

verses.text: While he fears [ Allah ],
verses.translation: while he fears (Allah),

verses.text: From him you are distracted.
verses.translation: to him you pay no heed!

verses.text: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
verses.translation: Never! (you should never act in this way,) Indeed this (Qur’ān) is an advice.

verses.text: So whoever wills may remember it.
verses.translation: So, whoever so wills may pay heed to it.

verses.text: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
verses.translation: It is (recorded) in those scripts (of the Preserved Tablet) that are honoured,

verses.text: Exalted and purified,
verses.translation: exalted, purified,

verses.text: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
verses.translation: in the hands of those scribes

verses.text: Noble and dutiful.
verses.translation: who are honorable, righteous.

verses.text: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
verses.translation: Damned is the man! How ungrateful he is!

verses.text: From what substance did He create him?
verses.translation: From which stuff did He (Allah) create him?

verses.text: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
verses.translation: from a drop of semen! He created him, and designed him in due proportion,

verses.text: Then He eased the way for him;
verses.translation: then He made the way easy for him,

verses.text: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
verses.translation: Later, he made him die, and put him into grave,

verses.text: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
verses.translation: Thereafter, when He will intend, He will raise him up.

verses.text: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
verses.translation: No! He has not yet fulfilled what He (Allah) had commanded him.

verses.text: Then let mankind look at his food -
verses.translation: So, the man should consider his food,

verses.text: How We poured down water in torrents,
verses.translation: how well We poured water,

verses.text: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
verses.translation: then how nicely We split the earth,

verses.text: And caused to grow within it grain
verses.translation: then We grew in it grain,

verses.text: And grapes and herbage
verses.translation: and grapes and greens,

verses.text: And olive and palm trees
verses.translation: and olive and date-palms,

verses.text: And gardens of dense shrubbery
verses.translation: and gardens, full of thick trees,

verses.text: And fruit and grass -
verses.translation: and fruits and fodder,

verses.text: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
verses.translation: as a benefit for you and your cattle.

verses.text: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
verses.translation: So when the Deafening Noise will occur,

verses.text: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
verses.translation: the Day when one will flee from his brother,

verses.text: And his mother and his father
verses.translation: and from his mother and father,

verses.text: And his wife and his children,
verses.translation: and from his wife and sons,

verses.text: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
verses.translation: every one of them will be too engaged in his own affairs to care for others.

verses.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
verses.translation: Many faces, on that day, will be bright,

verses.text: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
verses.translation: laughing, rejoicing,

verses.text: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
verses.translation: and many faces, on that day, will be stained with dust,

verses.text: Blackness will cover them.
verses.translation: covered by darkness.

verses.text: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
verses.translation: Those are the disbelievers, the nefarious.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
verses.translation: When the sun will be folded up,

verses.text: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
verses.translation: and when the stars will swoop down,
