verses.text: And when the mountains are removed
verses.translation: and when the mountains will be set in motion,

verses.text: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
verses.translation: and when the ten-months pregnant she-camels will be abandoned,

verses.text: And when the wild beasts are gathered
verses.translation: and when the wild beasts will be gathered together,

verses.text: And when the seas are filled with flame
verses.translation: and when the seas will be flared up,

verses.text: And when the souls are paired
verses.translation: and when the people will be arranged in categories,

verses.text: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
verses.translation: and when the girl-child that was buried alive will be asked,

verses.text: For what sin she was killed
verses.translation: for what sin she was killed,

verses.text: And when the pages are made public
verses.translation: and when the scrolls (of deeds) will be unrolled,

verses.text: And when the sky is stripped away
verses.translation: and when the sky will be stripped off,

verses.text: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
verses.translation: and when the Hell will be set ablaze,

verses.text: And when Paradise is brought near,
verses.translation: and when the Paradise will be brought close,

verses.text: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
verses.translation: then everyone will know what he (or she) has put forward.

verses.text: So I swear by the retreating stars -
verses.translation: So, I swear by those (stars) that recede,

verses.text: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
verses.translation: that proceed, that withdraw from the scene,

verses.text: And by the night as it closes in
verses.translation: and by the night when it departs,

verses.text: And by the dawn when it breathes
verses.translation: and the morning when it starts breathing,

verses.text: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
verses.translation: it (the Qur’ān) is surely the word of a noble messenger (Jibra’īl X),

verses.text: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
verses.translation: the one possessing power and a high status with the Lord of the Throne,

verses.text: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
verses.translation: the one obeyed there, trusted.

verses.text: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
verses.translation: Your companion (Muhammad ) is not a madman,

verses.text: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
verses.translation: and he did see him (Jibra’īl X) on the clear horizon.

verses.text: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
verses.translation: And he (the Prophet) is not stingy about (the news of) the unseen.

verses.text: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
verses.translation: Nor is it the word of an outcast satan (devil).

verses.text: So where are you going?
verses.translation: Then where are you going?

verses.text: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
verses.translation: It is nothing else but a message of advice for all the worlds,

verses.text: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
verses.translation: for the benefit of any one from among you who intends to go straight.

verses.text: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: And you cannot intend (to do anything) unless it is so willed by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the sky breaks apart
verses.translation: When the sky will be cleft asunder,

verses.text: And when the stars fall, scattering,
verses.translation: and when the stars will disperse,

verses.text: And when the seas are erupted
verses.translation: and when the seas will be burst forth,

verses.text: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
verses.translation: and when the graves will be overturned,

verses.text: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
verses.translation: then one will know what he sent ahead and what he left behind.

verses.text: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
verses.translation: O man! What has deceived you about your Gracious Lord,

verses.text: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
verses.translation: who created you, then perfected you, then brought you in due proportion?

verses.text: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
verses.translation: He composed you in whichever form He willed.

verses.text: No! But you deny the Recompense.
verses.translation: Never! (i.e. one should never be heedless towards him.) But you deny the Requital,

verses.text: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
verses.translation: while (appointed) over you there are watchers,

verses.text: Noble and recording;
verses.translation: who are noble, writers (of the deeds),

verses.text: They know whatever you do.
verses.translation: who know whatever you do.

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
verses.translation: Surely the righteous will be in bliss,

verses.text: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
verses.translation: and the sinners in Hell,

verses.text: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
verses.translation: in which they will enter on the Day of Requital,

verses.text: And never therefrom will they be absent.
verses.translation: and they will not (be able to) keep away from it.

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?

verses.text: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.translation: Again, what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?

verses.text: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah .
verses.translation: A Day when no one will have power to do any thing for another! And command, on that Day, will belong to Allah (alone).

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Woe to those who give less [than due],
verses.translation: Woe to the curtailers

verses.text: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
verses.translation: who, when they measure something to receive from people, take it in full,

verses.text: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
verses.translation: and when they measure or weigh something to give it to them, give less than due.

verses.text: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
verses.translation: Do they not think that they have to be raised up

verses.text: For a tremendous Day -
verses.translation: on a Great Day,

verses.text: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
verses.translation: the Day when all the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.text: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
verses.translation: Never! (i.e. they should never act in such a way.) Indeed the record of deeds of the sinners is in Sijjīn .

verses.text: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what Sijjīn is?

verses.text: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
verses.translation: A register, inscribed!

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.translation: Woe that day to the deniers,

verses.text: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
verses.translation: who deny the Day of Requital!

verses.text: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
verses.translation: And none denies it but every sinful transgressor.

verses.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) tales of the ancients.”

verses.text: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
verses.translation: No! But that which they used to commit has covered their hearts with rust.

verses.text: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
verses.translation: No! Indeed they will be screened off from their Lord on that Day.

verses.text: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
verses.translation: Then they will have to enter the Hell.

verses.text: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
verses.translation: Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”

verses.text: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
verses.translation: No! The record of deeds of the righteous is in ‘Illiyyūn .

verses.text: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what ‘Illiyyūn is ?

verses.text: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.translation: A register inscribed,

verses.text: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah ].
verses.translation: attended by those (angels) who are blessed with nearness to Allah!

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.translation: Indeed the righteous will be in absolute bliss.

verses.text: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.translation: While (sitting) on thrones they will be watching (the scenes of Paradise).

verses.text: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
verses.translation: You will recognize the glamour of bliss on their faces.

verses.text: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
verses.translation: They will be served with a pure sealed wine to drink,

verses.text: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
verses.translation: the seal of which will be of musk.-It is this (bliss) in aspiring for which the competitors should race each other.

verses.text: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
verses.translation: -and it will be blended with (a drink from) Tasnīm ,

verses.text: A spring from which those near [to Allah ] drink.
verses.translation: a spring from which will drink those who are blessed with nearness.

verses.text: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
verses.translation: Indeed those who were guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

verses.text: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
verses.translation: and when they passed by them, they used to wink at one another,

verses.text: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
verses.translation: and when they went back to their family, they went enjoying their mockery,

verses.text: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
verses.translation: and when they saw them, they said, “Surely these are the ones who have gone astray”

verses.text: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
verses.translation: while they were not sent as watchmen over them.

verses.text: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
verses.translation: So, today those who believed will laugh at the disbelievers.

verses.text: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.translation: While (sitting) on thrones, they will be seeing

verses.text: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
verses.translation: whether the disbelievers have been paid back for what they used to do.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the sky has split [open]
verses.translation: When the sky will split apart,

verses.text: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.translation: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,-

verses.text: And when the earth has been extended
verses.translation: and when the earth will be stretched (to give room to more people),

verses.text: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
verses.translation: and it will throw up whatever it contains, and will become empty,

verses.text: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
verses.translation: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,- (then man will see the consequences of his deeds.)

verses.text: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
verses.translation: O man, you have to work hard constantly to reach your Lord, and then you have to meet Him.

verses.text: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
verses.translation: So, as for him whose book (of deeds) will be given to him in his right hand,

verses.text: He will be judged with an easy account
verses.translation: he will be called to account in an easy manner,

verses.text: And return to his people in happiness.
verses.translation: and he will go back to his people joyfully.

verses.text: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
verses.translation: As for the one whose book (of deeds) will be given to him from his backside,

verses.text: He will cry out for destruction
verses.translation: he will pray for death,

verses.text: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
verses.translation: and will enter the blazing fire.

verses.text: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
verses.translation: He had been joyful among his people (in the world).

verses.text: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah ].
verses.translation: He thought he would never revert (to Allah).

verses.text: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
verses.translation: No! Indeed his Lord was watchful over him.

verses.text: So I swear by the twilight glow
verses.translation: So, I swear by the twilight (after sunset),

verses.text: And [by] the night and what it envelops
verses.translation: and by the night and what it envelops,

verses.text: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
verses.translation: and by the moon when it develops at the full,

verses.text: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
verses.translation: you shall certainly ascend from stage to stage.

verses.text: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
verses.translation: So, what is wrong with them that they do not believe,

verses.text: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah ]?
verses.translation: and when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not offer sajdah (prostration)?

verses.text: But those who have disbelieved deny,
verses.translation: Rather, those who disbelieve deny (the truth).

verses.text: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
verses.translation: And Allah is most aware of what they store.

verses.text: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
verses.translation: So, give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment,

verses.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.translation: but those who believed and did righteous deeds will have a reward that will never be interrupted.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the sky containing great stars
verses.translation: I swear by the sky, the one having stellar formations,

verses.text: And [by] the promised Day
verses.translation: and by the Promised Day,

verses.text: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
verses.translation: and by that which attends, and that which is attended,

verses.text: Cursed were the companions of the trench
verses.translation: cursed were the People of the Trench,

verses.text: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
verses.translation: the (people of the) fire that was rich with fuel,

verses.text: When they were sitting near it
verses.translation: when they were sitting by it,

verses.text: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
verses.translation: and were watching what they were doing with the believers.

verses.text: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
verses.translation: They punished them for nothing but that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Worthy of All Praise,

verses.text: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah , over all things, is Witness.
verses.translation: the One to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is witness over every thing.

verses.text: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
verses.translation: Surely, those who persecuted the believing men and the believing women, then did not repent, -for them there is the torment of Jahannam (Hell), and for them there is the torment of burning.

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
verses.translation: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them there are gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the big achievement.

verses.text: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
verses.translation: The seizure of your Lord is severe indeed!

verses.text: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
verses.translation: Surely He originates (creation) and repeats (it after death).

verses.text: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
verses.translation: And He is the Most-Forgiving, the Most-Loving,

verses.text: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
verses.translation: the Master of the Throne, the Glorious.

verses.text: Effecter of what He intends.
verses.translation: He is ever doer of what He intends.

verses.text: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of the forces,

verses.text: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
verses.translation: of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamūd?

verses.text: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
verses.translation: But those who disbelieve are (engaged) in denying (the truth).

verses.text: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
verses.translation: Allah has encompassed them from all sides.

verses.text: But this is an honored Qur'an
verses.translation: The reality is that it is the glorious Qur’ān,

verses.text: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
verses.translation: (recorded) in the Preserved Tablet (LauH MaHfūZ).

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the sky and the night comer -
verses.translation: I swear by the sky and by the Night-Comer,-

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
verses.translation: -and what may let you know what the Night-Comer is?

verses.text: It is the piercing star -
verses.translation: The star of piercing brightness!- -

verses.text: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
verses.translation: -there is no human being, but there is a watcher over him.

verses.text: So let man observe from what he was created.
verses.translation: So, let man consider of which stuff he is created.

verses.text: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
verses.translation: He is created of spouting water

verses.text: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
verses.translation: that comes out from between the loins and the chest-bones.

verses.text: Indeed, Allah , to return him [to life], is Able.
verses.translation: Surely He is Powerful to bring him back

verses.text: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
verses.translation: on a day when all the secrets will be searched out,

verses.text: Then man will have no power or any helper.
verses.translation: and he will have neither strength (to defend), nor a supporter.

verses.text: By the sky which returns [rain]
verses.translation: I swear by the sky that rains,

verses.text: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
verses.translation: and the earth that cracks open (for plants),

verses.text: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
verses.translation: this is a decisive word,

verses.text: And it is not amusement.
verses.translation: and it is not a joke.

verses.text: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
verses.translation: They are devising plans,

verses.text: But I am planning a plan.
verses.translation: and I Am devising plans.

verses.text: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
verses.translation: So leave the disbelievers alone at the moment; give them respite for a while.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
verses.translation: Pronounce the purity of the name of your most exalted Lord,

verses.text: Who created and proportioned
verses.translation: who created (everything), then made (it) well,

verses.text: And Who destined and [then] guided
verses.translation: and who determined a measure (for everything), then guided (it),

verses.text: And who brings out the pasture
verses.translation: and who brought forth pasturage,

verses.text: And [then] makes it black stubble.
verses.translation: then turned it into a blackening stubble.

verses.text: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
verses.translation: We will make you recite, then you will not forget

verses.text: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
verses.translation: except that which Allah wills. Indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.

verses.text: And We will ease you toward ease.
verses.translation: And We will facilitate for you (to reach) the easiest way.

verses.text: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
verses.translation: So, extend advice (to people) if advice is useful.

verses.text: He who fears [ Allah ] will be reminded.
verses.translation: The one who fears (Allah) will observe the advice,

verses.text: But the wretched one will avoid it -
verses.translation: and it will be avoided by the most wretched one

verses.text: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
verses.translation: who will enter the Biggest Fire,

verses.text: Neither dying therein nor living.
verses.translation: then he will neither die therein, nor live (a desirable life).

verses.text: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
verses.translation: Success is surely achieved by him who purifies himself,

verses.text: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
verses.translation: and pronounces the name of his Lord, then offers prayer.

verses.text: But you prefer the worldly life,
verses.translation: But you prefer the worldly life,

verses.text: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
verses.translation: while the Hereafter is much better and much more durable.

verses.text: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
verses.translation: Indeed this is (written) in the earlier divine scripts,

verses.text: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
verses.translation: the scripts of Ibrāhīm and Mūsā.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
verses.translation: Has there come to you the description of the Overwhelming Event?

verses.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
verses.translation: Many faces that day will be humbled,

verses.text: Working [hard] and exhausted.
verses.translation: laboring, exhausted.

verses.text: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
verses.translation: They will enter into the scorching fire.

verses.text: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
verses.translation: They will be made to drink water from a boiling spring.

verses.text: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
verses.translation: There will be no food for them except from a thorny plant

verses.text: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
verses.translation: that will neither nourish, nor satisfy hunger.

verses.text: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
verses.translation: Many faces that day will be full of glamour,

verses.text: With their effort [they are] satisfied
verses.translation: well pleased with their endeavor,

verses.text: In an elevated garden,
verses.translation: in a lofty garden,

verses.text: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
verses.translation: in which they will not hear any absurd talk.

verses.text: Within it is a flowing spring.
verses.translation: In it there is a flowing spring.

verses.text: Within it are couches raised high
verses.translation: In it there are elevated couches

verses.text: And cups put in place
verses.translation: and goblets, well placed,

verses.text: And cushions lined up
verses.translation: and cushions, arrayed

verses.text: And carpets spread around.
verses.translation: and carpets, spread around.

verses.text: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
verses.translation: So, do they not look at the camels how they are created,

verses.text: And at the sky - how it is raised?
verses.translation: and at the sky, how it is raised high,

verses.text: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
verses.translation: and at the mountains, how they are installed,

verses.text: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
verses.translation: and at the earth, how it is spread out?

verses.text: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
verses.translation: So, (O Prophet,) keep on preaching; you are only a preacher.

verses.text: You are not over them a controller.
verses.translation: You are not a taskmaster set up over them,

verses.text: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
verses.translation: but whoever turns away and disbelieves,

verses.text: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
verses.translation: Allah will punish him with the greatest torment.

verses.text: Indeed, to Us is their return.
verses.translation: Surely towards Us they have to return,

verses.text: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
verses.translation: then it is Our job to call them to account.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the dawn
verses.translation: I swear by the dawn,

verses.text: And [by] ten nights
verses.translation: and by Ten Nights,

verses.text: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
verses.translation: and by the even and the odd,

verses.text: And [by] the night when it passes,
verses.translation: and by the night when it moves away,

verses.text: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
verses.translation: -Is there (not) in such an oath (enough assurance) for a man of sense?-

verses.text: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
verses.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with (the people) of ‘Ād

verses.text: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
verses.translation: of Iram , the men of tall pillars,

verses.text: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
verses.translation: the like of whom were never created in the lands,

verses.text: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
verses.translation: and (how He dealt) with (the people of) Thamūd who had carved out the rocks in the Valley (of Qurā),

verses.text: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
verses.translation: and with Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of the stakes,

verses.text: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
verses.translation: - those who had rebelled in the cities,

verses.text: And increased therein the corruption.
verses.translation: and spread a lot of mischief therein.

verses.text: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
verses.translation: So, your Lord let loose on them the whip of torment.

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
verses.translation: Surely your Lord is ever on the watch.

verses.text: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
verses.translation: As for man, when his Lord tests him, and thus gives him honour and bounties, he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”

verses.text: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
verses.translation: But when he tests him, and thus straitens his provision for him, he says, “My Lord has disgraced me.”

verses.text: No! But you do not honor the orphan
verses.translation: No! But you do not honour the orphan,

verses.text: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
verses.translation: and do not encourage one another to feed the needy.

verses.text: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
verses.translation: And you devour the inheritance with a sweeping gulp,

verses.text: And you love wealth with immense love.
verses.translation: and love wealth, an excessive love.

verses.text: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
verses.translation: No! When the earth will be crushed thoroughly to be turned into bits,

verses.text: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
verses.translation: and your Lord will come, and the angels as well, lined up in rows,

verses.text: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
verses.translation: and Jahannam (Hell), on that day, will be brought forward, it will be the day when man will realize the truth, but from where will he take advantage of such realization?

verses.text: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
verses.translation: He will say, “O Would that I had sent ahead (some good deeds) for (this) my life!”

verses.text: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
verses.translation: So no one can punish like He will punish, that day,

verses.text: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
verses.translation: nor can anyone shackle like He will shackle.

verses.text: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
verses.translation: (As for an obedient man, it will be said to him,) “O content soul,

verses.text: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
verses.translation: come back to your Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing.

verses.text: And enter among My [righteous] servants
verses.translation: So, enter among My (special) servants,

verses.text: And enter My Paradise."
verses.translation: and enter My Paradise.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: I swear by this city, Makkah -
verses.translation: I swear by this city,

verses.text: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
verses.translation: -and (O Prophet,) you are going to be allowed (to fight) in this city-

verses.text: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
verses.translation: and by the father and all those he begot,

verses.text: We have certainly created man into hardship.
verses.translation: indeed We have created man (to live) in hard struggle.

verses.text: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
verses.translation: Does he think that no one has power over him?

verses.text: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
verses.translation: He says, “I have spent a lot of wealth.”

verses.text: Does he think that no one has seen him?
verses.translation: Does he think that no one has seen him?

verses.text: Have We not made for him two eyes?
verses.translation: Did We not make for him two eyes,

verses.text: And a tongue and two lips?
verses.translation: and one tongue and two lips,

verses.text: And have shown him the two ways?
verses.translation: and showed him the two ways?

verses.text: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
verses.translation: Yet he did not make his way through the steep course,- -

verses.text: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
verses.translation: - And what may let you know what the steep course is?

verses.text: It is the freeing of a slave
verses.translation: (It is) freeing of the neck of a slave,

verses.text: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
verses.translation: or giving food in a day of hunger

verses.text: An orphan of near relationship
verses.translation: to an orphan near of kin,

verses.text: Or a needy person in misery
verses.translation: or to a needy person lying in dust- -

verses.text: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
verses.translation: - then he did not join those who believe and advise each other to be patient and advise each other to be merciful.

verses.text: Those are the companions of the right.
verses.translation: Those are the People of the Right Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their right hands)

verses.text: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
verses.translation: As for those who reject Our verses, they are the People of the Left Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their left hands.)

verses.text: Over them will be fire closed in.
verses.translation: Upon them will be the Fire, enveloping them with closed exits.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the sun and its brightness
verses.translation: I swear by the sun and his broad light,

verses.text: And [by] the moon when it follows it
verses.translation: and by the moon when she follows him,

verses.text: And [by] the day when it displays it
verses.translation: and by the day when it shows his brightness,

verses.text: And [by] the night when it covers it
verses.translation: and by the night when it envelops him,

verses.text: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
verses.translation: and by the sky, and the One who built it,

verses.text: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
verses.translation: and by the earth, and the One who spread it,

verses.text: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
verses.translation: and by the soul, and the One who made it well,

verses.text: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
verses.translation: then inspired it with its (instincts of) evil and piety,

verses.text: He has succeeded who purifies it,
verses.translation: success is really attained by him who purifies it,

verses.text: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
verses.translation: and failure is really suffered by him who pollutes it.

verses.text: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
verses.translation: (The People of) Thamūd denied the truth because of their transgression,

verses.text: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
verses.translation: when rose up the one who was most wretched of them.

verses.text: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
verses.translation: So, the Messenger of Allah said to them, “Be careful of Allah’s she-camel and her right to drink.”

verses.text: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
verses.translation: But they rejected him and killed her, so their Lord sent eradicating torment upon them because of their sin, and made it equal for all.

verses.text: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
verses.translation: And He has no fear of its consequence.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the night when it covers
verses.translation: I swear by the night when it covers (the sun),

verses.text: And [by] the day when it appears
verses.translation: and by the day when it unveils itself,

verses.text: And [by] He who created the male and female,
verses.translation: and by the One who created the male and the female,

verses.text: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
verses.translation: your efforts are diverse:

verses.text: As for he who gives and fears Allah
verses.translation: As for the one who gives (in charity) and fears Allah,

verses.text: And believes in the best [reward],
verses.translation: and believes in the best (religion),

verses.text: We will ease him toward ease.
verses.translation: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme ease (i.e. the comforts of Paradise).

verses.text: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
verses.translation: But the one who is miser and deems himself self-sufficient,

verses.text: And denies the best [reward],
verses.translation: and rejects the best (religion),

verses.text: We will ease him toward difficulty.
verses.translation: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme distress.

verses.text: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
verses.translation: And his wealth will not help him when he will fall down (into Hell).

verses.text: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
verses.translation: Of course, it is undertaken by Us to guide,

verses.text: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.translation: and in Our control is the Hereafter and the worldly life.

verses.text: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
verses.translation: So I have warned you of a blazing fire.

verses.text: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
verses.translation: None will enter it but the wretched one,

verses.text: Who had denied and turned away.
verses.translation: who rejected (the truth) and turned away (from it).

verses.text: But the righteous one will avoid it -
verses.translation: And saved from it will be the most God-fearing one,

verses.text: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
verses.translation: who gives his wealth (in charity) to become purified,

verses.text: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
verses.translation: while no one has conferred any favour on him for which he would give a return,

verses.text: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
verses.translation: but (he gave his wealth in charity) only to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.

verses.text: And he is going to be satisfied.
verses.translation: And surely he will soon be happy.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the morning brightness
verses.translation: I swear by the forenoon,

verses.text: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
verses.translation: and by the night when it becomes peaceful,

verses.text: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
verses.translation: your Lord (O Prophet,) has neither forsaken you, nor has become displeased.

verses.text: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
verses.translation: Surely the Hereafter is much better for you than the present life.

verses.text: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
verses.translation: And of course, your Lord will give you so much that you will be pleased.

verses.text: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
verses.translation: Did He not find you an orphan, and give you shelter?

verses.text: And He found you lost and guided [you],
verses.translation: And He found you unaware of the way (the Sharī‘ah ), then He guided you.

verses.text: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
verses.translation: and He found you in need, then made you need-free.

verses.text: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
verses.translation: Therefore, as for orphan, do not oppress him,

verses.text: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
verses.translation: and as for the beggar, do not scold him.

verses.text: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
verses.translation: And about the bounty of your Lord, do talk.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
verses.translation: Have We not caused your bosom to be wide open for you?

verses.text: And We removed from you your burden
verses.translation: And We removed from you your burden

verses.text: Which had weighed upon your back
verses.translation: that had (almost) broken your back,

verses.text: And raised high for you your repute.
verses.translation: and We raised high your name.

verses.text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
verses.translation: So, undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.

verses.text: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.

verses.text: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
verses.translation: So, when you are free (from collective services), toil hard (in worship),

verses.text: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
verses.translation: and towards your Lord turn with eagerness.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the fig and the olive
verses.translation: I swear by the Fig and the Olive,

verses.text: And [by] Mount Sinai
verses.translation: and by Tūr, the mount of Sinai,

verses.text: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],
verses.translation: and by this peaceful city,

verses.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
verses.translation: We have created man in the best composition,

verses.text: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
verses.translation: then We turned him into the lowest of the low,

verses.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
verses.translation: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, because for them there is a reward never ending.

verses.text: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
verses.translation: So, what can make you, after all this, to deny the Requital?

verses.text: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
verses.translation: Is Allah not the Greatest Ruler of all the rulers?

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
verses.translation: Read with the name of your Lord who created (every thing),

verses.text: Created man from a clinging substance.
verses.translation: He created man from a clot of blood.

verses.text: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
verses.translation: Read, and your Lord is the most gracious,

verses.text: Who taught by the pen -
verses.translation: who imparted knowledge by means of the pen.

verses.text: Taught man that which he knew not.
verses.translation: He taught man what he did not know.

verses.text: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
verses.translation: In fact, man crosses the limits,

verses.text: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
verses.translation: because he deems himself to be free of need.

verses.text: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
verses.translation: Surely to your Lord is the return.

verses.text: Have you seen the one who forbids
verses.translation: Have you seen him who forbids

verses.text: A servant when he prays?
verses.translation: a servant of Allah when he prays?

verses.text: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
verses.translation: Tell me, if he is on the right path,

verses.text: Or enjoins righteousness?
verses.translation: or bids piety, (would the former still forbid him?)

verses.text: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
verses.translation: Tell me, if he rejects (the true faith) and turns away,

verses.text: Does he not know that Allah sees?
verses.translation: does he not know that Allah is watching (him)?

verses.text: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
verses.translation: No! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag (him) by forelock,

verses.text: A lying, sinning forelock.
verses.translation: a lying, sinful forelock.

verses.text: Then let him call his associates;
verses.translation: So let him call the men of his council,

verses.text: We will call the angels of Hell.
verses.translation: We will call the soldiers of the Hell.

verses.text: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah ].
verses.translation: No! Never obey him, and bow down in sajdah, and come close to Me.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
verses.translation: We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down in the Night of Qadr.

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what the Night of Qadr is?

verses.text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
verses.translation: The Night of Qadr is much better than one thousand months.

verses.text: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
verses.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend in it, with the leave of your Lord, along with every command.

verses.text: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
verses.translation: Peace it is till the debut of dawn.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not (expected) to desist (from their wrong beliefs) unless there comes to them a clear proof,

verses.text: A Messenger from Allah , reciting purified scriptures
verses.translation: a messenger from Allah who recites the purified scrolls

verses.text: Within which are correct writings.
verses.translation: containing (right and) straight writings.

verses.text: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
verses.translation: And those who were given the Book did not disagree but after the clear proof came to them,

verses.text: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
verses.translation: while they were not ordered but to worship Allah, making their submission exclusive for him with no deviation, and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh. That is the way of the straight religion.

verses.text: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
verses.translation: Surely those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Jahannam , in which they will be living forever. Those are the worst of all human beings.

verses.text: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
verses.translation: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they are the best of all human beings.

verses.text: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
verses.translation: Their reward, with their Lord, is gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow, in which they will be abiding forever. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. That (reward) is for him who has awe of his Lord.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
verses.translation: When the earth will be trembled with its quake,

verses.text: And the earth discharges its burdens
verses.translation: and the earth will bring forth its burdens,

verses.text: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
verses.translation: and man will say, “What has happened to it?”

verses.text: That Day, it will report its news
verses.translation: That day it will describe all its happenings,

verses.text: Because your Lord has commanded it.
verses.translation: because its Lord will have so commanded it.

verses.text: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
verses.translation: That day the people will come back (from the place of reckoning) in different groups, so that they may be shown (the fruits of) their deeds.

verses.text: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
verses.translation: So, whoever does any good act (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.

verses.text: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
verses.translation: And whoever does evil (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the racers, panting,
verses.translation: (I swear) by those (horses) that run snorting,

verses.text: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
verses.translation: then those that create sparks by striking (their hoofs) on the stones,

verses.text: And the chargers at dawn,
verses.translation: then those that invade at morning,

verses.text: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
verses.translation: then raise, at the same time, a trail of dust,

verses.text: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
verses.translation: then enter, at the same time, into the centre of the (opposing) host,

verses.text: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
verses.translation: man is, indeed, very ungrateful to his Lord,

verses.text: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
verses.translation: and he himself is a witness to that fact,

verses.text: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
verses.translation: and in his love for wealth, he is very intense.

verses.text: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
verses.translation: Does he not then know (what will happen) when all that is contained in the graves will be overturned,

verses.text: And that within the breasts is obtained,
verses.translation: and all that is contained in the hearts will be exposed.

verses.text: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
verses.translation: Surely your Lord, that day, is fully aware of them.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Striking Calamity -
verses.translation: The Striking Event!

verses.text: What is the Striking Calamity?
verses.translation: What is the Striking Event?

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what the Striking Event is?

verses.text: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
verses.translation: (It will happen) on a day when people will be like scattered moths,

verses.text: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
verses.translation: and the mountains will be like carded wool.

verses.text: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
verses.translation: Then, as for him whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy,

verses.text: He will be in a pleasant life.
verses.translation: he will be in a happy life.

verses.text: But as for one whose scales are light,
verses.translation: But he whose scales are light,

verses.text: His refuge will be an abyss.
verses.translation: -his abode will be Abyss.

verses.text: And what can make you know what that is?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what that (Abyss) is?

verses.text: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
verses.translation: A blazing Fire!

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
verses.translation: You are distracted by mutual competition in amassing (worldly benefits),

verses.text: Until you visit the graveyards.
verses.translation: until you reach the graves.

verses.text: No! You are going to know.
verses.translation: No! (This is not a correct attitude.) You will soon know (the reality).

verses.text: Then no! You are going to know.
verses.translation: Again, you will soon know.

verses.text: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
verses.translation: No! Only if you knew (it) with a sure knowledge!

verses.text: You will surely see the Hellfire.
verses.translation: You will certainly see the Hell,

verses.text: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
verses.translation: then you will see it with full certitude.

verses.text: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
verses.translation: Then you will be asked about all the pleasures (you enjoyed in the world).

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: By time,
verses.translation: (I swear) by the Time,

verses.text: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
verses.translation: man is in a state of loss indeed,

verses.text: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
verses.translation: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, and exhorted each other to follow truth, and exhorted each other to observe patience.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Woe to every scorner and mocker
verses.translation: Woe to every backbiter, derider

verses.text: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
verses.translation: who accumulates wealth and counts it.

verses.text: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
verses.translation: He thinks that his wealth has made him eternal.

verses.text: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
verses.translation: Never! He will certainly be thrown into the Crushing Fire.

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
verses.translation: And what may let you know what the Crushing Fire is?

verses.text: It is the fire of Allah , [eternally] fueled,
verses.translation: It is Allah’s kindled fire

verses.text: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
verses.translation: that will peep into the hearts.

verses.text: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
verses.translation: It will be closed on them,

verses.text: In extended columns.
verses.translation: in outstretched columns.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
verses.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?

verses.text: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
verses.translation: Has He not turned their plan into nullity?

verses.text: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
verses.translation: And He sent upon them flying birds in flocks,

verses.text: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
verses.translation: throwing upon them stones of baked clay,

verses.text: And He made them like eaten straw.
verses.translation: and thus He turned them into an eaten-up chaff.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
verses.translation: Because of the familiarity of the Quraish,

verses.text: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
verses.translation: that is, their familiarity with the trips of winter and summer,

verses.text: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
verses.translation: they must worship the Lord of this House,

verses.text: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
verses.translation: who gave them food against hunger, and gave them security against fear.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
verses.translation: Have you seen him who denies the Requital?

verses.text: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
verses.translation: So, he is the one who pushes away the orphan,

verses.text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.translation: and does not persuade (others) to feed the needy.

verses.text: So woe to those who pray
verses.translation: So, Woe to those performers of Salāh,

verses.text: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
verses.translation: who are neglectful of their Salāh,

verses.text: Those who make show [of their deeds]
verses.translation: who (do good only to) show off,

verses.text: And withhold [simple] assistance.
verses.translation: and refuse (to give even) small gifts.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
verses.translation: (O Prophet,) surely We have given to you Al-Kauthar.

verses.text: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
verses.translation: So, offer Salāh (prayer) to your Lord, and sacrifice.

verses.text: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
verses.translation: Surely it is your enemy whose traces are cut off.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "O disbelievers,
verses.translation: Say, “O disbelievers,

verses.text: I do not worship what you worship.
verses.translation: I do not worship that which you worship,

verses.text: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
verses.translation: nor do you worship the One whom I worship.

verses.text: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
verses.translation: And neither I am going to worship that which you have worshipped,

verses.text: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
verses.translation: nor will you worship the One whom I worship.

verses.text: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
verses.translation: For you is your faith, and for me, my faith.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
verses.translation: (O Prophet,) When there comes Allah’s help and the Victory,

verses.text: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
verses.translation: and you see people entering Allah’s (approved) religion in multitudes,

verses.text: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
verses.translation: then pronounce the purity and praise of your Lord, and seek forgiveness from Him. Surely He is Ever-Relenting.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
verses.translation: Perish the two hands of Abū Lahab, and perish he!

verses.text: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
verses.translation: Neither his wealth benefited him, nor what he earned.

verses.text: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
verses.translation: He will soon enter a Fire, full of flames,

verses.text: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
verses.translation: and his wife as well,-the wicked carrier of firewood.

verses.text: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
verses.translation: Around her neck, there is (a collar of iron, like) a well-twisted rope.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One,
verses.translation: Say, “The truth is that Allah is One.

verses.text: Allah , the Eternal Refuge.
verses.translation: Allah is Besought of all, needing none.

verses.text: He neither begets nor is born,
verses.translation: He neither begot anyone, nor was he begotten.

verses.text: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
verses.translation: And equal to Him has never been any one.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
verses.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak

verses.text: From the evil of that which He created
verses.translation: from the evil of everything He has created,

verses.text: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.translation: and from the evil of the dark night when it penetrates,

verses.text: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.translation: and from the evil of the women who blow on the knots,

verses.text: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
verses.translation: and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
verses.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

verses.text: The Sovereign of mankind.
verses.translation: the King of mankind,

verses.text: The God of mankind,
verses.translation: the God of mankind,

verses.text: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
verses.translation: from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws (when Allah’s name is pronounced),

verses.text: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
verses.translation: the one who whispers in the hearts of people,

verses.text: From among the jinn and mankind."
verses.translation: whether from among the Jinn or Mankind.
